izzyondroid:eu.lastviking.app.vgtd.name: vikingGTD
izzyondroid:eu.lastviking.app.vgtd.description:
Inspired by the great book Getting Things Done by David Allan. This is a program I wrote because I badly needed it in order to organize my own time. I failed to find anything, on any platform, that satisfied my requirements:
 Free
 Preferably Open Source
 Designed after the principles in "Getting Things Done"
 Safe; no unnecessary app privileges, no enforced integration with Google (or any other) services in order to work.
 Fast and efficient to work with
 Safeguards against losing data by accidents in stressful environments (for example by cancelling a half edited task by hitting the Android back button).
 These requirements became my blueprint when I built VikingGTD. VikingGTD is free of eye candy and animations – but in stead very fast and responsive, also when the number of tasks grows during real use by busy people. (The database on my device has more than 8000 actions).
 VikingGTD implements what I believe is the most essential part of David Allens Getting Things done system: To be able to put all the stuff in your life into a system (lists) you can trust 100%.
 It's not a full blown GTD application - a lot of people (me included) are not ready to jump into that in one step. This application is for people who has grown out of the simple "to do apps" and "task managers" and need something a little better.
 Features: 
 Any number of actions in one of any number of lists.
 Each action can be configured with when, where, how and at what priority. These parameters can then be used to easily sort trough and re-organize the actions.
 Search in lists and actions.
 Fast access to main functions and frequently used features
 Easy to schedule an action to any time, date, week, month, or year.
 Easy and fast to reschedule one or more actions.
 Export to / import from xml on the sdcard for backup and move to other devices. (I use Nextcloud for backing up my app data).
 Flexible automatic repeat of completed actions for reoccurring tasks (from "Feed the cat" the next day to "years into the future).

izzyondroid:io.treehouses.remote.name: treehouses remote
izzyondroid:io.treehouses.remote.summary: Communicate with headless RaspPi server running treehouses image via Bluetooth
izzyondroid:io.treehouses.remote.description:
In order to use treehouses remote, it is required to download a custom Raspbian image that can be found here and flash it onto an SD card to be inserted into your Raspberry Pi.
 With treehouses remote, you can:
 Get detailed software and hardware information of a Raspberry Pi
 Configure a Raspberry Pi through user-friendly interface
 Easily install and access services such as Nextcloud, Netdata, Transmission, MongoDB, MariaDB and Moodle on your RPi
 And utilize many more features!
 Usage:
 treehouses [command]
treehouses help [command]
 Example Commands:
 help --- gives you a more detailed info about the command or will output this
expandfs --- expands the partition of the RPi image to the maximum of the SD card
rename --- changes hostname
password --- changes the password for 'pi' user
sshkey --- used for adding or removing ssh keys for authentication
version --- returns the version of cli.sh command
image --- returns version of the system image installed
detectrpi --- detects the hardware version of a Raspberry Pi
detect --- detects the hardware version of any device
ethernet --- configures rpi network interface to a static IP address
discover --- performs network scan and discovers all Raspberry Pis on the network
wifi --- connects to a wifi network
wifihidden --- connects to a hidden wifi network
staticwifi --- configures RPi wifi interface to a static ip address
wifistatus --- displays signal strength in dBm and layman nomenclature
bridge --- configures the RPi to bridge the WLAN interface over a hotspot
container docker balena --- enables (and start) the desired container
bluetooth --- switches bluetooth from regular to hotspot mode and shows id or MAC address
ap --- creates a mobile ap, which has two modes: local (no eth0 bridging), internet (eth0 bridging)
apchannel --- sets or prints the current ap channel
timezone --- sets the timezone of the system
locale --- sets the system locale
ssh --- enables or disables the SSH service
vnc --- enables or disables the VNC server service
default --- sets a raspbian back to default configuration
wificountry --- sets the wifi country
upgrade --- upgrades cli.sh package using npm
sshtunnel --- helps adding an sshtunnel
led --- sets the led mode
rtc --- sets up the rtc clock specified
ntp --- sets rpi to host timing locally or to get timing from a remote server
networkmode --- outputs the current network mode
button --- gives the gpio pin 18 an action
feedback --- sends feedback
clone --- clones the current SDCard onto a secondary SD card or specified device
restore --- restores a treehouses image to an SD card or specified device
burn --- download and burns the latest treehouses image to the SD card or specified device
rebootneeded --- shows if reboot is required to apply changes
reboots --- reboots at given frequency | removes it if reboot task active
internet --- checks if the RPi has access to internet
services --- executes the given command on the specified service
tor --- deals with services on tor hidden network
bootoption --- sets the boot mode
openvpn --- helps setting up an openvpn client
coralenv --- plays with the coral environmental board
memory --- displays the total memory of the device, the memory used as well as the available free memory
temperature --- displays Raspberry Pi's CPU temperature
speedtest --- tests internet download and upload speed
camera --- enables camera, disables camera, captures png photo
cron --- adds, deletes a custom cron job or deletes, lists all cron jobs
usb --- turns usb ports on or off

fdroid:com.lfjsoftworks.drift.name: Drift
fdroid:com.lfjsoftworks.drift.summary: Local-first RSS and Atom reader with optional cross-device sync
fdroid:com.lfjsoftworks.drift.description:
Drift is a local-first RSS and Atom feed reader. It fetches feeds directly from their source and keeps its own SQLite database on your device, so the app works fully offline and does not depend on any third-party service to function.
Drift is free and open source software, licensed under the AGPL-3.0-or-later.
Key features:
* Fetches RSS and Atom feeds directly, with no intermediary server required
* Local SQLite storage; your subscriptions and read history stay on your device
* OPML import and export for moving feeds in and out of other readers
* Optional self-hosted sync: point Drift at your own sync relay to keep subscriptions and read status in step across devices. The relay only relays data between your own devices; it is never the source of truth and is entirely optional
* Full-text article fetching for feeds that only publish summaries
* Starred articles, feed tags, and article search
* Background refresh and new-article notifications
* Home-screen article widget
Drift contains no advertisements, no analytics, and no tracking of any kind. The only network access it makes is to fetch the feeds you subscribe to and, if you choose to configure one, your own sync server.
Drift is available for Android, Linux, macOS, and the web.

fdroid:com.novadial.phone.name: NovaDial
fdroid:com.novadial.phone.summary: Unlock a secure, open-source calling experience with NovaDialer
fdroid:com.novadial.phone.description:
📞 SMARTER CALLING, DESIGNED FOR CLARITY
NovaDial is a privacy-focused phone application built for users who want a clean, reliable, and efficient calling experience. Based on Fossify Phone and developed as an independent fork, NovaDial introduces significant improvements to call management, usability, and performance while remaining completely free and open source.
🔒 PRIVACY FIRST
Your phone app should work for you, not track you. NovaDial contains no ads, no trackers, no purchases, and no unnecessary data collection. Your call history, contacts, and communication remain under your control.
📋 REIMAGINED CALL HISTORY
NovaDial introduces a redesigned call history system focused on speed and usability.
Traditional call logs can become cluttered over time, displaying thousands of duplicate entries from the same contacts. NovaDial takes a different approach by organizing recent calls around unique callers instead of loading every historical call record at once.
Benefits include:
• Faster startup and smoother navigation
• Cleaner recent calls interface
• Reduced clutter from repeated call entries
• Dedicated call details page for each contact
• Complete call history available when needed
Instead of displaying hundreds of repeated entries from the same caller in the main recent calls view, NovaDial shows a concise overview of your communication history. Detailed call records remain accessible through the dedicated call details screen.
🎨 MODERN AND USER-FRIENDLY DESIGN
NovaDial introduces UI refinements focused on usability and clarity. The interface is designed to feel familiar while providing a more streamlined experience for daily phone usage.
⚡ FAST AND LIGHTWEIGHT
Built to be efficient and responsive, NovaDial minimizes unnecessary data processing in the dialer and recent calls screens, helping maintain a smooth experience even for users with large call histories.
🌍 FULLY OPEN SOURCE
NovaDial is open source software. Anyone can inspect the source code, contribute improvements, or help shape the future of the project.
❤️ COMMUNITY-DRIVEN DEVELOPMENT
NovaDial is an independent fork of Fossify Phone, created to improve the calling experience through focused development and user-driven enhancements.
Download NovaDial and enjoy a cleaner, faster, and more privacy-respecting phone experience.
Open-Source Code: https://www.github.com/dhilipmpms/NovaDial

fdroid:dev.danjackson.speaker.name: Speaker
fdroid:dev.danjackson.speaker.summary: Bluetooth speaker fix: play background sound
fdroid:dev.danjackson.speaker.description:
This app automatically plays a quiet background noise when connected to specific Bluetooth devices.
This fixes problems with some Bluetooth speakers where, following silence, the speaker misses the first part of the next sound that is played. This is most apparent with intermittent sounds, such as speech. For example, when listening to an audiobook, the first part of each sentence may often be missed.
Playing a quiet (almost inaudible) noise on these speakers at all times prevents any periods of total silence and so avoids this problem.
The sound will play automatically while you are connected to certain Bluetooth devices, as chosen in the settings. Alternatively, you can temporarily play or pause the sound in the upper toolbar.

flathub:com.obsproject.Studio.description:
Free and open source software for video capturing, recording, and live streaming.
 Features:
 High performance real time video/audio capturing and mixing. Create scenes made up of multiple sources including window captures, images, text, browser windows, webcams, capture cards and more.
 Set up an unlimited number of scenes you can switch between seamlessly via custom transitions.
 Intuitive audio mixer with per-source filters such as noise gate, noise suppression, and gain. Take full control with VST plugin support.
 Powerful and easy to use configuration options. Add new Sources, duplicate existing ones, and adjust their properties effortlessly.
 Streamlined Settings panel gives you access to a wide array of configuration options to tweak every aspect of your broadcast or recording.
 Modular 'Dock' UI allows you to rearrange the layout exactly as you like. You can even pop out each individual Dock to its own window.
 Create Professional Productions:
 Choose from a number of different and customizable transitions for when you switch between your scenes or add your own stinger video files.
 Set hotkeys for nearly every sort of action, such as switching between scenes, starting/stopping streams or recordings, muting audio sources, push to talk, and more.
 Studio Mode lets you preview your scenes and sources before pushing them live. Adjust your scenes and sources or create new ones and ensure they're perfect before your viewers ever see them.
 Get a high level view of your production using the Multiview. Monitor 8 different scenes and easily cue or transition to any of them with merely a single or double click.

flathub:com.voxdsp.TuxVsDragon.name: Tux VS Dragon
flathub:com.voxdsp.TuxVsDragon.description:
You have to defeat the dragon. It takes 24 snowball hits to defeat the dragon. If Tux gets hit just once you have to start all over again! Snowballs will randomly spawn in one of the four grassy patches, Tux can only carry one at a time and cant throw a snowball unless he is standing still. Good luck!
 W,A,S,D / Arrow Keys = Move
 Space Bar = Throw Snowball
 C = Change camera view

April 1, 1991. A group of rogue handheld devices have broken from the order.
 They are determined to destroy us! Your mission is to defeat them...
 by any means necessary!
 5 exciting levels!

flathub:io.jor.nanosaur.name: Nanosaur
flathub:io.jor.nanosaur.summary: Send dinosaur eggs to the future before a meteor hits the Earth!
flathub:io.jor.nanosaur.description:
You are a dinosaur (a Nanosaur to be exact) from the future who has traveled back in time to collect the eggs of 5 dinosaur species before the giant asteroid hits the earth. The “primitive” dinosaurs will attack you as you try to get their eggs, but just remember that it’s for their own good that you blast them into oblivion!
 Being a dinosaur from the future, you are equipped with several pieces of technology to help you in your mission:
 Fusion Blaster: a multipurpose weapon for killing things.
 Jet Pack: for flying over things that might kill you.
 Temporal Compass: for finding time portals.
 GPS Locator: for figuring out where you are and where you should go.
 You can jump, swim, run around, jet around, shoot stuff, etc. The general rule to playing the game is “if it moves, kill it or it’ll kill you.” You only have 20 minutes to collect all 5 egg species so being efficient about your actions is critical.
 About this port: Nanosaur was released in 1998 by Pangea Software. It was a pack-in game on Macs that came out around that time. This port aims to provide the best way to experience Nanosaur today. This port was made and re-released under permission from Pangea Software, Inc.

flathub:org.gnome.Characters.name: Characters
flathub:org.gnome.Characters.description:
Characters is a simple utility application to find and insert unusual characters. It allows you to quickly find the character you are looking for by searching for keywords.
 You can also browse characters by categories, such as Punctuation, Pictures, etc.

flathub:org.gnome.Klotski.name: GNOME Klotski
flathub:org.gnome.Klotski.summary: Slide blocks to solve the puzzle
flathub:org.gnome.Klotski.description:
GNOME Klotski is a set of block sliding puzzles. The objective is to move the
 patterned block to the area bordered by green markers. To do so, you’ll need
 to slide other blocks out of the way. Complete each puzzle in as few moves as
 possible!
 GNOME Klotski comes with nearly thirty different puzzle layouts of varying
 difficulty. Some of the layouts are similar and only the size of one or more
 blocks differ. Other layouts have more variety.

firefox-addons:2869743.name: Web Privacy Defender
firefox-addons:2869743.summary: Web Privacy Defender is a lightweight tool that protects your online identity by preventing WebRTC leaks, which can expose your real IP address, even when using a VPN. This extension ensures your IP remains hidden, adding an extra layer of privacy.
firefox-addons:2869743.description:
Web Privacy Defender is a specialized Firefox extension crafted to enhance your online privacy by effectively preventing WebRTC leaks. As more users turn to VPNs for secure browsing, it’s crucial to understand that WebRTC can still expose your real IP address, undermining the very protection a VPN offers. This is where Web Privacy Defender steps in.
Key Features:
1. WebRTC Leak Prevention: The primary function of Web Privacy Defender is to block WebRTC requests that could reveal your actual IP address. This ensures that your online activities remain anonymous and secure.
2. User-Friendly Interface: Designed with simplicity in mind, the extension offers an intuitive interface that allows users to activate or deactivate protections with just a click.
3. Lightweight Design: Web Privacy Defender is built to be resource-efficient, ensuring that it does not slow down your browsing experience while providing robust protection.
4. Compatibility: The extension is fully compatible with various VPN services, enhancing your privacy without interfering with your existing security measures.
5. Real-Time Protection: Web Privacy Defender works in real-time, continuously monitoring your browser for any WebRTC requests and blocking them instantly to maintain your anonymity.
6. Easy Installation: Available directly from the Firefox Add-ons store, the installation process is quick and straightforward, allowing users to get protected in no time.
Why Use Web Privacy Defender?
In today’s digital age, safeguarding your online identity is more important than ever. With increasing concerns over privacy and data security, Web Privacy Defender offers an essential tool for anyone who values their anonymity online. By preventing WebRTC leaks, this extension provides an additional layer of security that complements your existing privacy measures, allowing you to browse the internet with confidence.
Whether you are accessing sensitive information, participating in online discussions, or simply enjoying your favorite content, Web Privacy Defender ensures that your real IP address remains concealed, thus protecting you from potential tracking and unwanted exposure.
With Web Privacy Defender, you can take control of your online privacy. This extension empowers you to browse securely, knowing that your identity is shielded from invasive technologies. Join the growing community of privacy-conscious users and enhance your web experience with Web Privacy Defender today!

firefox-addons:2773135.name: Beagle Security Web Assessment
firefox-addons:2773135.summary: Find surface level vulnerabilities in your web applications. Run a free website security assessment and gain a preliminary understanding of your application’s security posture.
firefox-addons:2773135.description:
Beagle Security's free website security assessment allows you to gain a preliminary understanding of your website's security posture. You can fix the issues by following the remediation procedures to improve your website's security.
Do you need an in-depth security assessment?
Beagle Security also offers an in-depth analysis of your website’s security to uncover all the latest vulnerabilities. With a coverage of 3000+ test cases, you can always be one step ahead of the bad actors.
Here's what you get with an in-depth security assessment
Technology agnostic solution
Beagle Security is technology and framework agnostic, giving you the complete flexibility to security test any web apps no matter how it is built. Legacy or the latest tech stack – the choice is yours.
Continuous security testing
Staying secure from the latest vulnerabilities can be a challenge when you rely on manual penetration testing. With Beagle Security, you can conduct periodic security tests with ease, either by scheduling them or running them in your CI/CD pipeline.
Find vulnerabilities behind login
Most of the critical functionalities in an application exist behind the login page. Running authenticated security tests allows you to make sure that most of the attack surface that exists on the authenticated pages are not left unattended.
Hunt down zero-days
Staying protected from zero days vulnerabilities used to be hard, but not anymore. You are backed by a dedicated team of security researchers that is always on the hunt for the latest zero-days and adding them to our vulnerability index.
Intelligence for your AppSec
Less false positives, support for multiple login authentication types, autonomously deciding attack scenarios - sounds too good to be true. That is what Beagle Security’s AI-powered core brings to the table.
Work with your tools
Beagle Security integrates with your bug tracking tools, communication apps and CI/CD pipeline tools, helping you to save time and focus on your priorities. Complete a one-time setup and experience a seamless application security workflow.

firefox-addons:3034636.name: Supernova Security
firefox-addons:3034636.summary: Blocks ads, trackers, and known malicious/phishing domains to keep your browsing fast and safe.
firefox-addons:3034636.description: A lightweight security and privacy extension that does three things: strips ads at the network level so pages load faster, blocks analytics and tracking scripts that follow you across the web, and intercepts known phishing and malware domains before they load. Each tab gets its own blocked count, threats redirect to a warning page instead of loading silently, and you can whitelist any site instantly from the popup.

firefox-addons:911317.name: Baseliner
firefox-addons:911317.summary: An extension for designers and developers who care about the grid.
firefox-addons:911317.description:
This tool will add a layer on top of any website to be used as a guidance when developing interfaces. 
Both vertical and horizontal baselines are now supported (V6.0+).
For better experience, you can change the colour of the lines as well as the opacity, making it easier to compare the grid with your website design. 
The configuration you set for each URL is saved on localStorage, so you can go back later on and keep the grid as it was last time.
Developed by J. Pedro Ribeiro (@jpedroribeiro), and constantly updated with support of the open source community.

firefox-addons:2699975.name: Translator (2)
firefox-addons:2699975.description:
Help to translate typed text, selected text, the active page.
This extension uses Google Translate, Bing Translator, Yandex Translate, Promt Translator, Pragma Translator or Babylon Dictionaries (optional).
How to translate text:
method 1: select required text on any web page and press on extension's button.
method 2: press on extension's button, enter required text in upper field and press "Translate"
How to translate web page:
method 1: load required web page, press on extension's button and click on "Translate active page '...'"
method 2: open preferences (right click on extension's button), choose "Default target language" and "Use Translate Toolbar" => each foreign web page will have hint to translate it.

firefox-addons:1019521.name: Media Tools - Convert, Split & Extract
firefox-addons:1019521.summary: Manipulate media files (video & audio) via FFmpeg commands right in your browser.
firefox-addons:1019521.description:
Media Tools , is a simple and very lite add-on that allows you to easily manipulate media (video, audio, etc.) files right in your browser. 
It uses an open-source software called FFmpeg. FFmpeg is an engine containing a suite of libraries for handling video, audio, and other media files and streams. In order to get more info about FFmpeg please read this Wikipedia page. To download and install FFmpeg on your machine, please visit this page.
This add-on uses nativeMessaging technology to communicate with FFmpeg software on your machine. Before using this add-on, you need to install FFmpeg on your machine. You also need the native client patch in order to build the communication between FFmpeg and your browser.
Please visit this GitHub repo and download the related patch for your machine. Follow the instruction in the above GitHub page in order to install the patch in your system. After installing, the "Media Tools" add-on in your browser can communicate with FFmpeg client on your machine (Window, Linux or Mac).
If you have a feature request, or found a bug to report, please fill the bug report form in the add-on's homepage .

bluejetty:00024490:ios.summary: Sequel to the 2019 smash hit, Mr Bullet, Mr Ninja will be your next great puzzle obsession! Replace your gun toting ways and equip a sword in this slash'em and dash’em puzzle experience! Swipe away and slice down the enemy spies, pirates, a
bluejetty:00024490:ios.description:
Sequel to the 2019 smash hit, Mr Bullet, Mr Ninja will be your next great puzzle obsession! Replace your gun toting ways and equip a sword in this slash'em and dash’em puzzle experience! Swipe away and slice down the enemy spies, pirates, and zombies. This unique puzzle experience will test your creative thinking. Enemies have gotten smarter and will block your attacks. Do you have what it takes to solve them all?
Use your brain in this unique puzzle game. You will need to outwit the enemies in order to make the killing blow! Travel to new levels, save hostages, and new unique weapons to battle your foes. Start your adventure now! The one thing you have to ask yourself is: can you do it in one slice?
 Game Features:
1. Destroy them all and save the world, again!
Mister Ninja is on a stealth mission. Use your quick wit and cut through the bad guys! Whether it is a spy, agent, zombie, lumberjack, alien they are all here to get in your way and only a MASTER can take them down.
2. Endless amount of Missions
So many enemies and levels for you to take down, each with their own unique twist! How smart are you? Can you solve all the puzzles? Slice through enemies to cut them down. Use your sword skills to make objects fall and explode. Create chain reactions and do whatever it takes to get your target!
3. New Challenges Await
Rescue hostages, throw shurikens at people and go on secret missions. No matter the situation, just remember to make motion count!
4. Engaging Physics Puzzler
Only the smartest and quickest can solve all the puzzles! You will need more than just accuracy to make it through. Speed, timing and patience are all things you will need to become the zennist ninja master. Can you get three stars on every level?
5. New Features Constantly Added
Never get bored! Mr Ninja is constantly updating with new unique levels, weapons and other skins. You will NOT want to miss out on the action.
If you liked Mr Bullet, you will love Mr Ninja!
Visit https://lionstudios.cc/contact-us/ if have any feedback, need help on beating a level or have any awesome ideas you would like to see in the game!

bluejetty:00079049:ios.summary: You have many mysteries to solve - murders on the train, at the Halloween fair, at the theater... Can you solve them all? The fascinating crime investigation "Murderous Script Collector's Edition" in the "Unsolved Case" series of detective
bluejetty:00079049:ios.description:
You have many mysteries to solve - murders on the train, at the Halloween fair, at the theater... Can you solve them all? The fascinating crime investigation "Murderous Script Collector's Edition" in the "Unsolved Case" series of detective games invites you to solve another mystery case, where you can test what deduction can do. Interrogate suspects, collect evidence, find hidden objects! You will have to make hard decisions to complete the task and see how the episode ends. It's time to make your choice!
You and your partner Scott have a lot of work ahead. There is the case of the famous city attorney, Richard Errikson, who turns out to have shady dealings. Another day, your buddy calls you to solve the disappearance of his sister’s boyfriend without official orders from the department. People in the media can also have dramatic lives, with all the abductions and a whole chandelier falling on a TV host’s brother. You are left with just a few clues if any. Do you have the courage, the curiosity to uncover the truth? Can you outsmart all worthy opponents?
· THINK TWICE!
You have the ability to choose a character's phrases for a particular action and influence the plot of the detective story. Don't forget that only your choice determines the course of this complex investigation and can affect the lives of the characters! 
· EARN ACHIEVEMENTS!
Conduct your own investigation, solving tangled puzzles, clever riddles and playing various mini-games. You need to get to the truth by interviewing suspects and investigating locations. If you act like a true detective, you'll earn many achievements that will highlight your success!
· GET READY FOR MORE!
Collect all the evidence and catch the culprit! You must complete this case to gain access to the bonus location! Immerse yourself in the criminal atmosphere of this unsolved case!
· COLLECT ITEMS!
This new episode of the detective story is full of mysterious objects and items that the player needs to find to advance the investigation! Lots of scenic locations with mysteries to solve and secrets to find! 
This game has a free trial part. You can unlock the full version through an in-app purchase.
-----

Find other games on our official website: https://dominigames.com/
Become our fan on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/dominigames
Check out our Instagram and stay tuned: https://www.instagram.com/dominigames

bluejetty:00099116:ios.description:
Printing has never been easier. With support for over 8,000 wireless printers, AnyPrint app lets you print documents and photos in seconds - straight from your device. Just choose a file, customize it using built-in tools, and print effortlessly.
Key Features:
PRINT FROM YOUR iOS DEVICE
- Print photos, documents, web pages, and contacts.
- Print directly from Dropbox or Google Drive.
- Supports 20+ file formats, including PDF, DOCX, JPG, CSV and TXT.
BUILT-IN DOCUMENT SCANNER
- Scan documents using your device’s camera.
- Easily print or share scanned files.
ADVANCED PRINT SETTINGS
- Choose page orientation.
- Print single or double-sided.
- Select pages per sheet.
- Print in black & white or color.
- Customize paper size (A3, A4, B5, and more).
- Set number of copies and page ranges.
POWERFUL DOCUMENT EDITING
- Highlight, draw, or add text to documents.
- Customize with built-in markup tools.
PHOTO ENHANCEMENT TOOLS
- Apply filters, blur, contrast, or sharpening.
- Resize and crop photos.
- Fine-tune saturation, masking, and more.
Seamless Compatibility. 
AnyPrint app works with all printer models that support AirPrint and is compatible with 99% of Wi-Fi-enabled printers.
!!! To use all features, ensure your iOS device and printer are connected to the same Wi-Fi network.
Premium:
To receive full access to AnyPrint features, you will need to subscribe to Premium.
Information about subscription auto-renewal:
- Subscription automatically renews unless the auto-renewal is turned off at least 24h before the end of the current period.
- The user can manage subscriptions and turn auto-renewal off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.
- Any unused portion of the trial period will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription.
- Payment will be charged for renewal within 24h prior to the end of the current period, and the cost of the renewal will be identified.

bluejetty:00184700:ios.description:
** Remastered version **
Survival RPG 2:Temple Ruins is the sequel of the first game : Survival RPG: Lost Treasure. It is a free 2d classic survival exploration RPG adventure game that combines quests, fantasy in a 2d retro style pixel art universe. All in one game!
On the first game, you were looking for a lost treasure, you ran aground and ended up on a deserted island. After many combats, items crafting and adventures, you finally found it and came back home with your ship and relaxed.
But shortly after, you were eager for new adventures. You heard rumors of a magical artifact that lies among the temple ruins. So you decide to embark on a new journey full of adventures leading you to a mysterious temple in the jungle.
In order to succeed, you will have to explore different environments: desert, jungle, forest, dungeon, complete quests, solve puzzles, help other characters, become a forager expert and gather items, craft multiple new ones and fight monsters in this fantasy retro pixel art 2d adventure.
Features:
- 7 story chapters that will bring you to the artifact.
- Exploration of more than 30 dungeons, caverns, jungles, temples and huts.
- More than 180 items to discover and craft
- Multiple quests and characters to help you in your journey.
- 70 crafting recipes that you will unlock during your adventure and exploration.
- Craft tools to help you
 - Cut trees with an axe
 - Use shovel for different tasks
 - Create candles or lantern to see in dark dungeons
 - Use pickaxes to gather different minerals
 - And many more...
- Discover hidden items
- Forage for food and become the forager expert
- Find hidden treasures with treasure maps
- Fight more than 35 different monsters and bosses
- Explore and solve multiple puzzles
- Classic retro style
Enjoy Survival RPG 2: Temple Ruins. A free 2d retro RPG adventure game, explore multiple environment, forest, jungle, temple and dungeon, survive and find the artifact! Hours of gameplay and choose your hero to be a boy or a girl character.
Follow us on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/survivaladventurethegame/

On the first game, you were looking for a lost treasure, you ran aground and ended up on a deserted island. After many combats, items crafting and adventures, you finally found it and came back home with your ship and relaxed.
 
But shortly after, you were eager for new adventures. You heard rumors of a magical artifact that lies among the temple ruins. So you decide to embark on a new journey full of adventures leading you to a mysterious temple in the jungle.
 
In order to succeed, you will have to explore different environments: desert, jungle, forest, dungeon, complete quests, solve puzzles, help other characters, become a forager expert and gather items, craft multiple new ones and fight monsters in this fantasy retro pixel art 2d adventure.
 
Features:

- 7 story chapters that will bring you to the artifact.
- Exploration of more than 30 dungeons, caverns, jungles, temples and huts.
- More than 180 items to discover and craft
- Multiple quests and characters to help you in your journey.
- 70 crafting recipes that you will unlock during your adventure and exploration.
- Craft tools to help you
     - Cut trees with an axe
     - Use shovel for different tasks
     - Create candles or lantern to see in dark dungeons
     - Use pickaxes to gather different minerals
     - And many more...
- Discover hidden items
- Forage for food and become the forager expert
- Find hidden treasures with treasure maps
- Fight more than 35 different monsters and bosses
- Explore and solve multiple puzzles
- Classic retro style
 
Enjoy Survival RPG 2: Temple Ruins. A free 2d retro RPG adventure game, explore multiple environment, forest, jungle, temple and dungeon, survive and find the artifact! Hours of gameplay and choose your hero to be a boy or a girl character.

bluejetty:00063693:ios.description:
The “Marantz AVR Remote” app for iPhone and iPad will give you an unprecedented level of command and control over the latest generation of Marantz AV Receivers (due to hardware differences, older models are not supported with this app. Please check the model compatibility list below). A wide portfolio of useful features, nicely designed graphics and easy to operate user interface do make the app a useful tool to control your AVR.
Control the basic functions of your Marantz product with power, volume, input and settings. Have direct access to Smart Select and Surround Modes.
Network browsing is either done within the Marantz AVR Remote app or depending on model by selecting HEOS network as input which opens the HEOS app automatically.
With the new Marantz AVR Remote, your iOS device just became an integral part of your home entertainment experience.
"Because Music Matters"
Compatible Marantz Models (*1, *2)
2026 New Models

Network AV Receiver: CINEMA 50 SERIES 2, CINEMA 60 SERIES 2, CINEMA 70s SERIES 2

2024 Model

2023 Model

2021 Model

2020 Models

Network AV Receiver: SR8015, SR7015, SR6015, SR5015, NR1711

2018 Models

*Not compatible with Marantz models other than the above models.
Main feature:
•On the fly HEOS app switching for network browsing and control for HEOS built-in AVR and AVP
•ECO Mode setting
•Option settings (Sleep Tone, Channel Level etc.) and Selected Setup Features
•Marantz CD Control when your Marantz AVR is connected to Marantz CD Player with a remote cable
•Viewing User manuals
•Multi-Language Support (English, French, German, Spanish, Dutch, Italian, Swedish, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Russian and Polish.) (*3)
Notes:
*1: A firmware update for your Marantz product is may be needed, please update the firmware via the system setup menu. (General > Firmware)　If the App doesn't work well, please try to reboot your mobile device, unplug the power cord of the main unit and reinsert into the power outlet or check your home network.
*2: Please set "Network Control" to "ON" in your product via the system setup menu to use this app. (Network > Network Control)
*3: The OS language setting is automatically detected; when not available, English is selected.

bluejetty:00023153:ios.description:
Sleep better and start the day with your favorite tunes. Are you curious to see how much you slept? Then, track your sleep in the app. 
Alarm Clock HD is the app to help you enjoy restful sleep and wake up worry-free. 
How Alarm Clock HD helps you sleep better:
• Unlimited Alarms: Apple Music or Alarm Sounds
• Customize Nightstand display colors
• Sleep Timer
• Local Weather Information
• Instant Flashlight - shake the device
• Full watchOS 2 support
• Screen Saver - for devices with OLED display
WAKE UP ON TIME: Proper Alarm Settings
• Keep the app open and running always to have your alarm go off and play the sounds you’ve set for ‘Music'.
When your app is open, you can use the volume slider within the app. When the app is in the background, use the device volume to set your volume.
• Make sure your battery is charged and have your notifications turned on before you go to sleep, when the battery level goes below 30% it might not sound. This is due to prevent the device from dying and the alarm not going off.
• Keep your Apple Music available on your device
The music you can select consists of everything you have available on your ‘Apple Music' app on your device. If the music is saved on your iCloud, and not on the device itself, it won’t be available.
NEVER MISS AN ALARM
When you close the app and do not have it running in the background, the alarm will use the device volume instead and play the notification sound system.
The app will close itself automatically after 10 hours of inactivity. This is due to prevent the device from dying and the alarm not going off.
When your device is muted, set to ‘Do Not Disturb’, or your device volume is set to 0, the alarm won’t play properly. It will still show the notification without any sound. This is due to Apple’s restrictions as we are unable to access the app settings when the app is closed, only when it’s open or running in the background.

bluejetty:00087143:ios.description:
FaceVibe turns every selfie into your best photo. This face app and body editor blends retouch, makeup, hairstyle, body shape, and teeth whitening into one beauty studio.
FACE RETOUCH & PORTRAIT EDITOR
Smooth skin with the airbrush and blemish remover, clear acne with the acne remover and pimple remover, and erase red eye with the red eye corrector. Reshape your face with the nose editor, jaw and cheek slimmer, and double chin remover, or fine-tune face symmetry with the face shape detector for balanced, natural results. Brighten dull skin with the glow up filter, retouch full-body portraits with the body and face editor, or run a quick face touch up on any selfie. The face scan, face AI, face rating, and face shape analyzer study your portrait and suggest the retouch that fits, while the skin editor and selfie editor keep every shot camera-ready. Explore beauty filters that pretty up your photos in seconds, retouch photos in one tap, then compare before and after with a tap. Every photo retouch runs on the FaceVibe ai retouch engine, so edits stay natural instead of overdone.
MAKEUP EDITOR
Try on a full AI makeup look without a mirror. The makeup editor layers foundation, blush, contour, lipstick, eyeliner, mascara, and eye shadow onto your photo with realistic blending, and the eye color changer lets you mix an eye color combination instantly. Pair makeup filters for everyday wear or a bold night-out look, then save your favorite make up combination to reuse across every photo.
HAIRSTYLE & HAIR COLOR CHANGER
Style your hair before you ever pick up scissors — no trip to the hair salon required. The hairstyle try on tool previews haircuts and colors on your own photo, the AI hair color changer swaps shades from natural browns to vivid pastels, and hair filters cover curly hair, short hair filter looks, buzz cut filter styles, hair cut filter, and long styles. Preview facial hair with the beard filter or clean it up with the no beard filter, style curly or thinning hair with a tap, and let the hair scan recommend a look built around your face shape. Style my hair however I like, from a classic cut to a bold color change.
BODY SHAPE & BODY TUNE
Adjust your figure with the body editor and body tune tools — slim the waist, reshape curves, and enhance your silhouette while the background stays untouched. The body shape editor and ai body editor let you make yourself thinner or fuller, sculpt the shape body you want, and fine-tune proportions with the body enhancer and body shaper. Edit body proportions and refine your body editing with the same ai face editor precision behind every retouch, so results never look forced.
AI ABS & MUSCLE FILTER
Add natural-looking definition with the AI muscle filter and abs editor. Sculpt a six pack, tone the midsection, and enhance muscle definition in body photos while keeping skin texture and lighting realistic.
HEIGHT ENHANCER
Look taller in every photo with the height enhancer. FaceVibe stretches body proportions carefully so you gain height without distorting your frame, ideal for portraits, fashion shots, and social posts.
TEETH WHITENING
Finish with a brighter smile. Whiten teeth in one tap with the teeth whitener and tooth whitener, the smile editor cleans up minor imperfections, and the teeth brightener gets you a natural, camera-ready white smile.
WHY FACEVIBE
Every tool lives in one face editor app and body editor — no need to juggle a separate makeup editor, hairstyle app, or teeth whitener. Results are designed to look like you, only polished — not filtered beyond recognition. Whether you want a quick retouch, a hairstyle try on, a slimmer body shape, defined abs, extra height, or a whiter smile, FaceVibe keeps every beauty tool in one editor. Download FaceVibe and start your first retouch today.

bluejetty:00062944:ios.description:
The angels see what your heart cannot, and they share it with love.
Love Angel Cards is an angel card deck devoted entirely to love and relationships. Every card shows an Angel and its gift, so the deck feels gentle, luminous and protective. Whether you are single and searching, thinking of someone special, in a relationship or healing after a breakup, the angels have a message for you.
YOUR PERSONAL CARDS
No other card reading app puts the two of you on the cards. Add your photo and name, and your partner's, and above every reading you'll see your card, their card and the card of your relationship. Each one opens a zodiac reading: who you are in love, who they are, and what your two signs make together, read aloud by the angels. Single? Meet the sign of your ideal match. Healing? Your past partner's card shows what to keep and how to let go.
THE ANGELS SPEAK
After each spread, choose a love topic (Their feelings, Our future, Finding love, Self-love, Healing a breakup, Trust & communication and more) and receive a personal interpretation of your whole reading. The card artwork comes alive while a soothing voice reads the message to you, sentence by sentence, naming you and the person on your heart.
YOUR DAILY ALIGNMENT
A love card waits for you every morning. Draw your Love Card of the Day, see today's moon phase read for the heart, and hear the angels' message for you and your person. Each day brings three new yes-or-no questions written for your situation, like "Is he thinking of me?" or "Should I reach out first?", one tap away from an answer.
22 LOVE SPREADS
From a single card to a thirteen-card portrait of a relationship:
• Daily Guidance: Love Card of the Day, Yes or No?, Week of Love, Month of Love
• New Sparks: Sweet Flirtation, Searching for Love, A New Romance, Ready for Love? and more
• Together: The Mirror, Plan of the Heart, The Relationship and more
• Soul & Destiny: Soulmate Spread, Love & Karma, Celtic Cross of Love and more
• Healing Hearts: Rekindling an Old Flame, Is It Too Late for Us?
Every position explains what it reveals.
YES OR NO?
Ask your question, draw three cards and the angels answer, always with a gentle word on what to do next.
LEARN
The full meaning of all 32 angel cards, 76 symbols and 155 card combinations.
JOURNAL
Every reading is saved exactly as you drew it, with its cards, insights and your private notes, so you can revisit the story of your heart by date.
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your profile and photos stay on your device.
Available in 14 languages.
SUBSCRIPTION REQUIRED
Love Angel Cards requires a subscription. It unlocks everything: all 22 spreads, narrated insights, your personal cards and zodiac readings, Your Daily Alignment, Yes or No?, Learn and the Journal. Choose a weekly, monthly or yearly subscription, or a one-time lifetime purchase. New users can start with a free trial.
• Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm your purchase.

bluejetty:00152315:ios.description:
Scale For Grams is an AI-powered tool that gives approximate weight, length and count estimates from a photo.
Take a picture or upload an image, and the AI analyzes visual details such as object type, size and context to generate an estimate within seconds.
Results are estimates only and may vary with image quality, object type and surroundings. This app is not a real scale and does not provide precise measurements. For general informational use only, not for medical, dosing or commercial purposes.
FEATURES
 - AI Photo Analysis – Estimate weight, length or count from a single photo
 - Recipe Mode – Check your ingredient amounts step by step against your recipe
 - Metric & Imperial – Grams, kilograms, ounces and pounds
 - Analysis History – Review your previous estimates
 - Quick & Easy – No setup or extra equipment needed
HOW IT WORKS
 1. Take a photo of an object
 2. The AI analyzes the image
 3. View your estimate
Photos are sent to a third-party AI service (OpenAI) to generate the estimate, and only after you give your permission. You can withdraw it anytime in Settings.

bluejetty:00022606:ios.description:
Book flights, reserve seats and access your digital boarding passes. With the SWISS app, your mobile travel companion for journeys with the Lufthansa Group network airlines, you can do all this and more.
Push notifications will inform you of your flight’s status in real time, so you are kept up to date throughout your journey.
With the SWISS app you are always well informed, from booking your flight to the arrival of your baggage at your destination so you can rest assured that your journey will run smoothly. Your personal data and personalized services can all be conveniently managed on your smartphone.
In short, the SWISS app ensures you are well informed about all aspects of your flight.
The main features of the SWISS app:
Before your flight
• Book your flight, reserve your seat and add your baggage: All this can be done conveniently in the app. You can also book a rental car or reserve or change your seat on the plane if you need to. With the app, you also have the option to add additional baggage.
• Online check-in: Use the SWISS app to check in with ease for all flights operated by Lufthansa Group Network Airlines. Your digital flight ticket will be sent directly to your smartphone. Use the app to show your mobile boarding pass at the airport.
• Travel ID and SWISS Miles and More: You now have the option of adding several payment methods to your Travel ID account so you can pay seamlessly and easily anytime and anywhere. To log in, use your Travel ID or SWISS Miles & More login credentials. Enter your personal data and personalized services to adapt the SWISS app to your needs.
• Real-time information and flight status: In the 24 hours before your flight, your personal travel assistant will inform you of all important updates about your trip. Push notifications will appear on your home screen, so you always know when it’s time to check in or if there have been any gate changes. This way you always have an overview of your flight and the most current information.
During the flight
• Flight ticket and on-board services: With the SWISS app, you always have your mobile boarding pass and on-board services in your pocket, even during the flight and when you’re offline. This means you receive important flight information when you need it, ensuring that any changes to your flight don’t come as a surprise.
After the flight
• Track your baggage: Your digital travel companion is also there to lend a helping hand after landing. You can easily track your checked baggage in the SWISS app so you can arrive relaxed at your destination.
With the SWISS app, you can enjoy a carefree journey. From booking your flights and rental cars to receiving automatic information and updates on the day of travel, the smartphone app is your handy travel companion. You can also manage your personal data while on the go.
Download the SWISS app now and enjoy your flight! Your personal travel assistant is there for you before, during and after your journey.
Find out about our flight offers at swiss.com and follow us on Instagram, Facebook, YouTube and X to stay up to date.
If you have any questions or require support, please do not hesitate to get in touch. You can contact us at https://www.swiss.com/ch/en/customer-support/faq.

bluejetty:00026291:ios.summary:
Yoink for iPad and iPhone lets you easily and quickly store items you drag, copy, share or download for later use.
This way, you can collect items in a central place without having to constantly move back and forth between your source- and
bluejetty:00026291:ios.description:
Yoink for iPad and iPhone lets you easily and quickly store items you drag, copy, share or download for later use.
This way, you can collect items in a central place without having to constantly move back and forth between your source- and destination applications.
The app accepts virtually any file type, for example app-content like images from websites, text snippets, web urls, eMails and documents - no matter if you drag, copy, share or download them.
Here's what users say about Yoink:
"The best shelf app on iOS" - Igloouk, UK App Store
"Most useful app in the iOS store. What a gem." - noway170, Austrian App Store
"A godsend. Get this. Now." - mr chairboy, US App Store
As a Slide-Over or Side-by-Side app on iPad, Yoink is always ready for you to drag something to it, no matter what app you're in. Just slide Yoink into view and conclude your drag operation.
On iPhone, use Yoink's Share extension, or copy-paste items into Yoink.
Items are stored in Yoink for later use, featuring rich previews for easy identification and full previews for most file types.
Drags containing multiple items are combined into a Stack.
Yoink comes with deep system integration:
- Clipboard Monitor:
Yoink's clipboard monitor saves everything you copy or cut, even when Yoink itself is in the background.
Use the Picture-in-Picture overlay to select what type of data Yoink should save, as well as to pause or stop it at any time.
- Picture-in-Picture for more than just videos:
Among others, Yoink can show pictures, PDFs, eMails and even websites in the Picture-in-Picture overlay, and lets you scroll through pages of documents right there.
- iCloud Sync
Synchronize Yoink's items across your devices using iCloud
- Handoff
Transfer files between iPhones, iPads and Macs (separate Mac Yoink app required) using Handoff
- Action/Share Extension
Almost any item you can share via the system-wide Share sheet, you can send directly to Yoink from there
- Keyboard
Yoink has its own keyboard so that inserting items you've stored in Yoink is easy and quick, without having to launch Yoink.
- Spotlight Integration
Any item in Yoink can be found via Spotlight - and the search-results are draggable.
- Today Widget
Access Yoink's items and save the contents from your clipboard in Yoink from Notification Center
- Shortcuts / Siri Suggestions
Yoink offers you Siri Shortcuts and Suggestions so you can automate processes, like adding items from the clipboard to Yoink, or copying items from Yoink, as well as starting downloads in Yoink.
- Files Integration
Access Yoink's files from any app that supports iOS 11's document browser
Here's what the press says about Yoink:
"Yoink is the shelf app Apple should have made." - Federico Viticci, MacStories.net
"Yoink is a must-have app" - Jeff Benjamin; 9to5mac.com
"Indispensable for power users." - Craig Grannell; techradar.com

bluejetty:00174666:ios.description:
Hi, I'm Steven Musumeche, a resident of Lafayette, LA and avid saltwater fisherman. I created Salty Solutions to answer a question that I'm always asking myself:
When should I go fishing?
Like most of you, I have a limited amount of time that I can devote to fishing. When I plan my next fishing trip, I want to make sure the conditions are conducive to a productive day on the water.
There are lots of great websites and apps available with information about weather, tides, and more. However, none of them gave me everything that I wanted to know in a way that could be quickly viewed and easily digested.
I'm a software engineer by trade, so I thought, "hey, I can make something decent enough for personal use." After showing it to a few fellow fisherman, I decided to release it publicly for anyone to use for free.
I hope you find it useful.

I'm a software engineer by trade, so I thought, "hey, I can make something decent enough for personal use." After showing it to a few fellow fisherman, I decided to release it publicly for anyone to use for free.

I hope you find it useful.

bluejetty:00150442:ios.description:

With the myORCA app, you can:
- Load fares instantly
- Check your balance
- Purchase and manage multiple ORCA cards
- Purchase daily or monthly passes
- Set up autoloads
- And much more!
With ORCA, you can pay for trips and transfers on Community Transit, Everett Transit, King County Metro, Kitsap Transit, Pierce Transit, Sound Transit and Washington State Ferries. Some exclusions apply on special trips and Washington State Ferries.
To use ORCA, be sure to tap your card on the ORCA card reader on board, on the train platform, or at your stop.
Reduced fare programs are available to qualified riders with low incomes, seniors (65+ years), youth (6-18 years), and persons with disabilities. Reduced fare cards work with the myORCA app, call 888-988-6722 / TTY: 711 to find out which card is right for you.
This app requires iOS 13 and above.

bluejetty:00073098:ios.description:
Roll the windows down and cruise along an astonishing island roadway with this self-guided driving tour of the Florida Keys, from Key Largo all the way to Key West!
Florida Keys (Key Largo to Key West):
Let the Florida Keys take your breath away! Cruise from Key Largo to Key West and catch all the stunning sights in between. Uncover the history behind the Keys, including President Truman’s “winter White House” and the story of the man with the seemingly impossible dream of connecting all the islands.
Marvel at the unbelievable diversity of life along the keys, from wild flocks of flamingos to the lush tropical flora to America’s only living coral reef, host to over 1,400 species of plants and animals! Walk along pristine beaches and take a dip in the wonderfully warm waters of the Atlantic. Then cross the famously beautiful Seven Mile Bridge and take in the unblemished vastness of the ocean.
Finally, catch a sunset unlike any other on Key West, where locals celebrate the sinking sun with magicians, musicians, and more! Don’t forget to grab an unforgettable meal from a street vendor as you watch the orange sun melt into the ocean.
Featuring riveting stories, an engaging narrator, and easy automatic audio, this app puts exploration in the palm of your hand!
This comprehensive tour includes all this and more:
■ Key Largo
■ The African Queen
■ Hurricanes of the Keys
■ Plantation Key
■ Big Betsy, the Giant Lobster
■ Theatre of the Sea
■ The Purple Isle, IslaMorada
■ Anne’s Beach
■ Long Key
■ The Hurricane of 1935
■ Dolphins of the Keys
■ Marathon
■ Turtles of the Keys
■ Seven Mile Bridge
■ Pigeon Key
■ Fred the Tree
■ Deer of the Keys
■ Geiger Beach
■ Key West
■ Mallory Square
■ Truman’s Little White House
■ The Ernest Hemingway Home and Museum
■ Key West Lighthouse
■ Tennessee Williams Museum
■ Southernmost Point of the Continental US
HOW IT WORKS:
As you travel, audio stories play automatically based on your location. Simply go to the starting point of the tour and begin following the given route. Each story begins playing on its own, usually just before you reach a point of interest.
TOUR FEATURES:
▶ Freedom of travel
No scheduled tour times, no crowded buses, and no rush to keep moving past stops that interest you. You have total freedom to skip ahead, linger, and take as many photos as you’d like.
▶ Automatic play
No muss, no fuss. Just follow the app’s built-in route to all the must-visit spots — the audio stories about everything you see will play automatically!
▶ Works offline
Download the tour in advance and then use it seamlessly, even in areas with no service!
▶ Lifetime purchase
No monthly subscription. No time limits. No usage limits. Enjoy this tour as many times as you like.
▶ Incredible stories
Immerse yourself in the history, culture, and secrets of this famous site with the help of a top-tier narrator and fascinating stories written by experts.
▶ Award-winning app
Featured on Thrillist and WBZ, this easy-to-use app won the Laurel Award for Technology from the Newport Mansions, who use the app for over a million tours per year.
FREE DEMO:
Check out the free demo to get an idea of what this tour is all about. If you like it, purchase the tour to get full access to all of the stories.
QUICK TIPS:
■ Download ahead of time, over data or WiFi.
■ Be sure the phone battery is fully charged, or take an external battery pack.
NEW TOURS ADDED!
■ Florida Bundle
■ Everglades & Big Cypress National Preserve

bluejetty:00071575:ios.summary:

Whether you’re chasing golden hour* or keeping an eye
bluejetty:00071575:ios.description:
Lumy is a modern sun tracker + outdoor activity planner.
- Perfect lighting for photos or videos? Done.
- Sunrise hike or sunset walk? Easy.
- Outdoor yoga or sunlight breaks? Covered.
Whether you’re chasing golden hour* or keeping an eye on moon phases for a night under the stars, Lumy helps you make the most of natural light.
Now redesigned from the ground up - Lumy feels more personal, purposeful, and in sync with how we live. 
Introducing Modes: Switch between profiles like Daily, Photography, or Meditation to shape Lumy around your routine. See only what matters to you.
Lumy also supports iOS’s State of Mind feature, offering sunlight suggestions based on your mood entries in the Health app - a gentle nudge to step out and connect with nature.
And with weather forecasts for the next seven days, you can plan with confidence. Lumy calculates all sun and moon data entirely on-device. No tracking. No server calls. Only the weather needs internet.
Lumy works seamlessly across iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, Apple TV, and HomePod. One purchase, full family access.
Features
- Modes: Switch profiles based on your needs... from weekday planning to weekend golden hour.
- Sun + Moon Tracking: Accurate data, solar compass, and future predictions.
- Season Info: Both astronomical and meteorological seasons.
- Remainders: Custom repeatable notifications.
- Apple Watch: Complications, Double-tap, and Live Activities.
- Widgets + Control Center: Quick access via Smart Stack and more.
- Interaction Upgrades: Time travel slider, Quick Access Button, fluid animations.
- Visual Feel: Simulated light, shimmering glows, and enhanced Classic visuals.
- Accessibility: VoiceOver, Dynamic Type, Reduce Motion, and more.
- Privacy First: Fully offline (except weather). Your data stays with you.
- Localization: Available in Japanese, Chinese, French, and German.
Lumy helps photographers, outdoor lovers, and wellness seekers stay in sync with the sun and moon.
*What's Golden Hour?
Golden Hour (or Magic Hour) is the short time after sunrise or before sunset when the light is soft, warm, and perfect for capturing stunning photos or videos.
Sun Information Available:
Sunrise, Sunset, First Light, Last Light, Golden Hour, Blue Hour, Astronomical Twilight, Nautical Twilight, Civil Twilight, Solar Noon, Solar Midnight.
Moon Information Available:
Moonrise, Moonset, Altitude, Azimuth, Transit, Transit Elevation, Weekly Moon Phase, Next Full Moon, New Moon, First Quarter, Last Quarter.
Got feedback or suggestions? We’d love to hear from you! Reach out at hello@waplestuff.com.

bluejetty:00016832:ios.description:

Explore cachoeiras, trilhas, cânions, mirantes e destinos incríveis em um só lugar. O Viajantes App conecta viajantes aos melhores destinos de natureza do Brasil com informações completas, roteiros estratégicos e experiências reais de quem vive na estrada.
Termos de Uso: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Criado por um casal apaixonado por natureza, o aplicativo nasceu para ajudar viajantes a explorarem o Brasil com mais segurança, autonomia e praticidade.
NO VIAJANTES APP VOCÊ ENCONTRA:
* Cachoeiras, trilhas, poços, cânions e mirantes
* Hospedagens, chalés, campings e restaurantes
* Guias locais, passeios e experiências
* Pacotes de viagem
* Roteiros prontos
* Comunidade de ecoturismo integrada
INFORMAÇÕES COMPLETAS PARA SUA VIAGEM
Descubra tudo antes de chegar ao destino:
* Fotos e vídeos reais
* Nível da trilha
* Distância e tempo médio de caminhada
* Tipo de acesso (carro comum ou 4x4)
* Valores atualizados
* Estrutura disponível
* Contatos e localização
* Locais pet friendly
* Informações sobre acessibilidade
HOSPEDAGENS E GASTRONOMIA
Encontre pousadas, hotéis, chalés, campings, restaurantes e cafés próximos aos atrativos turísticos. Tudo com contato direto e sem intermediários.
ROTEIROS PRONTOS
Os roteiros são criados por quem realmente conhece cada destino, organizando a viagem de forma estratégica para você aproveitar mais e perder menos tempo.
Descubra:
* O que fazer em cada dia
* Melhor sequência dos atrativos
* Onde se hospedar e comer
* Dicas importantes da região
* Experiências diferenciadas
PACOTES DE VIAGEM
Planeje sua viagem com mais tranquilidade através de pacotes completos para diversos destinos de natureza.
COMUNIDADE DE ECOTURISMO
O Viajantes App também é uma rede social para quem ama natureza e aventura.
* Compartilhe fotos e relatos
* Descubra novos destinos
* Interaja com outros viajantes
* Converse pelo chat
* Mostre os lugares que você já explorou

Conheça pessoas com os mesmos interesses em viagens, natureza e aventura. O ViajaMatch ajuda você a criar conexões e encontrar parceiros de viagem.
Se você ama cachoeiras, trilhas, camping, road trips e experiências ao ar livre, o Viajantes App é para você.
Baixe agora e comece a explorar o Brasil de um jeito totalmente novo.

bluejetty:00091447:ios.description:
This app provides you with the latest Mega Millions and Powerball information, including upcoming and past Jackpot numbers, winning amounts, payouts, etc. It helps you manage, organize, and track your favorite numbers and lottery tickets, and provides you with drawing videos.
It uses AI to accurately recognize Mega Millions and Powerball ticket numbers, identify the lottery type, keep track of draw dates, and monitor your winnings in multiple states.

bluejetty:00160503:ios.description:
A HEAD TO HEAD FURR-BATTLE
64 pets. 6 rounds of voting. 1 winner.
Grand Prize: $100 Amazon Gift Card
WIN GIFT CARDS WITH YOUR CUTE PET PHOTOS
Enter your pet to battle head-to-head against 64 other cuties. Vote on the Pet Parade App for hours of furry fun!
EARN GIFT CARDS, DOG FOOD, TREATS, AND PET SUPPLIES
Enter your cutest cat photos, dog pics or other pet photos to compete in live cute pet pic tournaments with other pet lovers to win gift cards for pet supplies from Chewy, Amazon, Petsmart, Pet Supplies Plus and Petco. Play fun dog games with your dog or cat games with your cat! Win prize tickets by submitting cute dog pics and cat photos. Whenever your puppy dog or cute cat wins a game, you unlock prize tickets which you can use to purchase dog food, cat treats and other pet supplies.
UPLOAD & SHARE YOUR CUTEST CAT & DOG PET PICS
Share your cutest dog pics, cat pictures and pet photos with the fastest growing pet photo social network for pet parents & lovers in the world. It’s just like social media for your pet! Discover your cuteness score and then post your cute pet pics to Shutterfly. Or use our fun stickers to create a new photo wallpaper of your beloved dog, cat and other pets. Upload cute cat pictures and dog photos for a chance to win gift cards to Chewy, Amazon or Petco!
VOTE ON PET PICS TO EARN COINS
Earn coins by voting for other people’s dogs, cats & cute pet pics, create your own pet pics match-ups and join live pet tournaments and competitions. Increase your pet’s cuteness score by posting cute pictures of your dog, cat or other pet. Don’t keep the dog and cat cuteness contained to your phone – create collages on Shutterfly! Easily export your dog pictures or cat photos to Shutterfly. Keep voting on other pet photos to earn gold coins to enter tournaments and win gift cards from Chewy, Amazon, Petsmart and Petco.
TAKE THE PET PARADE CUTENESS CHALLENGE
Want to know how cute your pet's photos and video are? Create a Cuteness Challenge to face off head-to-head against another dog, cat or pet. See your votes and treats tally up live as other Pet Parade parents vote for your pet. Create a photo collage, dog wallpaper, or cat screensaver of your cutest pet photo moments. Post your cutest pet photos to social media and shutterfly to share and print your cutest dog and cat memories. Not sure if your pet’s pics are cute? Pet Parade is the ultimate cuteness test (and a great way to win toys and treats from Chewy, Amazon and Petco!).
COMPETE IN LIVE CUTENESS TOURNAMENTS
Enter a live pet cuteness picture Tournament to battle against cute cats and dogs in themed photo competitions grouped by Level, Pet Type, and minimum Cuteness Score requirements. Play dog or cat games with your dog or cat. Is your dog, cat or other pet cute enough to make it to the Final Round? Find out in these single elimination style bracket pic tourneys where the winning pet pics of each round win prize tickets to spend in the Pet Parade store – win prizes from Petco, Chewy, Petsmart & more.
LEVEL UP TO UNLOCK PRIZES & GIFT CARDS
Collect points whenever your cute pet wins a face off or gets a virtual treat. Level up to unlock special prizes, coupons, savings, and gift cards from Petco, Chewy, and Amazon. Compete in higher level competitions to boost your pet cuteness rankings. Highlight your pet photos in photoshop, post to social media and Shutterfly and create fun mixtiles.
WIN REAL PET PRIZES & SAVINGS
Save and redeem your prize tickets to unlock gift cards from Petco & Chewy. Join thousands of cutest pet photo winners every day who redeem their prize tickets for exclusive savings on pet food, dog treats, dog collars and leashes and cat bowls.
- Follow us on Facebook at http://www.facebook.com/petparadegame
- Have a question or problem using the app? Visit https://play.parade.pet/ for our user guide.

bluejetty:00068338:ios.name: Calisthenics Coachy
bluejetty:00068338:ios.summary: Coachy is your intelligent training partner for every workout - whether you’re into WOD, kettlebell routines, calisthenics, HIIT, suspension training, or bodyweight workouts. Customize or generate workouts tailored to your equipment and goa
bluejetty:00068338:ios.description:
Coachy is your intelligent training partner for every workout - whether you’re into WOD, kettlebell routines, calisthenics, HIIT, suspension training, or bodyweight workouts. Customize or generate workouts tailored to your equipment and goals, enhanced with our intuitive workout timer and AI generator. Experience immersive training with Augmented Reality, watching Coachy demonstrate exercises in 3D and AR modes.
WHY COACHY?
Coachy delivers personalized daily routines based on your fitness level, goals, available equipment (like kettlebells and suspension trainers), and feedback from previous sessions. Whether you prefer WODs, HIIT, or calisthenics, Coachy’s AI adapts to your progress. Choose from pre-made workouts or build your own with flexible customization options. Enhance your workout with seamless Apple Music integration directly within the app.
WORKOUTS:
 • Daily Workouts: Receive a personalized workout each day, featuring WODs, kettlebell training, calisthenics, HIIT, suspension training, and bodyweight exercises. Provide feedback to help Coachy adjust future workouts.
 • Pre-made Workouts: Browse Coachy’s extensive library, including specialized routines for kettlebells, HIIT, suspension training, and more, available in four difficulty levels.
 • Custom Workouts: Create your own workouts from scratch, incorporating bodyweight exercises, kettlebells, suspension training, and other modalities.
 • Workout Generator: Utilize our powerful tool to generate workouts with over 20,000 configuration options, including WODs, HIIT, calisthenics, and more.
 • Fully Customizable: Modify, add, or reorder exercises, adjust rounds, and set rest durations between exercises and rounds.
 • Guided Sessions: All workouts are guided by Coachy, ensuring an effective training experience whether doing AI workouts, bodyweight routines, or kettlebell exercises.
 • Warm-up & Cool-down: Start with a warm-up and finish with a tailored cool-down for each session.
 • SharePlay: Workout together with friends and family via SharePlay on FaceTime for a shared training experience.
 • Screen Mirroring: Mirror your active workout to any external display or TV with an optimized UI.
 • Live Activities
EXERCISES:
 • Explore nearly 200 exercises, including kettlebell moves, suspension training, calisthenics, and bodyweight workouts.
 • View exercises and equipment in Augmented Reality with step-by-step instructions.
 • Customize Coachy’s appearance to match your style.
PROGRESS:
 • Set weekly workout goals across various training types like HIIT, calisthenics, and suspension training.
 • Track your workout history with detailed charts and a calendar.
 • Monitor your weekly goals with convenient widgets.
SHORTCUTS:
 • Start workout
 • Next exercise
 • Show workout weather
 • Show weekly summary
 • SharePlay workout
WEATHER:
 • Get weather data and sportswear recommendations based on your workout type.
 • Available for Home & Lock Screen widgets.
On watchOS:
 • Enhance your workout with the watchOS version, displaying current exercises, workout time, heart rate, and calories burned on your wrist.
 • Track weekly goals with complications.
Coachy syncs workout lengths with Apple Health. If you use Coachy on watchOS, your BPM and calories burned are also saved to Apple Health. The app supports dark and light modes, and all workouts and histories are saved on your device and iCloud if enabled.
Coachy Premium:
Unlock all workouts, including specialized WODs, kettlebell routines, HIIT sessions, suspension training, and unlimited custom workouts with Coachy Premium. Enjoy a 7-day free trial and subscribe monthly or yearly. Share Coachy Premium with family through Premium Family plans.
Privacy Policy & Terms: http://viktormaric.com/coachy-privacy-terms

bluejetty:00146386:ios.description:
Kindred is a members-only home swapping network that harnesses the power of a trusted community to unlock a lifestyle rich with travel and human connection. By exchanging homes and apartments with peers, both renters and owners alike can access the opportunity to travel between homes across North America and Europe.
HOW IT WORKS
Using Kindred is simple: you give a night to get a night. Members can swap homes 1-for-1, or book stays with credits earned by hosting others. For each night you host a member, you receive a credit to book a stay of your own at any Kindred home.
Once booked, your Kindred concierge takes care of all of logistics to make hosting and staying a breeze - from professional cleaning, to providing access to our members-only hosting essentials marketplace - so you can focus on enjoying your trip.
HOW TO JOIN
We are accepting applications at https://livekindred.com.
FEEDBACK
We’d love your feedback as we build this product and community! Please reach out to hello@livekindred.com with any questions or feedback.

bluejetty:00077381:ios.description:
You open an app for “just a minute.” Then you look up, and much more time has passed.
XLocker helps you create a little distance from the apps that easily pull you in, so you can give more time to the things you care about: work, study, reading, family, rest, or simply being present.
Choose the apps you want to manage, then decide what works for you:
• Lock selected apps when you want a clearer boundary
• Hide selected apps to reduce visual distractions
• Set a daily protection goal of 30 minutes, 1 hour, or no fixed goal
• Follow your own pace instead of chasing perfection
• Keep a record of the time you set aside and see your effort build over time
You do not need to change everything at once. Start with one app. Start with half an hour. Or start without a target at all.
Every time you choose to stay with what matters, you are making space for the life you want to live.
From this moment, leave a little more time for yourself.
XLocker is designed to help reduce app-related distractions. It does not guarantee reduced screen time, increased productivity, or any particular result. Features may vary depending on your device and Screen Time permissions.

bluejetty:00098082:ios.description:
Brain Prank Puzzle Party – The Ultimate Brainly Teaser Game!
Welcome to Brain Prank Puzzle Party – the most unpredictable, brainy, and laugh-out-loud puzzle experience you’ll ever play. This isn’t just a game — it’s a full-blown brainly journey filled with tricky puzzles, confusing riddles, irritating challenges, and nonstop chaos that will keep your mind teasing, your logic twisting, and your friends completely annoyed.
Get ready to dive into a world packed with tricky brainly scenarios and levels that throw logic out the window. Whether you're a classic prankster, a fan of brainy puzzles, or someone who simply loves annoying brain challenges that don’t make sense — this game was made for you.
From flashback tricky fun riddles to flakey twist challenges, each stage is more bizarre and entertaining than the last. With unexpected results, strange humor, and a fair dose of frustration, you’ll either laugh, scratch your head, or toss your phone (in a good way).
 What’s Inside the Chaos?
 Tricky Puzzle Challenges
Every level is filled with tricky puzzles, wild scenarios, and brainly teasers that make you think harder (or dumber). Use creativity, randomness, and sometimes total nonsense to solve the puzzle tricky madness.
 Brainly Teasers & Training
Push your limits and train brainly as you go through a brain brainly workout of ridiculous decisions, twisted logic, and impossible problem-solving. You’re not just playing — you're doing mental gymnastics.
 Laugh, Troll, and Annoy
Feel like a real prankster as you annoy your friends with outrageous levels. Whether you're trapped in a tricky twister, falling into a trick puzzle, or solving a teaser brainly, you’re in for endless surprises.
 Think Inside, Outside, and Around the Box
No solution is ever obvious. To solve tricky stages, you’ll need to challenge expectations, break logic, and embrace nonsense. This is full-on box-breaking fun.
 Story, Chaos, and Pranks
Every level unfolds an amusing plot, weird interactions, and annoying side quests. Encounter genet interstate, battle through difficulty bothersome puzzles, and laugh your way to the next mess.
 Global Flavor, Strange Worlds
From reshelve la raza, you'll explore multicultural humor, quirky puzzles, and international nonsense, topped off with a creepy vibe and strange mini-tales.
 Play Anytime – No Wi-Fi Needed

-Update your contact information
