The app works with:
- All NTAG I2C Plus 2K NFC tags and d
bluejetty:00177529:ios.description:
Amiibox is the best Amiibo collection app with the ability to add amiibo to your collection by simply scanning their NFC tags and writing those amiibo to different kind of NFC tags.
The app works with:
- All NTAG I2C Plus 2K NFC tags and devices
- All NTAG215 NFC tags
- Flashiibo
- PowerTags
- N2 Elite Tags
- Other generic NFC reading/writing devices
so you can quickly restore your backups easely. 
You can also import your own .bin files if you prefer to keep your amiibo sealed. 
BEWARE OF CLONE APPS: Amiibox is the leading Amiibo writing app and there are clone apps that copy our design and description. Their functionality is far from what Amiibox offers so make sure you pick the original app for the best experience!
The app works with all amiibo ever released, including such series as Splatoon, Animal Crossing, Mario, Metroid, Legend of Zelda, Pokemon etc. Please note that the recently released Kirby Air Riders and newer amiibos require NTAG I2C Plus 2K based tags or devices
Keep in mind that Amiibox will always support every single amiibo released without updating the app - just like magic!
Features:
• Superior, beautiful and user-friendly interface
• Mac, iPad, Apple Watch, Apple TV and Vision Pro apps to browse the whole Amiibo collection whenever you want
• Owned collection with the ability to add new amiibo by scanning their NFC tags or importing amiibo from files
• Get details like release date, unique id, collection and more from any amiibo
• Learn about each amiibo benefits and usage in game
• Global amiibo search
• Add amiibo you are hunting for to your wishlist
• Easy to use with NO ads or annoying pop-ups
• Dark mode and support for Dark/Tinted Icons
• iCloud Sync support for Favorite and Wishlist amiibo
• Full offline support
• Game Center Achievements
Amiibox is built with privacy in mind. That means that no data is sent to developers or any other third party*. Amiibox does not send any amiibo data anywhere. Amiibox does not have any tracking tools in the app. All your amiibo data is stored privately on your device and only you have access to it. 
Note: Most iPads do not have a NFC chip so you can only browse the Amiibo collection on those iPads.
(*) Valid unless you choose to view ads to earn credits in which case a unique identifier is being send to Google.

Terms of Service: https://amiibox.app/tos/
Privacy Policy: https://amiibox.app/privacy-policy/

Amiibox is an unofficial app for collectors and fans of amiibo and is intended only to be used for informational and educational purposes.

bluejetty:00185302:ios.description:
Join Kid-E-Cats in their new adventure – a Circus Show! Print out some posters announcing the show, choose a friend to come with you and hop on the train that will take you to the circus field. 
Be careful on your way and help the kitten overcome all obstacles that might appear on the road.
Well now, are you ready for the performance? Let’s get started!
JUGGLE
Choose the objects you will be juggling. Be attentive to sort out the unnecessary items. What would you choose to juggle – balls, skittles or may be cactuses or fish bones?
JUMP THROUGH A FIRE RING
Scared? Don’t be, it’s going to be fun. Jump some objects over while riding your bicycle and whenever you see a fire ring, jump through it. Be ready to fix your bike when it gets broken. Yes, you are going to be that busy!
BALANCE
Try to keep balance while being a real tightrope walker! Swipe to the left or to the right to help the kitten not to fall down.
MAGIC TRICKS
That’s the reason why we all come to the circus, right? Today you will make the magic transformations by turning some routine objects into something really wonderful!
STRONGMEN
Show everyone how strong you are! Assemble a barbell and then lift it up! 
TRAMPOLINE
Keep the kitten jump as high as possible and move the trampoline so that the kitten doesn't fall!
- Six engaging mini-games that can be replayed!
- Seven funny kitten friends to take with you
- 6 different reactions to use during the show
The game is appropriate for even the youngest players - the interface is easy to understand and there are always prompts and tips to make the game process interesting and engaging! So the parents can really relax for a while when their kids are busy at "Kid-E-Cats: Circus Show"!

bluejetty:00118725:ios.description:
Serve Legal Documents. Build Your Own Schedule. Get Paid Daily. 
Join the ABC Legal Network 
ABC Legal helps law firms, businesses, and individuals deliver legal documents across the country—and now, with the ABC Mobile App, you can be part of that mission. As a process server, you’ll play a key role in the legal system while enjoying the freedom and flexibility of gig work. 
Earn on Your Terms 
Looking for flexible work with reliable pay? The ABC Mobile App connects you to service opportunities in your area. Accept jobs when it works for you—whether you want to build a full-time route or pick up extra work on the side. Best of all, you get paid the next business day. 
The Easiest Way to Start Serving 
ABC is the largest process server in America—and the only app built just for gig workers like you. No chasing leads, no detective work. Just open the app, print the docs, and go. It’s simple, flexible, and you get paid fast. 
Be the Face of Justice 
Every document you serve helps move a legal case forward. Whether it’s a court summons, subpoena, or notice, your work matters—and we’re here to help you succeed. 
Let’s Get Started 
Download the ABC Mobile App and start your journey as a process server today. Flexible hours, meaningful work, daily pay, and a nationwide network are just a tap away. 
Requirements to Start: 
Age: You must be 18 years or older to get started. 
Transportation and Valid ID: Ensure you have a Driver’s License and Auto Insurance. 
Printer: You’ll need a smartphone and a printer to get started. We’ll pay you for printing the documents—just print, serve, and earn. 
Bank Account: You'll need a checking or savings account to get paid by direct deposit—fast, every business day. No bank account? No problem. We’ll mail you a check twice a month. 
Additional: Some states have special requirements. We’ll tell you if anything applies to you. 
*Actual earnings will depend on your location, the number of jobs you accept, and other factors. 
By downloading the app, you agree to receive communications from ABC Legal Services, including emails and push notifications. You can opt out of receiving push notifications through your device settings. 
By using this app, you agree to ABC Legal’s Conditions of Use and Privacy Notice.

bluejetty:00179539:ios.description:
Draw with unlimited features for free for 30 hours monthly with no ads! 
Now with new, powerful features!
Clip Studio Paint makes drawing a piece of cake, in any style!
Whether you are a beginner or a pro, Clip Studio Paint will improve every aspect of your art experience, while helping you grow as an artist.
Unlimited amount of brushes at your fingertips to recreate any style
- Use brushes with the same textures as real art materials
- Adjust details such as brush shape and paper quality to your liking
- Make unique colors with realistic color mixing, like traditional paints
- Draw with transparency to erase, so no need to switch brushes
Countless artist-made materials 
- Level up your art with free materials, for backgrounds and more
- Discover community-made brushes from creators worldwide
- Add details with materials like frills and more 
Coloring made easy
- Easily color even with line gaps using the magnetic lasso tool
- Lock transparency to paint over layers without affecting other areas
- Set light source and shadow position with Shading Assist
- Instantly reference and apply colors from an image to your art using Color Match
- Enhance your art with filters like Chromatic Aberration, Retro Film, Pencil, and more
Learn alongside other creators
- Loads of official tutorials and creator tips available 
- Watch tutorials on the Clip Studio Paint YouTube channel, for step-by-step advice
- Ask questions on the Clip Studio Ask community
Create the perfect reference with 3D models
- Use 3D drawing figures to help out your anatomy
- Customize character face and body models with beginner-friendly tools
- Attach 3D objects like hats and shoes to characters for more specific references
- Use 3D shapes to draw perspective
Adjust after you draw
- Liquify to make adjustments to the balance of your illustrations
- Mesh Transformation allows you to transform to different shapes
- Change up the poses of your character drawings with Puppet warp
- Non-destructive color adjustment layers to get your art just right
- Gradient maps give color to your grayscale illustrations
Stress-free layer features
- Assign colors and make multiple columns of layers to browse them at a glance
- Enjoy the freedom of masking and clipping on multiple layers to edit and move your work
- Add various effects to apply to the layer in a non-destructive way
The ultimate comic creation app
- All the tools you need for comic creation, from sketches to finishing touches
- Panel frames, speech balloons, text, effect lines, and screen tones in an instant
- Make high-resolution print data (6 GB+ memory recommended)
- Manage multi-page projects
Professional animation, on any device
- Use all the same tools as animation studios
- Unique features allow you to draw your frames as you like
- Expand your drawings to 4K resolution without losing quality by saving it as vector data
●Grade features
・FREE: 30 hours/month
・PRO: All the tools you need to create stunning illustrations & short animations
・EX: All the above + multi-page functionality for comic/manga artists and unlimited animation frames
*Clip Studio account needed to buy a plan.
● Target Devices and Specifications
・Minimum free storage space: 3GB, 4GB recommended
・Recommended display size: 5.5"+
Please see the following for supported devices.
https://support.clip-studio.com/en-us/faq/articles/20200154
You can use the app fully for free for up to 30 hours each month. 
After this free period has ended, please purchase a plan to:
- Save your canvas
- Export your data in various file formats on iPhone and more
Smartphone plan:
PRO: US$0.99 per month, get an annual plan for up to 5 months' worth of savings!
EX: US$2.49 per month, get an annual plan for up to 5 months' worth of savings!
Clip Studio Paint End User License Agreement
https://www.celsys.com/en/information/csp/

bluejetty:00092232:ios.description:
Most screen time apps fail because they’re easy to bypass. Bloom was created to fix that. 
Bloom revolutionizes your productivity by requiring you to scan an NFC keycard to your phone to access distracting apps.
**How It Works**
- Choose Your Distractions: Select the apps or websites you find most distracting.
- Block Your Distractions: Tap your Bloom card to your phone to block those apps.
- Live Distraction-Free: Stay productive with your card out of reach. When ready, just tap your Bloom card to your phone to unblock your apps.
**Features**
- Schedules: Set personalized schedules for your focus periods, allowing them to start and end automatically.
- Breaks: Use your apps mindfully by setting limits on the frequency and duration of your breaks.
- Strict Mode: Disable your ability to delete the Bloom app while in focus mode (optional).
- Emergency Exits: Unblock all of your apps without your bloom card up to three times.

- Spend less time on your phone and more time doing things that actually matter.
- Improve your work habits by blocking out distractions.
- Our physical solution is the ultimate solution for digital detox and time management.
With Bloom’s NFC keycard, you can leave the “key” to your distractions behind, ensuring you stay focused and productive.
Find your Bloom today and enjoy life beyond your phone!
(We prioritize your privacy—your screen time data stays securely on your device and is never shared or stored elsewhere).
Learn more by visiting our website: bloom.inc

Whether you are preparing for Air Force officer selection, pilot training pipelines, or aviation aptitude testing, AFOQT & TBAS Prep gives you the tools to study efficiently and build confidence before test day.
FREE FEATURES
• Create a free account
• Access introductory lessons covering exam structure, scoring, and study strategy
• Track your study progress
• Sync your progress and access with your AFOQT & TBAS Prep account
FULL ACCESS
• 82 comprehensive lessons with review sections across AFOQT and TBAS topics
• 160+ flashcard decks for rapid knowledge reinforcement
• 1,500+ sample test questions with detailed explanations

• Multi-Tasking Simulator
• UAV Simulator

STUDY WITH YOUR ACCOUNT
Full Access is tied to your AFOQT & TBAS Prep account. Sign in with the same account to keep your access and study progress synced and available wherever your account is supported.
EXISTING CUSTOMERS
If you previously purchased AFOQT & TBAS Prep, your access is preserved. Simply sign in or create an account to link your Full Access.

• Math Knowledge and Arithmetic Reasoning

• TBAS: Multi-Tasking, UAV, and Stick-and-Rudder / Cockpit tracking practice

bluejetty:00145594:ios.name: PlanRadar Construction Manager
bluejetty:00145594:ios.summary: PlanRadar is a single platform for all project documentation, processes and reporting. Construction documents, defects and tasks can be recorded on a mobile device, pinned directly to your construction plans and communicated to project memb
bluejetty:00145594:ios.description:
PlanRadar is a single platform for all project documentation, processes and reporting. Construction documents, defects and tasks can be recorded on a mobile device, pinned directly to your construction plans and communicated to project members in real-time. 
PlanRadar can be used for all use cases and is fully flexible to collect data how you prefer. Manage everything from legally compliant handover documentation with a detailed snag list, to digital site diaries to ongoing inspections, maintenance and reporting in one place. Benefit from seamless construction and real estate documentation that creates transparency for all stakeholders. 
YOUR BENEFITS: 
* Instant overview of construction site activity: 
With our construction site app, new tasks and construction defects can be located on digital plans or BIM models in the form of tickets. These can be placed with millimetre precision by all authorised project participants and can be supplemented by photos, text, voice messages and documents. It’s easy to communicate clearly and avoid mistakes and misunderstandings. 
* Office to project-site communication: 
Ongoing synchronisation between computer, mobile phones and tablets keep your team informed about all changes on the construction site in real-time, helping you stay on top of the status of different tasks and defects. 
* All project members working to the same plans, documents and tasks: 
Keep up-to-date plans on your smartphone. Newly uploaded blueprints are immediately accessible by all project participants in the mobile app. That way, you and your colleagues are always working with the latest set of drawings. 
* No extra paperwork in the office: 
Create detailed and completely customisable PDF or Excel reports and export your construction site diary, detailed snag list or an entire handover document in just a few clicks. Efficient reporting saves you from duplicating work in the office after completing your site inspections. 
* An intuitive design that gets you started in minutes: 
Unlike other construction apps, the simple user interface of PlanRadar allows for a quick and easy introduction to the software without expensive training. You can create your first project and start adding tasks within minutes.

bluejetty:00142593:ios.description:
Capture, create, edit, and share in 3D with Abound, the intuitive 3D scanning and creation platform for iPhone, iPad, and Web.
Scan real-world objects and spaces, or use AI Mode to create 3D models from a photo or a text prompt. From photorealistic captures to brand-new creations, Abound makes 3D fast, accessible, and ready for your workflow.
Capture the real world or create with AI
• Turn photos into detailed 3D models with camera zoom, auto-timer, and manual focus options
• Scan spaces as you walk with a mini-map, interactive camera views, and real-time raytrace preview
• AI Mode lets you create 3D models from a photo or by describing what you want
Edit with speed and precision
• Crop, rotate, and clean up scans with intuitive tools
• Take precise, scale-accurate measurements
• View your scans in the real world with augmented reality
Organize and find everything
• Browse your library in an interactive, zoomable grid
• Search, sort, and filter with ease
• Organize scans into folders
• Explore geolocated scans with Map View
Export into your workflow
• Use models in Blender, Unity, Unreal, SketchUp, Maya, and more
• Export meshes in USDZ, OBJ, GLTF, FBX, and STL
• Export point clouds in LAZ, PLY, and XYZ
• Create and export cinematic 4K videos of your scans
Access your work anywhere
• Sync your library across iPhone, iPad, and Web with an Abound account
• Sign in with Apple or Google for seamless cross-device access
• View and manage your scans any time at abound3d.com
Abound Web
• Embed interactive 3D scans on the web with a single line of HTML
• Upload DSLR photo sets or videos for professional-grade model creation
Share and collaborate instantly
• Send scan links that work in any browser, on any platform
• Keep scans private or share them publicly
• Invite others to view, comment, or download
• Share via Messages, email, or third-party apps
Your data stays under your control
• LiDAR scans are processed on your device, with no Internet required
• Photos are deleted immediately after processing on our servers
• Your scans stay yours until you choose to share
Fast, accessible, and built for creators
• Full support for Dark Mode and Dynamic Type
• Manage raw scan data with the built-in Storage browser
Go Pro with Abound
• Unlock premium features including unlimited creations, higher resolution models, and advanced export formats
Learn more: abound3d.com

Privacy Policy: abound3d.com/privacy

bluejetty:00120602:ios.summary: Create a personalized list of words to practice. Test your spelling - hear each word spoken. Get a star for each correct word. Practice just the words you have yet to master. Retest your words at anytime. Students can practice their words i
bluejetty:00120602:ios.description:
Create a personalized list of words to practice. Test your spelling - hear each word spoken. Get a star for each correct word. Practice just the words you have yet to master. Retest your words at anytime. Students can practice their words independently.
Originally designed to be a replacement for a student's spelling notebook which lists words to be learnt for school each week. Unlike a paper notebook, SpellingNotebook can speak each of the words to enable testing and practice without seeing the written word. SpellingNotebook contains a full searchable spelling dictionary so that words can be added directly to the student's word list, minimizing entry errors. 
User Reviews 
* This app is awesome I have a spelling test coming up and I can spell every word correctly thanks to this app!!! (US) 
* Makes spelling practice fun (UK) 
* So fun!!!! This is a great app for kids and adults! (US) 
* Great App!!! Whole class uses it!! (Australia) 
Spelling Notebook features: 
* Students can practice independently 
* More than 100,000 words - add new words to the built in spelling dictionary when needed 
* Spelling Notebook has a built in voice that can say all words in its extensive dictionary and any new english words added 
* Optionally Record your own voice for the word you want to practice. You can record just the word, or even a whole phrase to help you recognize which word to spell. 
* Multiple English regions: UK, US, Canada, Australia and NZ 
* Earn a star for correct words 
* Keep multiple word lists 
* Edit word lists: add or delete words, add or delete an entire word list, rename your list
* Import words from one wordlist into another 
* Words are selected from an extensive dictionary - minimizing entry errors 
* Help available in app to guide and support 
* Word list Copy and Paste
* History of Word list tests and practice
* Email test results
* 8 words per list: Upgrade to Premium for unlimited words per list and a selection of UK, US and Australian voices.
The built-in spelling dictionary is automatically selected by region. For countries outside US, Canada, Australia and NZ, the UK spelling dictionary is selected. 
Follow us on Instagram: @spellingnotebook
Recommended Ages: All, Kids 
Categories: Education, Productivity, Apps for Kids

The ShiftMed app put
bluejetty:00061665:ios.description:
You became a healthcare professional to care for others, not to be stuck with a schedule that doesn’t work for you. Pick up nursing jobs, per diem shifts, and allied health opportunities on your schedule with ShiftMed.
The ShiftMed app puts you in control. Find local nursing jobs, CNA shifts, RN opportunities, and allied health jobs near you. Browse available healthcare shifts, choose the ones that fit your life, and get paid for the work you do—instantly.
Your Schedule. Your Shifts. Your Choice.
With ShiftMed, you decide when, where, and how often you work. Whether you’re looking for extra income, a flexible schedule, per diem healthcare jobs, PRN shifts, or a new way to work full-time, ShiftMed connects you with opportunities at hospitals, skilled nursing facilities, outpatient centers, and other healthcare organizations near you.
Why healthcare professionals choose ShiftMed:
- Find local healthcare shifts in 165+ markets.
- Pick up RN, LPN, LVN, CNA, and allied health jobs.
- Choose shifts based on your availability, location, and pay preferences.
- Get access to opportunities from leading healthcare facilities.
- Enjoy benefits like Instant Pay, health coverage, and retirement savings. 
- Work flexibly with the benefits and security of W-2 employment.
Flexible Nursing Jobs for Healthcare Professionals
ShiftMed helps qualified nurses find flexible work opportunities across a variety of healthcare settings.
Available nursing roles include:
- Registered Nurses (RN)
- Licensed Practical Nurses (LPN)
- Licensed Vocational Nurses (LVN)
- Certified Nursing Assistants (CNA)
Find nursing shifts in specialties including:
- Emergency Room (ED/ER)
- Intensive Care Unit (ICU)
- Medical-Surgical (Med-Surg)
- Operating Room (OR)
- Perioperative (PACU)
- Telemetry
- Behavioral Health
- Stepdown (SDU)
Shift availability varies by profession and state of licensure.
Allied Health Jobs Built Around You
ShiftMed connects allied health professionals with flexible healthcare opportunities that help organizations deliver exceptional patient care.
Available roles include:
-Physical Therapists (PT)
-Physical Therapist Assistants (PTA)
- Occupational Therapists (OT)
- Certified Occupational Therapy Assistants (COTA)
- Respiratory Therapists (CRT/RRT)
- Speech-Language Pathologists (SLP)
- Speech-Language Pathologist Assistants (SLPA)
- Pharmacists
- Pharmacy Technicians
Claim Shifts in Just a Few Taps
Getting started is simple. Download the ShiftMed app, complete onboarding, and start exploring healthcare jobs and open shifts in your area. 
Customize your search by:
- Start time
- Distance
- Hourly pay rate
- Preferred facilities
Build the schedule you want—whether that means picking up a few extra shifts or creating a flexible full-time schedule.
Ready to Work on Your Terms?
Download ShiftMed today and start finding nursing jobs, CNA shifts, and allied health opportunities near you.
Learn more at shiftmed.com and follow us on Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube for company updates.

bluejetty:00129087:ios.description:
Have you ever heard of the “Don’t Break The Chain” (DBTC) motivation technique
used by the famous American stand-up comedian and director Jerry Seinfeld? The
idea behind this motivation technique is so simple and easy to achieve: Define a
goal and try to constantly do actions towards your goal. So, no matter you are
going to learn a new language, learn how to play Guitar, break a bad habit, write a
new book, or any other activities, the “Don’t Break The Chain” enables you to be
on the right track and forces you to keep doing whatever it takes to reach your
goal.
Interested in the idea and want to know how DBTC works? Well, download the
application for free on your iOS device, add your goals and start tracking your
activities on a daily basis.
What to expect from the Don’t Break The Chain?
DBTC, the motivation app to track your commitment to your goals and
resolutions, comes with a clean and neat design and the interface is so user-
friendly that you’ll get the whole idea after writing down your first goal and
marking the first X on the calendar.
What is X? 
Well, you have access to a large year-at-a-glance calendar and at the
first day of your motivation program, you get to mark that day with a red X, if you
manage to do the committed task toward your goal. In other words, did you do
the task you were supposed to do? If so, mark that day with an X, otherwise, you
have broken the chain and you prove your self your not motivated enough.
And the chain starts. Congratulations on starting your chain. You have to keep
doing the tasks every day and mark the calendar with an X to make sure you
never break the chain and you are getting closer to your goal day by day. After a
while, you’ll develop a good habit of doing worthy actions and you’ll see how
motivated you are.
Don’t forget that your chain of red Xs cannot be stopped unless you reach the
pre-defined goal, and you cannot mark a day with an X unless you’ve done what
you were supposed to do.
Don’t Break The Chain main features at a glance:
* Clean and neat design with fresh and intuitive interface
* Learn how to break a bad habit and replace it with a good one
* Track how committed you are to your goals and resolutions
* Easy to learn motivation technique
* Useful for anyone who cares about not wasting their times
So, download DBTC for free, start your first chain and try to be as committed as it
takes to your goal to make sure you never break the chain. The moment you start
a chain, there is no going back and you need to show others you are strong and
confident enough that you never cross the line and always respect the process.
Stay tuned and let us know about any bugs, questions, feature requests or any
other suggestions.
Read more about this motivation technique at:
http://lifehacker.com/281626/jerry-seinfelds-productivity-secret/
Steve Pavlina's 30 Days to Success is also a very similar technique:
http://www.stevepavlina.com/blog/2005/04/30-days-to-success/

bluejetty:00019068:ios.description:
DrumKnee is the most realistic drums app. Now you can play the bass with your foot.
Perfect for on-the-go drumming! It is like having a real drum set in the palm of your hands.
Play drums, record, and share your songs with the DrumKnee 3D community.
The new Splitteroo integration lets you remove drums from your favorite songs, create custom drum kits with the separated snare and kick sounds, and play along with the track for an immersive drumming experience!
DrumKnee is very different from any other app out there:
 First of all, it is a well-polished real drum app in 3D (how cool is that?).
 In addition, you get to trigger the bass sound with your foot. That's right, just rest your phone/tablet on your knee and kick it!!
 Mix and match the sounds so you can build your own custom drum set!!
Features:
 Professionally recorded sounds.
 Very low latency response. The best one out there. The delay between your tap on the screen and the sound is incredibly low.
 Most realistic drums app. You will feel just like playing a real drum.
 Cymbals are also chokable by holding your finger on them when played.
 Play along with select drumless songs.
 You can record your masterpiece and share it with friends.
 Many stylish skins for you to choose from.
 Jazz/Funk drum set
DK Music is another feature available.
 This service is a separate monthly fee that allows you to download drumless tracks directly to the app to play along with.

- Subscribe for unlimited access to the full drumless (songs without drums) songs library for the duration of your subscription
- Subscriptions are monthly, quarterly and yearly

- Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings
- No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during active subscription period
- Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription
- You can read our privacy policy at https://drumknee.wordpress.com/policy/

bluejetty:00148988:ios.description:
Immerse yourself in the exciting world of Unlock Master: Tap Puzzle, a thrilling and satisfying puzzle game designed to test your logic and strategic thinking. In this addictive gameplay experience, your mission is to tap away blocks in the correct order, clear the board, and unveil exciting rewards. With each move, you must carefully analyze the structure of the puzzle, ensuring that no obstacles remain in your path. Every level presents a unique challenge, requiring precise timing and smart decision-making to master the art of unlocking.
The gameplay is intuitive, but the challenge keeps you fully engaged. As you progress, you'll encounter a variety of cubes and blocks stacked together in different formations. Some blocks can be removed immediately, while others are blocked and require strategic tapping to clear the way. The key to success is understanding the movement of each piece, as some blocks can only be taken away when they are free from obstructions. With a satisfying tap, watch as the blocks disappear, creating a smooth and rewarding chain reaction. The more efficiently you remove them, the faster you can solve the puzzle and move on to the next exciting challenge.
Unlocking new levels brings greater complexity and excitement. As you advance, the puzzles become increasingly intricate, testing your ability to plan several steps ahead. Some levels introduce special block mechanics that add an extra layer of difficulty, making every stage a fresh and engaging experience. But don’t worry—if you ever find yourself stuck, helpful hints and boosters are available to guide you through tricky situations. With patience and strategy, you’ll develop the skills needed to conquer even the toughest puzzles.
Beyond its stimulating gameplay, Unlock Master: Tap Puzzle offers a visually satisfying experience. Each block disappears with smooth, polished animations, creating a relaxing and immersive effect. The intuitive controls ensure that every tap feels natural and responsive, making it easy to enjoy the game anytime, anywhere. Whether you're looking for a casual way to unwind or a mental challenge to sharpen your skills, this game provides endless hours of entertainment.
Are you ready to put your puzzle-solving abilities to the test? Let's play Unlock Master: Tap Puzzle and embark on a journey of tapping, unlocking, and mastering the ultimate block-removal challenge. With every level you complete, you'll get one step closer to becoming the Unlock Master!

bluejetty:00150620:ios.description:
FINN: YOUR AI WEALTH MANAGER
Finn connects to all of your accounts, understands your full financial life, tells you what needs attention, and helps you act on it. With it, you have an investment advisor, tax expert and private banker all in one, in your pocket. 
FINN FEED: YOUR PERSONALIZED MONEY BRIEFING
Your Feed brings what matters straight to you. Finn surfaces idle cash, portfolio drift, tax opportunities, and market moves that actually affect you. Open the app and see what deserves your attention today.
FINN CHAT: ASK FINN ANYTHING
Ask Finn about your portfolio, a market move, or a decision you're weighing. Finn answers with your numbers, understands your context and walks through the tradeoffs, so you're not guessing.
FINN TASKS: PUT YOUR MONEY TO WORK
Tell Finn what you want to happen and it sets up the workflow. Finn handles the steps, monitors the conditions, and checks with you before moving any money so you’re always in control. 
FINN PLANS: STAY ON TRACK
Big financial goals like buying a home, paying down debt, or planning for taxes take time. Finn Plans track your progress, catch you when you fall behind, and tell you the next move. Your plan stays alive as your life changes.
FINN STORIES & TIMELINE: NEWS THAT MATTERS TO YOU
Finn follows the news, filings, and company events tied to what you own and organizes them into clear timelines. See what happened, why it matters, and how it touches your money.
FINN SCORE: EVERY STOCK, CLEARLY RATED
Finn scores stocks and ETFs across growth, valuation, financial health, performance, risk, and sentiment. Each one is measured against its industry, so you know where it really stands. Make decisions confidently with the help of research backed by data and explained simply.
FINN PICKS: SEE CURATED INVESTMENT IDEAS
Finn Picks is a curated portfolio built on the Finn Score system. It turns structured analysis into a clear set of investment ideas you can act on, personalized to your goals.

bluejetty:00014758:ios.summary:
SQLPro for MSSQL is a lightweight Microsoft SQL Server database client, allowing quick and simple access to MSSQL Servers, including those hosted via cloud services such as SQL Azure or Amazon RDS.
Features include:
+ Intellisense/SQL auto
bluejetty:00014758:ios.description:
SQLPro for MSSQL is a lightweight Microsoft SQL Server database client, allowing quick and simple access to MSSQL Servers, including those hosted via cloud services such as SQL Azure or Amazon RDS.
Features include:
+ Intellisense/SQL autocompletion.
+ Syntax highlighting. 
+ Tabbed based interface for an optimal user experience (iPad).
+ Support for executing multiple queries at once. 
+ Quick access to tables, columns and more. 
+ Dark & Light themes which can be switched manually or automatically adjusted by your devices brightness.
+ Netbios support.
+ NTLMv2 supported (but not required).
+ SSH Tunnelling (password authentication only).
+ Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) sign-in, including MFA, for Azure SQL.
Some of the great features include:
+ Microsoft SQL Azure
+ Microsoft SQL Server 2005
+ Microsoft SQL Server 2008
+ Microsoft SQL Server 2008 R2
+ Microsoft SQL Server 2012
+ Microsoft SQL Server 2014
+ Microsoft SQL Server 2016
Thanks to the FreeTDS project (http://www.freetds.org/) for their great library.
This SQL Client does NOT work with MySQL or Postgres. Please ensure that your server is a Microsoft SQL Server (2005 or above).
Note 1: SQL Server Express is supported, however using it makes me sad. Please confirm that the SQL Server Express installation has been configured properly for remote connections over TCP/IP, and that you can connect remotely from another windows pc before requesting support.
Note 2: SQLPro for MSSQL can connect to Microsoft SQL Server 2000 however it is not supported.
Privacy Policy:
https://hankinsoft.com/privacypolicy.html
Terms of Use:
https://hankinsoft.com/termsofuse.html
Price:
SQLPro requires a Premium upgrade in order to interact with database result sets. Premium is available as either a Lifetime Purchase or through a Subscription with Monthly and Yearly options. Subscriptions auto-renew within 24 hours of the expiration date unless auto-renewal is turned off in the iTunes account settings. Your Account will be charged for renewal (based on your selected plan) within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable. Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.

Welcome to English Dictionary - the easiest way to learn English language fastly within your iPhones and iPads.
Our new English to English Dictionary app is a light weight and elegant tool. You can find over 150,000+ english words with their English meanings for Free on your smartphone! - It's Offline. So user need not any internet connection more.
- Perfect app for travellers! This, will help you to learn and talk English language with people easily!
- We developed a new quiz inside English dictionary! To take the quiz, you can easily tap the option icon in the top left side of the screen and choose quiz. Accessories and jewelry: Stay up-to-date with the latest fashion trends available in our store. Our creative sellers even offer handcrafted items.
Electronics and gadgets: Get the best prices on gadgets for the most demanding users. With the Prom Shopping, you can purchase electronic devices at competitive prices!

- Quickly find special offers using filters.

- Be the first to discover low prices and pay in your preferred method.
- Easily communicate with sellers.
- Choose eco-friendly products among countless options.
Shop from the comfort of your home and enjoy many other valuable features.

bluejetty:00131354:ios.description:
Scout new terrain and navigate in-field maps with the most comprehensive, intuitive four-season backcountry App. Trusted by guides and heralded by pros, onX Backcountry features 650,000+ miles of hiking and biking trails, 300,000+ rock climbs, and 4,000+ ski routes.
With interactive 3D Offline Maps, easy-to-use GPS navigation, and trustworthy mapping data, onX Backcountry gives you the tools to execute incredible outdoor adventures. Plan hiking, mountain biking, backpacking, or skiing trips with clarity on terrain, slope angle, and conditions.
Switch between activity-specific Map Modes. Toggle Map Layers to show nearby hazards such as wildfires or avalanche terrain. Study distance and elevation gain, locate free dispersed camping, and sync your map across devices before you even leave the house.
Map out custom routes with our snap-to-trail feature and add Waypoints to points of interest. Review Slope Angle and Slope Aspect to evaluate the steepness and direction of terrain. View localized Weather, hour-by-hour Wind Forecasts, and Recent Satellite Imagery.
Download 3D Offline Maps so you can find your way back to camp, even without cell service. Leave a breadcrumb trail with Tracker to measure key trip stats.
A great day starts with a better map. Go farther today with onX Backcountry.
onX Backcountry Features:
▶ Does onX Backcountry work without cell service?
onX Backcountry is built for remote, offline GPS navigation. Download 3D Offline Maps and access interactive trail and Map Layer data. Navigate off-grid trails with confidence, see exactly where you are on satellite imagery, and track activity stats even without signal.
▶ How can I find and track backcountry hiking trails?
Discover guidebook hiking trails or build custom routes based on key terrain features. Use route builder to plan backpacking trips with realistic expectations of time, distance, and elevation. Hike responsibly by checking private land, dispersed camping, active fire, and terrain Map Layers.
▶ What mountain biking trails and features are available?
Plan your next ride with detailed information on trail difficulty, elevation, and distance. Build your own MTB route or access thousands of expert-sourced trails. Download interactive maps for offline use and understand complex terrain using LiDAR Topo, Satellite, and Terrain Basemaps.
▶ How can I plan rock climbs and backcountry ski tours?
Find new climbs powered by Mountain Project and analyze your approach in 3D. View recent Snow Imagery, Beacon Guidebook routes, real-time Weather Forecasts, and Avalanche Simulator data. Evaluate slope risk with Avalanche Terrain Exposure Scale (ATES) maps.
▶ How does onX Backcountry deliver better in-field maps?
onX Backcountry is the only App with offline 3D, LiDAR-based Topo, intuitive route building, and proprietary Map Layers for conditions, cell coverage, and terrain. With four-season outdoor coverage and US-based customer support, access the most detailed maps for the backcountry.
▶ Premium & Elite Membership
• 650,000+ miles of hiking, backpacking, and mountain bike trails
• 4,000+ backcountry skiing lines with guidebook descriptions
• 300,000+ rock climbing routes with approach trails
• 3D Offline Trail Maps to navigate without cell service
• 985 million acres of Public Land across the U.S.
• 550,000 Recreation Icons: Trailheads, backcountry cabins, campgrounds, and more
• Map data sourced from USFS, BLM, and NPS
• Private Land Layer (ELITE ONLY)
• Recent Satellite Imagery (ELITE ONLY)
▶ onX SOS:
When something goes wrong in the field, onX SOS connects you to a 24/7 professional rescue team that coordinates help and covers rescue and evacuation costs.
• Available as an add-on subscription for $49.99/year
• Powered by Overwatch x Rescue (OxR)
▶ Terms of Use: https://www.onxmaps.com/tou
▶ Privacy Policy: https://www.onxmaps.com/privacy-policy
▶ Feedback: Please contact us at support@onxmaps.com. We’d love to hear from you.

bluejetty:00093745:ios.summary:
Welcome to Kamloops Golf & Country Club
Kamloops Golf & Country Club is the oldest course in the area and over the years it has become a local favorite. The golf course underwent a major renovation in 2010 that incorporated undulating fair
bluejetty:00093745:ios.description:
Welcome to Kamloops Golf & Country Club
Kamloops Golf & Country Club is the oldest course in the area and over the years it has become a local favorite. The golf course underwent a major renovation in 2010 that incorporated undulating fairways and greens. The makeover revitalized the original design while also complementing its best features. The bunkers were reshaped and the water hazards were redesigned. Strategically placed mounding was also added. The golf course is more challenging but overall it's playable for a variety of skill levels. Kamloops G&CC isn't terribly long, from the back tees it is just over 6,700 yards, but it still provides a round that's interesting enough for more advanced players. It's more traditional in design, but there are subtle degrees of difficulty that will keep you on your toes. The terrain is mostly flat, making it a nice golf course to walk and the mature trees provide shady respite as well.

bluejetty:00120334:ios.description:
Master fractions with confidence—step by step.
MathBoard Fractions is a comprehensive learning app designed to help students of all ages understand, practice, and excel at working with fractions. Whether you’re just getting started or ready to tackle complex operations, MathBoard Fractions offers the perfect mix of instruction, interaction, and evaluation.
Through engaging activities and a built-in Problem Solver, students will explore key concepts, see worked examples, test their understanding, and learn how to arrive at the correct answer—not just what it is.
Activities Include:
 • Understanding proper and improper fractions
 • Matching visual quantities to fractions
 • Simplifying fractions
 • Comparing and ordering fractions
 • Adding, subtracting, multiplying, and dividing fractions
*Built-In Problem Solver:
Students can walk through the solution steps for:
 • Simplifying fractions
 • Finding the Greatest Common Factor (GCF)
 • Finding the Least Common Denominator (LCD) using:
• Least Common Multiple
• Prime Factorization
 • Comparing and ordering fractions
 • Solving addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division problems
*Progress Tracking
Track student progress across individual activities or overall. Results can be saved, reviewed in the Problem Solver, or shared via email—perfect for teachers and parents.
*Customizable Settings:
MathBoard Fractions adapts to different skill levels and teaching goals:
 • Set maximum values and denominator ranges
 • Choose whether to use simplified or whole-number fractions
 • Enable or disable common denominators
 • Select timed or non-timed activities
 • Choose between multiple choice or student-supplied answers
Whether used at home or in the classroom, MathBoard Fractions transforms fractions from frustrating to fun—building real understanding that lasts.

- Serves as a discreet, secondary display for
bluejetty:00150906:ios.description:
The Tandem t:slim mobile app, the companion app for your pump. Always consult a healthcare professional for information about how to manage diabetes. 
- Deliver a bolus from your smartphone* 
- Serves as a discreet, secondary display for the pump† 
- View pump data and receive push notifications directly on your smartphone‡ 
- Wirelessly upload pump therapy data to the cloud† 
Note: Units of measure on app may differ from those pictured above. Mobile app units of measure will match the paired t:slim X2 insulin pump. 
ALWAYS READ THE LABEL AND FOLLOW THE DIRECTIONS FOR USE. The electronic instructions for use for the Tandem t:slim mobile app (Basic UDI-DI: 0850018992TF-0011603KR) can be accessed through the t:slim X2 user guide, available here: https://www.tandemdiabetes.com/support/resources/documents. Upon request, a printed copy of the user guide can be provided within 7 days at no additional cost. 
If the language set on your smartphone is supported by the mobile app, then the mobile app will display in that language. If the language set on your smartphone is not supported by the mobile app, then the mobile app will display in English. 
*Requires a t:slim X2 insulin pump from Tandem Diabetes Care and a compatible smartphone. Additional restrictions apply. Refer to the user guide for t:slim X2 insulin pump for a list of warnings and precautions. 
†The information on the Tandem t:slim mobile app display may not be identical to the current status of your pump. Wireless uploads from the Tandem t:slim mobile app to the cloud-based Tandem Source platform require a compatible phone and an internet or wireless data connection. Uploads to the Tandem Source platform do not take place in real time and should not be relied upon by healthcare providers, pump users, or caregivers for remote patient monitoring. Standard carrier data rates may apply. ‡You cannot dismiss alerts and alarms from the app and must do so on the pump itself, but once an alert or alarm has been dismissed on the pump it will also disappear from the mobile app.

bluejetty:00064596:ios.name: Bank3 Mobile
bluejetty:00064596:ios.summary: The Bank3 App is a free mobile decision-support tool that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other financial institutions, into a single, up-to-the-minute view so you can stay organize
bluejetty:00064596:ios.description:
The Bank3 App is a free mobile decision-support tool that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other financial institutions, into a single, up-to-the-minute view so you can stay organized and make smarter financial decisions. It is fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your personal finances.
FEATURES
Multi-Account Aggregation: View all of your financial information (balances, transaction history, merchant spending averages) in one place for on-the-go organization.
Alerts & Notifications: Set alerts for low funds and be notified about upcoming bills.
Add Tags, Notes, Images & Geo-Information: By enhancing transactions with custom tags, notes or photos of a receipt or check, you have the ability to stay organized and find exactly what you’re looking for when searching through your finances.
Contact: Locate ATMs or branches and contact Bank3 customer service directly from the app.
SAFE AND SECURE
The app utilizes the same bank-level security that protects you when you’re on Internet Banking. The app also features a unique 4-digit passcode setting that prevents unauthorized access.
GETTING STARTED
To use the Bank3 App, you must be enrolled as a Bank3 Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials. After you successfully login to the app, your accounts and transactions will begin updating.

bluejetty:00157538:ios.description:
Brook Health Companion helps you find your healthy zone in the flow of your everyday life.
For people managing chronic conditions like diabetes or hypertension, or those who need a little extra support with their health, Brook builds your complete health story and helps you reach your goals.
HOW BROOK WORKS
Brook collects health information automatically and manually to help you track your health journey, and gives you the tools you need to get healthy and feel your best.
Through Brook, you can chat with our Health Coaches - skilled nutritionists, dietitians, and other health professionals available for live chat every weekday. They even answer questions on the weekends so you can get the support and guidance you need for success. 
CHECK OUT WHAT OUR MEMBERS ARE SAYING
“Brook has been THE MOST IMPORTANT TOOL in this journey. The ease of tracking, the reminders, the encouragement and compassion of the Health Coaches aligns well with my motivation.” - JP
“Brook helps me so much. I love it. I don’t feel like I’m alone dealing with this disease.” - BM
“Had my Dr. visit this afternoon. He was very pleased with the progress. I was down 13 lbs from my last visit. BTW not only were my A1c 6.0 but overall cholesterol was 139 and triglycerides were 119.....Woo Hoo!! It’s a great day. Thank you Brook!” - KM
FEATURES:
Chat your way to success
- Get answers and guidance from Health Coaches about nutrition, sleep, stress, exercise, and more
- 1-on-1 advice and support, 7 days a week
- Chat with your doctor and the clinic care team (for those participating in Remote Monitoring)
Quick data capture
- Log your data through simple messaging and notifications
- Background logging of daily activities like sleep and exercise and other health data through connected devices
- Integration with Apple HealthKit for retrieving health data directly into Brook
Insights and Dashboards
- Get instant feedback on your data from our friendly chat-bot, and personalized insights and support for improving your health from our Health Coach team.
- View data dashboards to track progress and explore your full data history
- Share data reports with your doctor for data-driven office visits
- Share health data with your doctor (for those participating in Remote Monitoring)
Note: Brook is not a medical device and is not a replacement for medical treatment. Insights from Brook are general and are not a substitute for advice from your licensed health providers.

bluejetty:00175259:ios.description:
Have you ever dreamed of building your own virtual world in an easy and intuitive way without any coding experience necessary? Ever dreamed about a 3D world, where it's YOUR rules YOUR characters? Ever wanted to build something amazing and share it with friends and family?
If so, Struckd is the answer - the ultimate playground to bring your creativity to life.
PLAY. CREATE. SHARE:
Choose one of the many templates to build your first own world step by step. Pick from many genres. Anything from Racing and Tower defense to Action Puzzlers and RPGs. Shape the characters, and join them on their journeys.
Maybe you're even more creative? Maybe you want your imagination to run wild? If so, why not combine the hundreds of elements available with YOUR rules and build YOUR own universe!
Once you win your level you can share it: Challenge your friends with your tricky levels or play games from the community. All creations are user generated and ready to be explored.
Experiment, excite and gamify in this interactive, virtual world!

• Share section: Share your creation with millions of other players!
• Multiplayer: Play your own map together with friends!

• Free!

bluejetty:00074605:ios.description:
Top 5 Free App in US, #1 in Utilities Category (Aug. 2009)
· CNN: "iPhone App Helps Track Sex Offenders"
· Today Show, NBC September 4th: "Is Your Family Safe From Sex Offenders"
· Fox & Friends FOX: "iPhone App Tracks Sex Predators"
· USA Today: "iPhone App Finds Registered Sex Offenders"
· ABC News: "Top Selling iPhone App: Offender Locator"
· Biz Journal, Wall Street Journal online, Yahoo Finance, Finance AOL, USA Television Network: "ThinAir Wireless Strengthens Partnership with Stop Child Predators"
The Offender Locator ® allows anyone living in the United States to view Registered Sex Offenders living in their area. The Offender Locator gives everyone the ability to find out if Registered Sex Offenders live in their area.
Knowledge = Safety
Purchase the Offender Locator and see if Registered Sex Offenders are living near you, your friends, or any address that you want to check. We compile data from all 50 state's "Registered Offender Databases" so that you have a single source for finding Offenders living anywhere in the United States, no matter where you are, right in the palm of your hand! Our data is updated DAILY with each state offender registry so you always have the most accurate information available.
___________________________________________
FEATURES:
· Utilize the GPS function on your iPhone to find registered offenders living near your current location. 
· View registered offenders who live near your friends by simply selecting a name from your iPhone contact list. 
· Enter your home address or any address to find registered offenders living in that area. 
· Enter the name of any registered offender in the U.S. and find out instantly where they reside and offenses committed.
· Upload any picture or link URL and find the likelihood that a face in your photo matches any offender in public databases. Harnessing the power of machine learning, this is possible and now available in our app. 
Once you choose one of the four ways to view registered offenders, the application will compile a list of offenders based on that selection allowing you to view details for each offender including photo and offense. You can then find out how close they live to you or your loved ones using the mapping capabilities of the iPhone.
This application is extremely simple to use!
Your iTunes account will be charged automatically for your selected plan. Charges will occur upon confirmation of purchase or after the free trial period, if any, unless auto renewal is turned off or your subscription is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your subscription will automatically renew at the then-current rates within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. To cancel, visit the Account Setting in your iTunes account. Subscription fees are non-refundable. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if applicable, will be forfeited when you change your subscription.
Terms of Service: https://offenderapps.com/tos.html
Privacy Policy: https://offenderapps.com/privacy.html

bluejetty:00084265:ios.name: FORM Swim
bluejetty:00084265:ios.summary:
Built for the FORM Smart Swim 1 and Smart Swim 2 Goggles. Your underwater coach gives you real-time visual feedback to get the most out of your swims and improve your swimming technique.
1. HEADCOACH™ - A revolutionary swim experience with
bluejetty:00084265:ios.description:
Built for the FORM Smart Swim 1 and Smart Swim 2 Goggles. Your underwater coach gives you real-time visual feedback to get the most out of your swims and improve your swimming technique.
1. HEADCOACH™ - A revolutionary swim experience with in-goggle visual coaching coupled with comprehensive in-app analysis and educational resources. In the water, practice head pitch, head roll, and pacing to perfect your technique. Elevate your technique and improve your performance with real-time coaching.
2. SWIMSTRAIGHT™ - A one-of-a-kind digital compass helping you swim a straighter course in open water. Connect your goggles to a supported Apple Watch or Garmin smartwatch to get GPS-based metrics in open water. Alternatively, use the goggles independently for a unique open water experience.
3. GUIDED WORKOUTS - At the pool, let your goggles guide you through your swim with instructions and progress updates. No more paper, plastic bags or relying on your memory to know what to do next.
4. ALL YOUR SWIM TRAINING IN ONE PLACE - Choose between Plans and Workouts based on your swim goals. Work through a Plan structured to improve your swimming skills or swim and individual guided workout.
5. SCRIPT - INSTANTLY GENERATE WORKOUTS - Transform your swim training with Script, FORM’s proprietary technology that instantly converts any written workout into a guided experience in your goggles. Whether you capture text with your phone’s camera or copy and paste it, Script brings your workouts to life. Plus, easily integrate workouts from platforms like TrainingPeaks and Tridot, or create custom sessions with our workout builder.
6. ANALYZE YOUR METRICS - Sync with the app to review each set out of the pool after every swim—and revisit past workouts to track your progress over time. You can share stats with your coach, too. Customize your goggles with metrics that are important to you.
7. YOUR DATA EVERYWHERE - Automatically sync your workouts with Strava, TrainingPeaks, Apple Health, TriDot, and Final Surge. Perfect if you're training for your next triathlon.
The FORM Swim App works with the FORM Smart Swim 1 and Smart Swim 2 Goggles, the first wearable fitness tracker for swimmers and triathletes that shows metrics in real time on an augmented reality display. Learn more at www.formswim.com.
Read more about our terms and conditions here:
Terms of service: https://formswim.com/terms-of-service
Privacy policy: https://formswim.com/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00136581:ios.description:
Introducing Mawqif: The Ultimate Parking Solution!
Say goodbye to the hassle of carrying cash and coins for parking payments! With Mawqif, the revolutionary parking app, parking has never been easier or more convenient. 
Mawqif takes parking to the next level by seamlessly integrating advanced technology into your daily routine. Using cutting-edge ANPR cameras, the app effortlessly detects your vehicle, eliminating the need for physical tickets or cumbersome payment methods.
With our innovative scan and pay feature, Mawqif lets you settle your parking fees in a snap. Simply scan the Barcode code displayed at the parking ticket using the app, and securely pay from your digital wallet. It's quick, it's convenient, and it's cashless!
No more fumbling for loose change or worrying about expired parking meters. Mawqif ensures a seamless parking experience every time. Focus on what matters most - your day, your errands, your journey - and let Mawqif take care of the rest.
Key Features:
- Effortlessly pay for parking without the need for cash or coins
- ANPR camera integration for automatic vehicle recognition
- Convenient scan and pay feature for hassle-free payment
- Secure transactions through your digital wallet
- Say goodbye to parking tickets and expired meters
Experience the future of parking with Mawqif! Download now and enjoy stress-free parking, one spot at a time.

bluejetty:00080419:ios.description:
Embark on an unforgettable journey in Dacardia, an idyllic island devastated by a mysterious storm, in Neopets: Tales of Dacardia. 
As the new Town Planner, you’ll work alongside the Dacardian community to restore the land they call home and uncover clues to reveal the truth behind the storm. Was it a natural disaster, or is there something more sinister at play? Uncover the strange and surprising secrets of this remote corner of Neopia!
Shape Dacardia’s future with the power of creativity! Craft, customise, and explore the land, from lush fields to ancient jungles. bluejetty:00021733:ios.description:
SlideShow Maker is a feature-packed app that lets you create stunning slideshows using your images and videos. The app is designed to be easy to use, and it offers a wide range of video templates to help you create the perfect slideshow for any occasion.
One of the main features of SlideShow Maker is the ability to import images and videos from your device's camera roll or photo library. You can then arrange the photos and clips in the order you want, and add transitions, music, and text to create a truly professional-looking slideshow. The app supports a wide range of video formats, so you can be sure that your slideshow will look great no matter where you share it.
Another key feature of SlideShow Maker is the extensive collection of video templates that are available to users. These templates are designed to make the slideshow creation process even easier, as they provide pre-designed layouts, transitions, and effects. The templates cover a wide range of themes, such as birthdays, weddings, holidays, and more. You can also customize the templates to your liking, by adding your own images, music, and text.
In addition to the templates, SlideShow Maker also includes a variety of other tools and features to help you create the perfect slideshow. For example, you can use the app's built-in video editor to crop, trim, and adjust the brightness and color of your videos. You can also add filters, animations, and other special effects to make your slideshow truly unique.
SlideShow Maker also includes a powerful music library, which allows you to choose from a wide range of royalty-free music tracks to add to your slideshow. You can preview the tracks before adding them, and adjust the volume and timing to fit your slideshow perfectly. The app also allows you to add your own music, so you can create a truly customized soundtrack for your slideshow.
Once you have finished creating your slideshow, SlideShow Maker makes it easy to share your creation with others. You can export your slideshow in a range of video formats, and share it directly to social media platforms. You can also save the slideshow to your device's camera roll, or send it to others via email or text message.
In summary, SlideShow Maker is a powerful, easy-to-use app that provides a wide range of tools and features to help you create stunning slideshows. Whether you're looking to create a slideshow for a special occasion, or just want to showcase your favorite photos and videos, SlideShow Maker has everything you need to make your vision a reality. With its extensive collection of video templates, music library, and editing tools, this app is a must-have for anyone who wants to create professional-looking slideshows with ease.
If you have any questions, please contact us: slideshow_app_help@outlook.com

bluejetty:00027268:ios.name: Glow Eve Period Tracker
bluejetty:00027268:ios.summary: Eve by Glow is a savvy period tracker and sex app for women who want to take control of their health and sex lives. Eve predicts your next period and your chances of pregnancy. Track your moods and symptoms to discover trends in your cycles
bluejetty:00027268:ios.description:
Eve by Glow is a savvy period tracker and sex app for women who want to take control of their health and sex lives. Eve predicts your next period and your chances of pregnancy. Track your moods and symptoms to discover trends in your cycles. Own your cycle and feel good in bed. Get it, girl.
PERIOD & HEALTH TRENDS UNLOCKED
+ Log to keep track of sex, moods & symptoms.
+ Quick, elegant logging at any time of day or night.
+ See your health data visualized in beautiful charts.
+ Identify trends and patterns unique to your body.
+ Compatible with the Health App for tracking Sleep, Steps, Walking+Running, Height, Weight, Date of Birth, Water, and of course, menstrual health (Menstruation, Sexual Activity, Spotting).
INTERACTIVE PERIOD & CYCLE TRACKING
+ Fastest and easiest way to track your period.
+ Interactive staircase helps you see your cycle history in a whole new way.
+ Forecast your ovulation and upcoming period with period tracker predictions that are refined over time.
+ Review past periods and menstrual cycles to better understand your cycle.
+ Calendar views on period tracker show your upcoming period.
EPIC COMMUNITY
+ Community provides an extended friend group for discussing sex & health.
+ Ask the community anything--nothing is off limits.
+ Learn from other women who have been there before.
SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION
Eve by Glow is free to download and use. Upgrading to Glow Premium will unlock: 
- Advanced Cycle Chart
- Cycle Analysis
- Comparative Insights
- Forecast
- Advanced BBT chart
- Premium Articles
- Private messaging
- Custom profile
- Premium support
- (More premium features will be coming soon!)
Eve offers quarterly and yearly subscription options: 
- Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at the confirmation of purchase. 
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
- Your iTunes Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. 
- Subscriptions may be managed and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to your Account Settings in iTunes after purchase. 
For full Privacy Policy and our Terms of Service:
https://glowing.com/privacy
https://glowing.com/tos
CONNECT WITH US
Web - http://www.glowing.com
Facebook - http://www.facebook.com/glow
**Note: The information provided by Glow should not replace professional medical advice. Always consult with a healthcare provider for medical advice. If you are having technical issues or have any questions about your cycle or period, we're here to help. Please send us an email to: support@glowing.com

Take charge in Gas Station Simulator Inc., the ultimate game for oil tycoon enthusiasts, idle games managers, and aspiring entrepreneurs!
Manage, rebuild, and expand the gas station simulator, clean up your junkyard, and fix cars in this immersive and rewarding gas station simulator.

Start with a run-down junkyard gas station and transform it into an idle games thriving business, fix a car, clean the road, and pump gas. Clear out the debris, gather resources, and renovate every corner to create the gas station and garage of your dreams of idle games. This is where your tycoon journey begins.

Roll up your sleeves as a tycoon and get under the hood! Upgrade your garage station, repair cars, and keep customers happy with expert service. From tuning engines to fixing up clunkers, it’s your time to shine as the ultimate car mechanic in this business game.

Keep your gas pumps running, assist customers, and grow your business with smart decisions. Expand your services with additional features like a convenience store or car wash, making every visit unforgettable for your clients. Idle games meet tycoon games in the most engaging gas station simulator.
Earn Rewards and Upgrades:
Work hard as an oil tycoon and gas station simulator owner to collect rewards and invest in cutting-edge tools and equipment. Upgrade your operations to increase efficiency and turn your gas station into an idle games booming success. Every business game requires strategy—this one rewards your smartest moves.
Endless Challenges for your Strategy:

Master Your Idle Games Junkyard:
Transform a neglected junkyard into a bustling idle games automotive hub. Organize the space, repurpose old items, and make room for your growing garage tycoon empire. It's a business game that requires vision and skill.
Use your idle games tycoon skills to overcome the challenges of this gas station simulator, pump gas, fix cars, and become a millionaire! Be the gas station simulator boss in the most exciting tycoon games experience.
Whether you're into junkyard car repairs, idle games management, or simply love creating a gas station from scratch, Gas Station Simulator Inc. offers endless opportunities for fun and growth. Dive into the action and start building your business game empire today in the best gas station simulator, idle games and tycoon games combo available!

bluejetty:00025505:ios.description:
Are you ready for a wild and entertaining adventure? Join Annie on her pursuit to win over the love of her life in the game, Annie's Pursuit! This game is jam-packed with exciting features that will keep you hooked for hours on end. From makeovers to home decorations, from solo match games to PVP battles, this game has it all!
Annie was just a regular freshman at St. Philips Academy until she met Nate. Nate was the smartest and most popular boy in school, and Annie couldn't help but fall head over heels for him. Unfortunately, three mean girls had other plans for Annie. They bullied her and made her life miserable, forcing her to stay away from Nate.
But Annie wasn't going to let these girls get in the way of true love. With the help of her friends, she set out on a mission to win over Nate's heart. And that's where you come in!
In Annie's Pursuit, you'll start by playing match 3 levels to earn coins and boosters. Use these coins to buy decorations for Annie's room and outfits for her dates with Nate. You'll also have to help Annie with her makeup and hair so she can look her best for Nate.
But it's not all about looks in Annie's Pursuit. You'll also have to help Annie with her studies so she can impress Nate with her intelligence. Battle with other players, or cooperate with others to complete goals to earn extra coins and boosters.
As you progress through the game, you'll encounter the mean girls who bullied Annie. Show them who's boss by beating them in match 3 levels and earning rewards!
And don't worry, you won't be alone in this adventure. Annie has a group of loyal friends who will help her every step of the way. They'll give her advice on what to wear, help her with her makeup, and even lend her a hand with her studies.
So what are you waiting for? Join Annie on her pursuit to win over the love of her life in the game, Annie's Pursuit! With its fun and addictive gameplay, hilarious storyline, and exciting features, this game is sure to become your new obsession. Download it now and start playing!

bluejetty:00073717:ios.description:
Block and limit screen time.
Keep kids safe and focused with the most comprehensive and easy to use parental control app for devices in home and on the go.
Circle Parental Controls App gives parents screen time control whether kids are playing their favorite online game, connecting with friends or doing schoolwork. Circle goes beyond setting Screen Time Limits and Filters with additional parental control features like Pause, History, Rewards and Bedtime. Parents can customize screen time and WiFi control based on their kids’ ages and their own family preferences, and even limit or block social media.
SCREEN TIME PARENTAL CONTROL APP
• Filter: Choose appropriate (or block inappropriate) content by age with web filters. Even block social media.
• Time Limits: Set daily screen time limits for popular apps and sites.
• Pause the Internet®: Make the Internet stop for every family member (or just one).
MONITOR AND KEEP TRACK OF ONLINE TIME
• History: Check out sites kids visited (or tried to visit) throughout the day. Or go back as far as you’d like for screen monitoring and phone monitoring.
• Usage: Get a complete picture of your family’s Internet use, across all devices
• Location: Keep track of your kids through their mobile devices. Monitor kids’ phones to keep them safe.
BALANCE TIME ONLINE AND OFFLINE
• Bedtime: Ensure your kids get the sleep they need. Set a bedtime for connected devices.
• Rewards: Celebrate good behavior by giving a little extra online time just for the day.
• Focus Time: Schedule distraction-free Internet time for school, homework or offline time.
Start managing your family’s online screen time today with a free trial to access all the parental control app features like WiFi blocker, app blocker and other premium parental control app and screen time control features. Circle’s WiFi manager, Internet and website blocker, and mobile device management make for the most robust screen time parental control app available.
Kids can use the Circle parental control app to keep track of their own screen time online with a personalized dashboard. 
THE ULTIMATE PARENTAL CONTROL APP
Over 90% of Circle parental control app users say it helps keep their kids safe online and makes it easier to manage screen time in their family. 
————
Circle Home Plus — sold separately
Need an in-home device to manage online screen time on smart TVs, video game consoles, and computers? Manage all Wi-Fi connected devices in your home with the Circle Home Plus parental control device - universal parental control at home and away! Learn more: meetcircle.com
The Circle Parental Controls App is not for use with Circle with Disney or Circle on Netgear routers.
————
Need Help?
If you have any parental control app questions, need help with the Circle parental control app, or want to provide feedback, please contact our Support Team:
help@meetcircle.com
help.meetcircle.com
————
Subscription Pricing & Terms
A Circle subscription is required and gives your family access to every Circle parental control feature.
Circle Subscription comes with a FREE trial period (for new premium members only). 
The Circle subscription is an automatic renewing subscription. Your subscription will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase and will automatically renew unless auto-renewal is disabled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Subscriptions are billed at the start of each period and cannot be refunded. Subscribers can manage subscriptions and disable auto-renewal by visiting their iTunes Account Settings after purchase.
Privacy policy: https://meetcircle.com/privacy/
Terms of use: https://meetcircle.com/license/

bluejetty:00120756:ios.summary:
We make math fun & engaging. Over 40 Million kids use the SplashLearn program to Boost Confidence, Increase Scores & Get Ahead in Math & Reading. 
SplashLearn is a comprehensive and curriculum aligned math & reading program that reinforces
bluejetty:00120756:ios.description:
We make math fun & engaging. Over 40 Million kids use the SplashLearn program to Boost Confidence, Increase Scores & Get Ahead in Math & Reading. 
SplashLearn is a comprehensive and curriculum aligned math & reading program that reinforces math & reading concepts using self-paced and adaptive practice.
***Awards & Recognition's for SplashLearn Series***
SplashLearn Program is currently used by over 40 million kids and has bagged several prestigious awards.
• Winner of “Gold Stevie Award” in “Education and Reference” category
• Winner of “Tabby Awards” in “Best Education and Training App” category
• Winner of “Best Elementary Student App” by BestAppEver.com
• Featured in Apple lists - “Staff Favourite”, “New and Newsworthy”
*** REVIEWS ***
“School may be out, but students looking to brush up on their math skills will be hard pressed to find a better tool than Splash Math. It was charming, instructive, comprehensive and spoke to kids at the perfect level. There’s a reason this is an Apple Staff Favorite.” – CBSLocal.com
“Parents need to know that 1st Grade Splash Math Game lets kids practice first-grade level Common Core math skills in an entertaining way. Kids earn little origami fish for their "aquariums" as they go.” 
- CommonSenseMedia.org
***Key Features of 1st Grade SplashLearn***
+ Self-paced math practice program
+ Explanation for wrong answers
+ Scratchpad for rough work
+ Virtual rewards and games
+ Monitor progress with real-time progress dashboard
+ Progress synced across multiple iPhones, iPods, iPads, desktops and laptops.
*** TOPICS COVERED ***
This app covers following topics:
1. Addition - Add numbers within 20 using pictures and models
2. Subtraction - Subtract numbers within 20
3. Advanced Addition - Add three numbers within 20 and solve word problems involving addition
4. Advanced Subtraction - Subtract to compare and solve word problems involving subtraction
5. Mixed Operations - Fact families and missing numbers in addition and subtraction equation
6. Place Value - Work with basic concepts of place value involving amounts of tens and ones in two digit numbers
7. Counting and Comparison - Count to 120 and compare and order numbers two digit numbers based understanding of place value
8. Time - Read and set time in hours and half-hours using clocks
9. Measurements - Measure lengths of objects using smaller objects and order three objects based on length
10. Addition Facts - Add 1, 2, 3...9 to another number
11. Subtraction Facts - Subtract 1, 2, 3...9 from another number
12. Data and Graphs - Analyze and organize data in up to three categories using charts and picture graphs
13. Geometry - Recognize shapes based on defining attributes and partition circle and rectangles into halves and fourths
14. Money - Identify coins and their values and count money using coins
***Reading Program Overview***
Children begin by spellings through fun games. They also pick up sight words through fun games and learn to read decodable books. The Reading program also offers a variety of bedtime stories and books, so reading becomes a daily habit for young learners. We have games to improve the Reading skills of the child and we make Reading Comprehensions Fun! 
***Subscription Plans***
• Plans: Monthly, Quarterly, Yearly (subject to change)
• Free Trial: We offer a free trial period for all plans.
• Cancel Anytime: No charges if plan cancelled before end of trial period.
• Renewal: Auto-renewal may be turned off anytime from Account Settings. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
• Privacy Policy: https://www.splashmath.com/privacy
• Terms of Use: https://www.splashmath.com/terms-of-use
***Refund Policy***
User can cancel subscription & auto-renew anytime and no further credit card charges will be made from next billing cycle. No full or partial refund of the current subscription is offered for the active subscription period.
