bluejetty:00026610:ios.name: MyLabcorp
bluejetty:00026610:ios.summary: Get personalized explanations of your health data from Labcorp and answers to questions about your lab results, trends over time, and more with our built-in AI experience. Gain health insights to better understand your recent blood work, su
bluejetty:00026610:ios.description:
Get personalized explanations of your health data from Labcorp and answers to questions about your lab results, trends over time, and more with our built-in AI experience. Gain health insights to better understand your recent blood work, such as why your cholesterol levels may be changing, or ask questions about nutrition and learn which food groups to prioritize for a healthier diet. MyLabcorp provides real-time information designed to help you achieve desired health goals and better prepare for conversations with your healthcare provider. 
MyLabcorp also features the same easy Labcorp patient portal experience you know and love. Securely view your Labcorp test results, schedule appointments, and review and pay invoices in one convenient place. 
Note: MyLabcorp is designed to support understanding and wellness and does not provide medical diagnoses or treatment recommendations. Always consult a qualified healthcare professional with medical questions or concerns. 
Key Features
• Easy migration - MyLabcorp replaces the Labcorp Patient™ mobile app. Use your existing credentials to log in—all your secure Labcorp health data is waiting for you. 
• Convenient access to all your Labcorp health - Check your current and past Labcorp results and health profile via our secure mobile app—anytime, anywhere—with the same features you’ve been using in the Labcorp patient portal. Easily view your Labcorp test results, schedule appointments, view bills, and gain health insights you can discuss with your provider at your next healthcare visit. 
• AI-powered insights in a healthcare setting - Ask questions and receive real-time answers from an AI experience designed to support your understanding of your body and health. MyLabcorp’s AI chat feature lets you explore your test results within a HIPAA-compliant system, unlike general-purpose AI tools, which aren’t built to protect health data or limit how it’s used. 
• Privacy and security you can trust - Labcorp takes privacy seriously. Your personal and medical information is protected by Labcorp security controls and used only in accordance with HIPAA.
• Track and monitor health data over time - View your Labcorp test results and health data, dating back up to 15 years, alongside standard result ranges. This can help identify topics you may need to discuss further with your healthcare provider. 
• Gain new insight into your health - Deep dive into 12 key health areas that provide an educational overview to help you better understand and manage your health. You can also receive content authored by Labcorp's clinical team and read clinically guided education to learn more about your specific results. 
Who it’s for 
• People looking to easily manage their Labcorp visits and related services  
• People reviewing their lab results and wanting clearer explanations  
• People wanting to better understand trends in their health data  
• People seeking general, plain-language health information as they prepare for conversations with their healthcare provider  
• People interested in better understanding their health and building individual health literacy

bluejetty:00156797:ios.description:

- Parcel signing: By scanning the QR code or manually inputting the information, consignee can complete the signing of parcels, which can ensure the timeliness of parcel signing and service quality.
- Exception handling: By scanning the QR code or manually inputting information, last mile couriers can real-time record the abnormal information and handle the parcels
In addition, [GOFO Driver] also supports the functions such as data statistics and user information display, which can help users understand the overall situation of the logistics information and improve logistics management.

bluejetty:00182587:ios.description:
SOS game is now on App Store. SOS is a puzzle similar to tic tac toe or XOX but it is a more advanced one and requires more strategic thinking and attention. Enjoy SOS game for free!
Achieve a high score and it will be published on the online leaderboard.
How to play SOS game?
- You can play this game against your IOS device.
- SOS is played in turns.
- You can watch your turn from the top panel.
- When it is your turn, tap on a tile where you want to put a letter.
- Select S or O letter from the dialog.
- If you complete an SOS, vertically, horizontally or diagonal, it is your turn again until you cannot make an SOS.
- Then other player takes the turn.
- You get 1 point for each SOS.
- Player who makes more SOS wins the game.
- Depending on the your SOS series and combos, your final score will be calculated and sent to online leaderboard if you signed in to Game Center.
Enjoy!

Your dad invited you to celebrate, trick-or-treat, play detective games with him in your hometown. You’re excited for your reunion, but your joy is quickly overshadowed by eerie creatures invading your home! It’s up to you to solve lots of seek and find games and puzzles and delve into your family’s secret history to stop the monsters. Do you have what it takes to save the town from a terrible fate before it’s too late? Find out in this mysterious thrilling game - Halloween Chronicles: Monsters Among Us Collector’s Edition!
· SAVE YOUR HOMETOWN FROM DANGEROUS MONSTERS!

· STOP GHOSTS FROM USING A MAGIC CAMERA IN THE BONUS GAME!
Your magic camera gets stolen by mysterious ghosts in the Bonus Chapter! Now it’s up to you to go through tons of hidden object games we can offer! Play them and solve spooky riddles to stop the ghosts from killing everyone!
· COLLECTIBLE PHOTOS, INTERVIEWS, AND FILMS TO FIND!
Like most of the search and find games, this game has everything you’d enjoy apart from the main playing process. In this version of Halloween Chronicles: Monsters Among Us Collector’s Edition, you may also collect morphing objects, film rolls, interesting interviews, as well as download wallpapers, replay your favorite games and enjoy concept arts!
Download one of the most amazing free hidden object games – Chronicles: Monsters Among Us! Play the game for absolutely free, but if you feel stuck or don’t want to solve a mini-game, you may buy hints to help you proceed quicker!

bluejetty:00179934:ios.name: Skincare Routine
bluejetty:00179934:ios.summary:
Personalised Skin Tracker & Layering Guide – No Subscription!
One-off purchase • Automatically orders your AM/PM routine • Avoids ingredient conflicts • Diary with photos.
Transform your skincare and beauty regimen with a personalized rout
bluejetty:00179934:ios.description:
Personalised Skin Tracker & Layering Guide – No Subscription!
One-off purchase • Automatically orders your AM/PM routine • Avoids ingredient conflicts • Diary with photos.
Transform your skincare and beauty regimen with a personalized routine! Skincare Routine helps you discover the best order to apply your skincare and makeup products, track your usage, and achieve your best skin ever.
The app comes pre-loaded with DECIEM (The Ordinary, NIOD, Hylamide & Fountain) products but you can add any skin treatments from any brand including Drunk Elephant, Pixi Beauty, Paula's Choice, The Inkey List and any of your favourite brands!
Note: The app price is a one-off payment and there are currently no subscriptions or recurring payments.
*** Key App Features ***
• CREATE YOUR ROUTINE
Add products to your routine. They will be automatically placed in your AM and/or PM routine as recommended.
• ADD CUSTOM PRODUCTS
You can add custom skincare products from other brands by selecting the option in the top-right menu in the Routine section or from the Custom tab in the Products section.
• USE YOUR ROUTINE FOR LAYERING ADVICE
The products are listed in the recommended layering order, along with advice for when and how to use each product.
• KEEP TRACK OF USAGE TO AVOID CONFLICTS
Each morning and evening, check each product off your list to keep track of which treatments you have used. This will allow the app to prevent any conflicts by showing you which products should be avoided.
• TRACK YOUR SKIN'S PROGRESS
Any time you notice your skin is looking particularly good or bad, you can make a note of it by pressing on the face icon next to the morning or evening routine. You can also add a comment to note down more details for your own record and add photos to track your progress.
• ADD PHOTOS
You can add photos of your skin to your diary tracker and also add photos of custom products.
• REMINDERS & TIMERS
You can set up notifications to remind you about your daily skin regimen. You can also set timers for products which require a specific wait time. Both can be found in the Settings.
*** Advanced App Customisation ***
• RE-ORDER YOUR ROUTINE
If you don't wish to follow the recommended layering order, you can choose to re-order the products to fully customise your routine by selecting the option from the top right menu (with 3 dots) of the Routine section. You can also change the order of the layer steps, for instance DECIEM recommends oils before moisturisers but some users prefer the other way around.
• USE CONFLICTING PRODUCTS
When we recommend not using a product due to conflicts with other products or because you've reached the usage limit, you can choose to ignore the warning and use it anyway. You will then have the option to permanently ignore conflicts on that specific product.
• SCHEDULE PRODUCTS
You can choose specific days of the week for a product if you wish. For instance, you may wish to make it so that the "AHA 30% + BHA 2% Peeling Solution" only appears in your routine on Tuesdays and Fridays.
You can also choose dates of the month, e.g. the 1st and 15th of every month.
Another useful option is to schedule products for every X days, so you could choose every 2 days to alternate.
*** Recommended for skin concerns... ***
• Dry & Dehydrated Skin: Achieve plump, healthy-looking hydrated skin.
• Acne-Prone Skin: Reduce inflammation to help support clear skin.
• Blemishes & Congestion: Reduce inflammation and brighten the skin.
• Sensitive Skin: Keep your skin moisturised with this gentle routine.
• Mature Skin & Wrinkles: Promote youthful skin and reduce the signs of ageing.
• Pigmentation Problems: Gently exfoliate and brighten skin tone.
• Oily Skin: Rebalance your skin for a healthy, fresh look.
Please note, Skincare Routine (previously known as "Skincare Regimen Organiser") has no connection with DECIEM, The Ordinary or any other skincare brand.

bluejetty:00087337:ios.description:
Corah is a relaxing semi-idle MMORPG. Explore a new fantasy world with no ads, no energy system and a vibrant community. Return to the era of classic games with simple 2d UI and retro MMO feels. With no level cap and no pay to win, Corah is the mobile MMORPG of 2026.
Corah seeks to revive the old school MMORPG feeling on mobile. Relax while your character does the rest. Play as any of four classes, each with three sub-classes. Hunt monsters, collect equipment, increase your stats and skills, and play in real time with other players. Manage your game, don’t control it. Corah avoids annoying mobile controls and allows you to chill while your characters do everything.
Explore a vibrant fantasy world in Corah. Increase your character’s stats and skills as you hunt monsters, join castle raids and level up. Collect and upgrade equipment to better outfit your character. Earn daily rewards and achievements as you continue playing. Get pets for your character and increase their stats and upgrade them to best help you level up.
Join a guild and play with others, just like in popular, old-school MMORPGs. Explore a fully player-driven economy with the Player Market and party up with other players and participate in the Castle Siege, Guild Raids and more in real time. Trade, chat and play online with friends and join a community of classic MMORPG fans.
Relax and start your next idle adventure today. Join the Corah community and play to win.
RETRO MMORPG THEMES
- Choose from four classes & twelve subclasses
- Relax as you level up with idle gameplay
- Join a Guild & play online with others
- Upgrade your Pets & Equipment
ONLINE FEATURES
- Join a guild & party up to take on Castle Sieges & Guild Raids
- Add friends & chat with other players
- Trade items with friends & in the Player Market
- Fight battles with guild members & friends in real time
IDLE GAMEPLAY
- Start a battle or raid & let your character do all the work
- No need for active battle controls
- Simple UI & lack of energy mechanic enhances the idle RPG experience
Join our Discord and be a part of the Corah community:
https://discord.gg/RBFAjvpYqC
Privacy Policy:
https://sites.google.com/view/wflpp/home

bluejetty:00148594:ios.description:
After years of being stuck at home, it’s time to get on a plane and travel!
New airport and airlines. Build the airport step by step and manage the airlines. It's time to travel the world!
This is an idle management game that uses the airport as the management location. As a manager, you need to give full play to your talents and build your own airport!
Game features:
- Airport simulation game.
Simulate the construction of an airport and add additional facilities/stores such as restaurants, restrooms, convenience stores, bookstores, etc.
You will be responsible for the entire process of check-in, security check, and boarding.
-Route construction, city simulation.
Expand routes to Hong Kong, Singapore, Shanghai, Tokyo and other cities. Explore and invest in destination cities, unlock numerous city facilities, and discover unique city landmarks!
-Casual idle games, a variety of classic mini-games.
The game uses vertical screen placement. This is a relaxing game that allows you to experience the entrepreneurial experience of an aviation tycoon without too much effort. The game has various mini-games such as Monopoly, match-2 games, flip and matching games, and more!
-Manage flights to enhance your travel experience.
The game has an independent world time system built into it, and each flight operates according to its schedule. The sun rises and sets outside the terminal, which is always brightly lit. Each destination city has its own seasonal weather, and in addition to graphical representations, different types of weather have different impacts on flight safety.
- Reasonable arrangement of flight attendants.
Hundreds of flight attendants can be recruited to arrange appropriate routes. Improve technology and service levels and create high-quality routes. After each flight, passengers rate their experience. Always pay attention to the evaluation and make targeted improvements. Passengers occasionally chat about their journeys. Are you ready to hear their stories?
Email: Publishing@topspeedhunter.com

bluejetty:00156896:ios.name: ASL Speed Spell
bluejetty:00156896:ios.summary: ASL Speed Spell allows American Sign Language learners to improve their fingerspelling speed. Whether you're newer to the ASL alphabet or have been studying for years, this free app can help learners at all levels understand fingerspelling
bluejetty:00156896:ios.description:
ASL Speed Spell allows American Sign Language learners to improve their fingerspelling speed. Whether you're newer to the ASL alphabet or have been studying for years, this free app can help learners at all levels understand fingerspelling faster and with better accuracy.
How is this ASL app different from the rest? Each fingerspelled word is individually recorded as its own video, so you can watch smoothly fingerspelled words at the speed of your choice. Plus, you can choose among several categories, like 'names', 'animals', and 'countries', to help add context to the word!
App Features:
- Practice fingerspelling over 500 words, each with their own video.
- Can't figure out the answer? Replay the video, or 'give up' to see what the word was.
- Adjust the speed of your practice - from Beginner all the way up to Expert.
- Choose which category of words you want to practice, so you have context behind the word.
- Forget how to sign a letter? The ‘alphabet’ page shows you each letter from multiple perspectives, including common variations.
- The Statistics page helps you keep track of your streaks, word counts, and more.
- Adjust your settings for daily practice reminders, statistics, and more. 
- Not a fan of ads? A small one-time in-app purchase removes ads from the app forever.
This app offers a paid premium option, available as either a monthly subscription or a one-time lifetime purchase. For the subscription option, subscriptions renew within 24 hours of the subscription period ending, and a subscription purchase will be charged through your iTunes account. Manage at any time using Account Settings in iTunes. Privacy Policy and Terms of Use can be found at https://www.aslspeedspell.com/privacy.php

bluejetty:00026812:ios.summary:
One app for Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and PDF. Work faster with AI and familiar tools, with files synced across phones, tablets, and computers.
Scan, convert, sign, and share documents wherever you work. WPS AI helps you summarize files, ana
bluejetty:00026812:ios.description:
One app for Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and PDF. Work faster with AI and familiar tools, with files synced across phones, tablets, and computers.
Scan, convert, sign, and share documents wherever you work. WPS AI helps you summarize files, analyze content, and create presentations faster.
ALL YOUR DOCUMENTS, ONE WPS
• Documents: Create, read, and edit Word-compatible files with familiar formatting tools.
• Spreadsheets: View and edit Excel-compatible spreadsheets wherever you work.
• Presentations: Create, review, and update PowerPoint-compatible presentations.
• File Compatibility: Work with common Office and PDF formats without switching between multiple apps.
PDF TOOLS FOR EVERYDAY WORK
• Read & Edit: View, annotate, fill, sign, and organize PDF files.
• Convert: Convert supported Office files to PDF for easier sharing and delivery.
• Work on the Go: Review and update PDFs directly from your phone or tablet.
SCAN, EXTRACT, AND DIGITIZE
• Document Scanner: Scan documents, receipts, notes, and business cards.
• Advanced OCR: Extract text from images and scanned documents for editing and reuse.
• Image Enhancement: Improve scan clarity and reduce blur, shadows, and unwanted marks.
WORK ACROSS YOUR DEVICES
• Pick Up Anywhere: Access and edit your files across phones, tablets, and computers.
• Keep Files in Sync: Continue working across devices without repeatedly sending files to yourself.
• One Familiar Workspace: Manage your Office documents and PDFs with WPS wherever you work.
WPS AI: GET DOCUMENT WORK DONE FASTER
• Ask & Analyze: Find key information in lengthy PDFs, documents, and complex spreadsheets.
• Summarize: Turn long files and reports into concise takeaways.
• Write & Rewrite: Draft, rewrite, and polish emails, reports, and other content.
• Translate: Understand and work with content across languages.
AI SLIDES: FROM IDEA TO EDITABLE PRESENTATION
• Create from a Prompt: Turn a topic or outline into a structured presentation.
• Smart Layout: Let AI organize and format your slides.
• Continue Editing: Refine the generated content and layout before sharing.
SUPPORTED OFFICE FILE FORMATS
• 51 languages supported worldwide.
• Supports a wide range of office and development file formats:
DOC, DOCX, WPT, DOTM, DOCM, DOT, DOTX
XLS, XLSX, XLT, XLTX, CSV, XML, ET, ETT
PDF
PPT, POT, DPS, DPT, PPTX, POTX, PPSX
TXT
LOG, LRC, C, CPP, H, ASM, S, JAVA, ASP, BAT, BAS, PRG, CMD
ZIP
OPTIMIZED FOR iOS PERFORMANCE
• Engineered for fast and stable mobile performance.
• Designed to reduce lag during demanding document tasks.
AUTO-RENEW SUBSCRIPTION
Choose from 1-month, 3-month, or 1-year auto-renewal options. Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account upon purchase confirmation. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing period. You can manage or turn off auto-renewal anytime in your Apple ID account settings. Cancellations will take effect after the current active subscription period ends.
PRIVACY & TERMS
Privacy Policy: https://www.wps.com/privacy-policy/
Auto-Renew Terms: https://www.wps.com/auto-renewal-terms/

GoCal - Your AI diet coach and calorie tracking expert
Say goodbye to manual diet recording! Just take a photo to start scientific diet management! GoCal combines AI visual recognition and professional nutrition algorithms to provide you with a one-stop solution of "photographing food - calorie estimation - diet planning - daily intake analysis", making calorie control, fat loss and nutritional balance simple and efficient.
- Core function highlights
AI photo recognition, nutrition analysis and recording in seconds
Take a photo of the meal, AI automatically identifies the food type, estimates calories and weight, and simultaneously generates protein, fat, and carbon water intake data, so that the nutritional status of each meal is clear at a glance.

Understanding diet is the key to success. Automatically compare recommended intake with actual data, highlight abnormal indicators (such as excessive sodium, insufficient dietary fiber), and use visual charts to present nutritional gaps, so that dietary adjustments can be traced.
From today, let GoCal's AI coach help you say goodbye to blind dieting and use data to drive healthy choices. Whether it is fat loss and body shaping, muscle gain and weight gain, or balanced diet, you can find exclusive solutions here!

bluejetty:00141704:ios.description:
Step into a magical realm where love, adventure, and mystery intertwine! The circus is in town, bringing with it a whirlwind of secrets and surprises. What does fate hold for you in "Royal Romances: Fortunes and Foes"?Unravel the secrets of the Enchanted Forest, seek and find hidden objects, and meet a cast of unforgettable characters. Dive into our hidden object games, where romantic games and thrilling adventure games collide. Can you find objects in pictures and solve the puzzles that await? Only you can decide the fate of kingdoms!
The reign of cruel King Illeon has come to an end. Love triumphed over evil, and peaceful times have returned to the land. But there are new adventures ahead for our heroes. In the depths of the Enchanted Forest, you encounter a dragon. Fear not, it's only a hatchling! What do you do with it? Of course, you cannot tell a single living soul about your lucky find. Especially when a traveling circus has stopped on its way to a performance at the royal palace, attracting the attention of a thousand eyes. Or maybe just enjoy the show!
Shape the Fate of Kingdoms!
Immerse yourself in an engaging story where romantic games meet high-stakes drama. Build relationships, make life-changing choices, and see how your actions affect the fates of kingdoms and characters alike. It's the perfect blend of hidden object games and romance-filled adventures!
Solve Intricate Puzzles!
Engage in a variety of casual hidden object games that test your logic and creativity. From mystery games to clever find objects in a picture games, each puzzle is designed to be both rewarding and relaxing. Unlock special achievements as you progress in adventure games!
Collect & Explore!
Enjoy hours of exploration as you seek and find hidden objects while discovering collectible items, secret pathways, and breathtaking visuals. This blend of hidden object games and romantic games will keep you engaged with its charming characters and thrilling twists!
Beautiful Locations!
Seek and find hidden objects across beautifully crafted environments, from the magical Enchanted Forest to the bustling circus grounds. Perfect for fans of hidden object games, every scene is packed with intricate details. Explore the vibrant world and find objects in pictures to uncover the secrets hidden in plain sight!
Discover the ultimate free-to-play experience with "Royal Romances: Fortunes and Foes" and start your adventure right away!
-----

Find other games on our official website: https://dominigames.com/

bluejetty:00157247:ios.summary: Pelipost is the simplest way to send photos, letters, greeting cards, phonebooks, and more to your incarcerated loved one. Upload from your phone and we handle the printing, the postage, and the facility rules for you. Every item you send i
bluejetty:00157247:ios.description:
Pelipost is the simplest way to send photos, letters, greeting cards, phonebooks, and more to your incarcerated loved one. Upload from your phone and we handle the printing, the postage, and the facility rules for you. Every item you send is one more reason for them to smile at mail call.
Pelipost is more than photos. Send greeting cards, photo cards, letters, and postcards to the people you love, all from one app.
FOUNDED BY SON AND MOM
When our co-founder Becky was incarcerated, the one thing she asked her family for was photos. Getting them to her meant navigating confusing facility rules and constant guesswork. Becky and her son Joe built Pelipost so no family has to struggle the way theirs did. Today Pelipost keeps hundreds of thousands of families connected across the country.
HOW IT WORKS
1. Download the app and add your loved one.
2. Choose photos, a card, or a letter.
3. We print and mail it, following each facility's rules for you.
WHAT YOU CAN SEND
- Photo prints
- Greeting cards
- Photo cards
- Letters
- Postcards
WHY FAMILIES CHOOSE PELIPOST
- Trusted by 500,000+ families
- 50+ million items delivered
- Works with 4,000+ correctional facilities nationwide
- A reminder from home that they are loved and not forgotten
- Earn PeliPOINTS on every order and redeem them for free prints
- A community of loved ones who understand what you are going through
It was from their struggle that Pelipost came to be.
Download the Photos-to-Prison App® today, start connecting with your loved ones, and experience the fastest, most reliable photo-sharing service in the industry.
If you have questions about our service or issues with your order, contact our award-winning Customer Support Team. You can message us at support@pelipost.com, and we’re happy to answer any questions you may have.

Pass your ASE with flying colors! Boost your confidence in passing the first time with our mobile app and a personal study plan based on your current skill and requirements.

- Choose from different topics required to pass a certification
- Practice with 1700+ questions
- Track your strengths and weaknesses within Stats section of the app
- Study detailed statistics of every test you take
- Compare your score to the community average for almost any type of exam
- - - -

You need to buy a lifetime access or subscribe to get access to all features, courses and questions. The cost of the purchase is charged to your iTunes account. Subscriptions are auto-renewable and are billed at the rate and period selected depending on the subscription plan. Users’ accounts are charged for auto-renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period.
Subscriptions can be managed and auto-renewal can be turned off in Account Settings in iTunes after the purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.

bluejetty:00175084:ios.description:
Personalize and send beautiful invitations and greeting cards for FREE with Punchbowl®. Choose from thousands of party invitations including the largest selection of kids character invites. Exclusive designs feature Mickey Mouse, Frozen, Elmo, Bluey, PAW Patrol, Peppa Pig, Spider-Man & more! Invite guests by email or text and track RSVPs on-the-go. Send thoughtful free eCards for birthdays, holidays, or to say thank you! The MUST HAVE app for busy parents, Punchbowl has been featured in publications such as Parents, Real Simple, O Magazine, Ladies' Home Journal, and Women's Health.
FIND THE PERFECT INVITATION:
• Thousands of beautiful online invitations
• ‘Characters Kids Love’ collection features hundreds of beloved, iconic characters from Disney, Hasbro, Marvel, Mattel, Nickelodeon, Sesame Street & Universal
• ‘Handmade Art’ collection features hand-crafted designs
• Popular categories include Birthdays, Baby Showers, Bridal Showers, Graduation, Weddings, Halloween, Thanksgiving, Christmas & New Year's
PERSONALIZE & SEND INVITES ON THE GO:
• Best invitation maker for all your celebrations
• Add a photo to select designs
• Quickly build Guest Lists with convenient import options
• Send party invitations online by email or text message
MANAGE ONLINE INVITATIONS WITH RSVP:
• Track RSVPs in real time from the app
• Add more guests, follow-up with anyone who hasn't responded
• Chat with guests one-on-one or broadcast announcements to your entire list
• Add a Potluck List, Poll, Co-Host & more
RSVP TO INVITATIONS:
• Respond to email invitations or text invitations as a guest
• View the guest list, get directions, see To-Do Items from the host
DELIVER GREETING CARDS BY TEXT OR EMAIL:
• Gorgeous free ecards with the look and feel of a traditional paper greeting card
• Popular categories include Birthday, Thank You, Valentine's Day, Mother's Day, Father's Day & Christmas
• Deliver a thoughtful gift card inside your greeting
• Add a heartfelt video message to any card
• Upload a photo to select designs & personalize your message with our card maker
• Send cards by email or text instantly, or schedule for delivery later
DIGITAL GIFT CARDS
• Gift cards are redeemed directly with the selected retailer in the USA only and can’t be used for in-app purchases
• Recipients receive a secure redemption link via email or text
PAID SUBSCRIPTION OPTIONS:
• A subscription unlocks exclusive designs and benefits such as the ability to upload a photo to your design, add a video message to a card, collaborate with a co-host, poll your guests, schedule a card, or remove advertising
• Plus subscriptions are available for $5.99/month or $47.99/year
• Premium subscriptions are available for $19.99/month or $71.99/year
• Platinum subscriptions are available for $29.99/month or $95.99/year
• Extra subscriptions are available for $35.99/year
• Advanced subscriptions are available for $47.99/year
• Preferred subscriptions are available for $59.99/year

bluejetty:00142739:ios.description:
Your music library is a journal — years of exploration, shifting taste, precious memories, playlists you've lived inside. Hezel keeps it all safe.
Back up your entire library — songs, playlists, and music videos — in seconds. If anything ever disappears, restore it in a tap.
Taking a break from Apple Music? Park your music with Hezel, keeping it safe until you're ready to return.
Switching to a new account? AirDrop your backup to another device and restore your library exactly as it was.
Starting fresh? Clear out your old library without losing the playlists you care about.
Curious about your music journey? Revisit past backups and play your old Replay playlists — right from Hezel.
Hezel Ultra goes further:
• Automatically back up your library every few days, all seamlessly in the background.
• Export your backup as a CSV file and dig into your data.
• Manage your backups, bookmark the important ones, and set smart storage limits.
Heads up:
Hezel can only restore music added from Apple Music or matched by iTunes. Songs added as MP3 files through iTunes can't be recovered.
Terms of Service: https://hezel.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://hezel.app/privacy

bluejetty:00095233:ios.description:
Avatone is a fitness app and workout tracker that transforms your real progress into a powerful fitness avatar. Whether you're training at the gym, running, or starting your fitness journey, Avatone helps you stay motivated with visual progress tracking, personalized goals, and an engaging leveling system.
Why Athletes Choose Avatone
Fitness App + Workout Tracker: 
Log your workouts, reps, sets, and cardio sessions with a clean and intuitive interface.
Avatar Fitness System: 
Every workout powers up your avatar—get stronger, leaner, and more defined as you progress.
Strength Training & Cardio Tracking: 
Track weightlifting, running, bodyweight exercises, and more.
Real-Time Performance Insights: 
View metrics, charts, and trends to understand how your workouts improve your performance.
Motivation Through Visualization: 
See instant feedback on your fitness avatar as you hit milestones and complete workouts.
Customizable Fitness Goals: 
Set goals for reps, weight, distance, calories burned, or workout streaks.
Engaging Progress Experience: 
Celebrate every level-up, streak, and achievement as your avatar evolves.
Supportive Fitness Community: 
Share your progress, connect with others, and stay accountable together.
Workout History Log: 
Revisit past workouts and track long-term improvement over time.
 A Workout Tracker Designed for Everyone
Whether you're lifting at the gym, training at home, or running outdoors, Avatone gives you the tools to stay consistent and motivated. Log workouts, track goals, and watch your avatar transform as your fitness improves.
Level up your fitness avatar. Track workouts. Stay motivated.
Avatone makes your fitness journey visual, rewarding, and fun!

AMAZING WORLDS
Jump across the legendary Green Hill Zone or take to new worlds including Mountain, Jungle, Blue Sky & Mechanical Zones.
STORY AND ARCADE MODES
Leap through 48 different levels on a quest to stop the evil Dr. Eggman or Jump until you drop in the infinite Arcade Mode.
FUN CHALLENGES AND QUESTS

CHALLENGE THE WORLD
Compete against players across the world to see who can jump highest in Arcade Mode or set epic scores on global leaderboards.

bluejetty:00068676:ios.description:
Got tired of unwanted calls, telemarketers, and scammers spoofing your phone number?
WideProtect blocks spam and scam calls using phone number prefixes and patterns — block up to 1 billion numbers, covering 100 area codes in the USA.
Free to try for 3 days, with a restricted phone number count.
PROTECTION FEATURES
- Block calls by prefix or pattern — stop spoofed numbers, robocalls, and telemarketers before they reach you.
- Pre-configured prefixes for the UK, Germany, France, the Netherlands, Austria, Spain, Switzerland, Chile, and India.
- Add prefixes or patterns for any country, including satellite operators.
- Community-reported spam numbers — benefit from numbers flagged by other WideProtect users.
- One-tap blocking from Phone and Contacts via "Share Contact - Block in WideProtect."
PRIVACY & CONVENIENCE
- No registration, no user data collection — install and use.
- Works completely offline — your number list never leaves your device.
- Family Sharing supported, with a discounted price for the whole household.
- Help screen includes a short video manual.
WideProtect is free to download and try. A subscription or one-time lifetime license is required to continue using the app after the trial.
SETUP
After installing, grant permission to all WideProtect extensions via 'iPhone Settings -> Apps -> Phone -> Call Blocking & Identification.'
IMPORTANT NOTICES
- Don't remove the app from memory while it's updating your blocking list — safe to remove afterward.
- Since iOS 26: if you've called a number yourself, it won't be blocked until you delete that call from 'Phone' -> 'Recent.'
- Blocked calls may be forwarded to voicemail, depending on your mobile operator — contact them for details.
- If WideProtect extensions don't appear in iPhone Settings right away, add your prefix in the app, wait 1-2 minutes, then check Settings again.
- WideProtect is available via auto-renewable subscription or one-time payment. Payment is charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your Account Settings.
FEEDBACK & SUPPORT
Email us at dodatoklab@gmail.com with any questions or issues.

bluejetty:00146465:ios.description:
Alpina app is the companion application for the connected Alpina watches produced by the Swiss watch brand Alpina. 
The app is dedicated exclusively to the MMT SwissConnect powered watches and will allow the user to sync and save the data collected by the Alpina timepiece.
With its easy-to-understand graphics, the app will provide insights on your activity and sleep data per day, week, or month and help you calibrate your goals to reach new heights in your well-being.
The Dynamic Coach will encourage you to perform better and help you better your lifestyle by giving you useful tips based on your recorded information. 
You can also use the Apple Health to share your step and sleep data between the Alpina App and Apple Health. You can manage Apple Health settings in the Apple Health App and turn on reading and writing of steps and sleep analysis.
The functions provided by the watch and app include:
ENVIRONMENT (for AlpinerX watches only)
Altitude
Barometer
GPS (Connected)
Compass
UV Indicator
Temperature
BODY
Activity Tracking
Dynamic Coach
Sleep Monitoring
Smart Alarms (Get-Active Alerts, Sleep Alarm)
TIME & NOTIFICATION
Always on Time & Date (Hours, Minutes, Seconds, Date)
Calls & Messages Notifications
Time Recorder (Stopwatch, Timer, Workouts)
Wordtimer (2nd Time Zone + Local 24h Time)
Battery 2+ years
Cloud Backup and Restore

bluejetty:00173533:ios.name: MixerBox BFF: Location Tracker
bluejetty:00173533:ios.summary: MixerBox BFF is a real-time GPS location sharing app that lets you share your current location with loved ones! Experience location safety features that surpass ordinary GPS tracking apps. More than just a GPS location tracker, MixerBox BFF
bluejetty:00173533:ios.description:
MixerBox BFF is a real-time GPS location sharing app that lets you share your current location with loved ones! Experience location safety features that surpass ordinary GPS tracking apps. More than just a GPS location tracker, MixerBox BFF makes connecting with friends and family easier than ever.
◆More comprehensive location information: Arrival/Departure notifications, 30-day timeline
◆More flexible: Personalized maps to create your own custom locations
What you can do with MixerBox BFF:
•View the real-time location of friends or family members on the map
•See how long they stay at one place
•Receive real-time alerts when friends or family are about to arrive, arrive, or leave home, work, and school
•Get individual driver reports
•Access past location history for your friends or family members
•Send text messages on the map
MixerBox BFF aims to help reduce anxiety about the whereabouts of your loved ones with easy tracking and alerting messages. You can instantly share your location with friends, family, and loved ones, making it easy to see each other's location right away and view information such as speed, battery level, and duration of stay.
◆ Find My Phones!
Lost your phone? Let your friends help you locate and find it on the map. This app is invitation-only, so you can only share your location with friends and family you approve, ensuring security
◆ The World Is Your Oyster!
Through "Your World" and "Footprints," MixerBox BFF automatically records the places and routes you've been to. It helps reminisce about travel memories and daily activities and check favorite travel destinations, frequently visited shops, and facilities. You can also use it as a regular map app. Rebuild your footprint history anytime — no old data needed!
◆ Temporarily Hide Your Location
With "Ghost Mode," you can blur your location or temporarily stop sharing it with specific friends. You have complete control over your location info.
◆ Phone Widget
Add the MixerBox BFF widget to your phone's home screen! Without entering the MixerBox BFF app, you can instantly see the current location of the friends you care about through the widget.
◆ Set Your Own Locations
You can set your favorite locations, such as Home, School, and Workplace! When visiting exciting places, you can check in, tag friends, and add those locations to your personal world map.
◆ Arrival/Departure and Travel Notifications
You will receive notifications when your friends arrive/depart from specific locations or go on long-distance travel, saving time from asking, "Where are you?"
◆ Customize to your preferences
- Map styles: Standard maps, Satellite maps, etc.
- Theme options: Choose from dark styles, cute styles, and more to freely change the style you like!
- Personal status: Change your status anytime, such as "at home," "at work," "having a meal," "traveling," and other fun options.
◆ When can you use MixerBox BFF?
- Emergency safety confirmation.
- When you lose or misplace your phone or when you want to locate the iPhone of your family or friends.
- Keeping an eye on family members living far away.
- Meet up with friends.
- Prevent getting lost from your travel companions during domestic and international travels.
MixerBox BFF is perfect for various situations:)
MixerBox BFF is a map SNS & GPS tracking app that anyone can use! Try it now! If you have any questions or comments, feel free to get in touch with us: bff.support@mixerbox.com
Stay close to the people who matter most. MixerBox BFF is always by your side!
◆ Follow MixerBox BFF on social media for the latest updates:
• Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/BFF.socialapp
• Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/bffsocialapp
• Threads: https://www.threads.net/@bffsocialapp

bluejetty:00099949:ios.description:
An Apple Arcade subscription is required for the full game. All your progress will carry over and you can continue right where you left off.
Take your first step on an epic adventure with Hello Kitty and Friends! In this preview, explore the mysterious Seaside Resort and discover all the fun of cooking and crafting gifts for friends, solving puzzles in ancient ruins, fishing, customizing your avatar and your cabins, and more. Can you figure out how to open the mysterious gate?
-----------------------
The full game on Apple Arcade includes:
OPEN WORLD ADVENTURE
Welcome to Big Adventures Park, where friendships are key and adventure is just around the corner! Join your supercute new friends in a gorgeous world teeming with adorable creatures, delicious food, and many mysteries to explore.
HELLO KITTY AND FRIENDS
Get to know supercute and friendly faces like Hello Kitty, Kuromi, Cinnamoroll, and more by discovering their likes, questing alongside them, and eventually becoming best friends. Craft rare items, solve ancient puzzles, and decorate cabins to bring new visitors and create your ultimate island paradise.
TONS OF FEATURES
- Run, climb, and glide around a mysterious island
- Become besties with Hello Kitty and Friends
- Dive deep to explore a magical underwater world
- Cook delicious dishes and craft useful tools
- Create your own customized Hello Kitty and Friends-style avatar
- Decorate cabins to attract Hello Kitty and Friends and their family members too
- Discover the greatest gifts to give each friend
- Collect and dye clothes to create a custom wardrobe
- Solve exciting puzzles and mysterious ruins
- Catch tons of fish and critters
- Snap some selfies with gudetama
- Put pineapple on a pizza?
- Become a mermaid (yes, really)
- And SO much more
UPDATES & MORE
Experience new events, new friends, and more to explore with consistent game updates.

bluejetty:00177867:ios.description:
Block Buzzle Jewel is a free block puzzle game that combines the logic of Sudoku with the fun of Tetris-style jewel blocks. Easy to learn but challenging to master, this classic relaxing matching gems game sharpens your mind, relieves stress, and keeps you entertained for hours—online or offline.
New Jigsaw Puzzle Mode
Unlock an exciting puzzle collection! You'll get jigsaw piece when you win the game level. After you collect all the puzzle pieces, you will complete beautiful themed jigsaw puzzles. Each time period brings fresh designs pictures, making your puzzle journey even more engaging.
Multiple Gameplays
- Classic Mode: Classic 9x9 Sudoku grid gameplay—clear rows, columns and 3x3 squares.
- Jigsaw Mode: Gather unique jigsaw pieces and get stunning images in your album.
- Nostalgic Tetris: Where retro Tetris gameplay meet fresh gems puzzle design for endless nostalgic fun.
- Daily Challenge: a fresh ice-block puzzle—clear the frozen board and train your brain every day.
Key Features
- Colorful Jewel Graphics: Vibrant visuals and stress-free crush effects make every move exciting.
- Strategic Combos & Streaks: Plan your moves, clear multiple lines, and enjoy powerful combo blasts.
- Unlimited Playtime: No timers, no pressure—play at your own pace and enjoy pure puzzle fun.
- Offline & Free: No WiFi needed! Enjoy endless block puzzle fun anytime, anywhere.
How to Play
1.Drag the gem blocks onto the 9x9 grid.
2.Fill rows, columns, or 3x3 squares to clear blocks.
3.Trigger more combos by clearing multiple lines at once.
4.Use the storage grid wisely when blocks don’t fit.
5.The game ends when there’s no space left on the board.
6.Use the game props to maximize your best score and enjoy the endless pleasure time.
Whether you love block puzzle, wood block puzzles, classic Tetris or matching puzzle games, Block Buzzle Jewel delivers a relaxing but addictive puzzle fun. Download now and start your journey with gems, combos, and jigsaw puzzle collections!

bluejetty:00186698:ios.description:
Ella is a sight-singing ear-training app that helps you improve your musical ear with fun and engaging exercises.
It uses the microphone to detect your pitch and provide accurate evaluation and feedback. The tuner’s pitch detection helps you to adjust your singing.
Features:
- Wide variety of exercises
- On-screen tuner in every exercise
- Intonation and interval evaluation
- Detailed graph of your singing pitch
- Practice mode lets you listen before playing
- Play mode that tests your skills
- High-score tracking for each exercise
- Leaderboard for each exercise collection
Ella gives you a detailed analysis of your performance on intonation and intervals and lets you further visualize it through graphs. The intonation score is based on how accurately you sang the pitch of each note. The interval score is based on how accurately you sang each interval.
Ella teaches sight-singing and music-reading with a cutting-edge experience that includes a wide variety of exercises. Follow the learning path to navigate musical concepts from beginner to advanced.
Use practice mode to nail your singing performance. Use play mode to achieve your personal best and appear on the global leaderboards and to compete with friends.

bluejetty:00127316:ios.description:
Welcome to Idle Taxi Tycoon! Are you ready to be part of the best Taxi Crew in Town? We hope you are, the Taxi Station is waiting for you!
This Taxi Simulator game will give you the chance to become an Idle Taxi Tycoon. This is not just a driving game where you become a taxi driver, in this idle game you can get rich, get more Taxi Stations, hire and manage taxi drivers!
This idle game simulator is not just about tapping, you have to develop a good strategy to get rich, buy more taxis, and manage jobs from passengers. Transport people all over the city: Hotel, Hospital, High School, University, Prison, or Airport - Taxis are needed everywhere!
If you love tycoon games and you dream about managing a crew of ragtag drivers, then it’s time to start playing Idle Taxi Tycoon! Once you get rich, you will be able to expand your empire across the city and transport people from everywhere! In other Taxi Games, you can’t even upgrade the cabs or expand your HQ, but in this clicker game, it is possible to become an Idle Tycoon and help people.
Unlike other tap games and simulators, use your riches to tap and improve your Taxis, even earning money when you are offline. Come back and jump right into this Taxi Car Game!
Do you have what it takes to become a rich idle taxi tycoon? Start tapping and make more money, play also offline! To become a millionaire tap tycoon and get rich just upgrade the kitchen, emergency call room, and leisure room, get the maximum out of this idle game!
Features:
- Use your profit to manage your taxi station. Hire the best drivers and assign them to routes!
- Each driver has its unique driving style and skills!
- Manage and optimize your Taxi Station! No other Idle Tycoon Game will give you so many options!
- Have you become a millionaire already? Then start tapping, because in this taxi car game you can upgrade your taxi stations to make them bigger! Level up and tap, expand the garage and call room of your taxi station so that your drivers can provide transport for more and more people!
- Enjoy new Taxi challenges in this exciting tycoon game! Just one call can start the adventure and you can be the hero in this idle game!
Unlike other clicker games, you can dispatch Taxis, while you manage your drivers and tap to become a millionaire idle tycoon full of gold and riches. Will you become the Taxi Tycoon in this Idle Game?

bluejetty:00099240:ios.description:
Our app, AI Homework Helper, is a state-of-the-art tool designed to aid students in completing their homework by providing AI-powered answers derived from photos. Users can explore a wide range of subjects, making it simple to receive customized support that fits their individual academic needs. The app also includes an interactive chat feature, enabling dynamic communication with the AI to enhance the learning process. Moreover, AI Homework Helper keeps a record of all past queries and lets users save their favorite answers for easy future access.
Disclaimer: This application has been created for educational purposes only and is intended to facilitate a deeper understanding of the subject matter. We strongly emphasize that we do not condone or encourage cheating, including plagiarism or any other forms of dishonest behavior. Our mission is to inspire honest learning and personal growth by promoting a thorough comprehension of the material studied. Please use this application responsibly and with respect for your own knowledge and achievements.
Please note that the subscription plan includes some restrictions: free users are limited to just two photo-based answers, while access to the chat functionality and saved history is exclusive to premium subscribers. This encourages users to upgrade to a premium plan for a fuller, more versatile learning experience.
The app offers auto-renewable subscriptions and in-app purchases as follows:
Weekly subscription — $4.99

bluejetty:00065848:ios.description:
Dive into the fizziest match-3 puzzle adventure with Candy Crush Soda Saga by King! Splash into over 15,000 mouth-watering levels bursting with bubbly fun. Enjoy a refreshingly sweet journey that's completely ad-free, both online and offline!
Match, pop, and fizz your way through irresistible game modes:
- Free the Soda Bears stuck in sticky frosting or delicious honeycomb!
- Spread the Jam by matching candies strategically across the board.
- Pop Soda Bottles to flood the board with fizzy excitement.
- Conquer deliciously tricky obstacles like jelly and bubblegum to keep the fun flowing.
Fizz-tastic Events & Bubbling Tournaments:
- Candy Hunt: Join tasty themed events and race against others to collect special sweets.
- Weekly Contest: Show off your skills by matching more candies than your friends. Top the leaderboard every week for scrumptious prizes!
- Soda Cup: Compete in this prestigious match-3 showdown to win heaps of sparkling Gold Bars.
- Climb the leaderboards, earn fantastic rewards, and prove you're the ultimate Soda champion!
Bubbly Boosters & Delightful Features:
- Sweet Boosters: Power up your play with legendary boosters like the Color Bomb and the delicious Lollipop Hammer! Stuck on a tricky puzzle? Boosters have your back!
- Daily Surprises: Log in daily to grab tasty rewards, including free boosters and extra lives.
- Fun With Friends: Share lives, challenge your pals, climb the leaderboards, and see who's truly the fizz-tastic master of match-3 puzzles!
- Play Anytime, Anywhere: Online or offline, dive into uninterrupted puzzle-solving without any ads to slow your fizz.
Whether you're unwinding after a long day or craving a fresh twist on your favorite puzzle game, Candy Crush Soda Saga serves up endless fizzy fun and sweet excitement.
Note: Candy Crush Soda Saga is free to play, but optional in-game items such as extra moves or lives require payment.
By downloading Candy Crush Soda Saga, you agree to our terms of service, which can be found at https://king.com/termsAndConditions.

bluejetty:00180773:ios.name: French Turkish Flashcards
bluejetty:00180773:ios.summary:
Learn French & Turkish helps you study two languages side by side. With a structured format and interactive tools, it’s ideal for beginners who want to start learning both French vocabulary and Turkish vocabulary in daily sessions.
Main Fe
bluejetty:00180773:ios.description:
Learn French & Turkish helps you study two languages side by side. With a structured format and interactive tools, it’s ideal for beginners who want to start learning both French vocabulary and Turkish vocabulary in daily sessions.
Main Features:
Flashcards for Each Language
Learn common French words and Turkish words through simple flashcards. Each card includes native pronunciation, translations, and two usage examples. These French flashcards and Turkish flashcards help you focus on real-world usage.
Audio Practice
Tap to hear any French word or Turkish word spoken out loud. Listening improves your pronunciation and helps you learn to speak French and learn to speak Turkish with better confidence.
Mini Quizzes
Check your progress with quick quizzes. You’ll test how well you remember French vocabulary and Turkish vocabulary.
Matching Game
Boost your memory by pairing French or Turkish words with their English meanings. The matching game supports better retention and helps beginners learn French or learn Turkish with ease.
Favorites for Review
Save any difficult French word or Turkish word to your favorites for repeated study. This makes your learning path more personalized.
29 Levels Per Language
All features (flashcards, quizzes, games) come with 29 levels, so you can learn French and learn Turkish step by step.
Whether you’re just starting or revisiting, this app is a helpful way to build your vocabulary and learn to speak French and Turkish at your own pace.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://www.appfluxlabs.com/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00024142:ios.summary:
Meet HitMeal—a nutrition app, calorie counter, and food tracker that helps you track calories, macros, and eating habits.
Keeping track of what you eat is harder than it sounds: calories sneak up on you, and logging every meal manually is
bluejetty:00024142:ios.description:
Meet HitMeal—a nutrition app, calorie counter, and food tracker that helps you track calories, macros, and eating habits.
Keeping track of what you eat is harder than it sounds: calories sneak up on you, and logging every meal manually is a chore. HitMeal takes that off your plate—scan a barcode, snap a photo, or search the database, and each meal lands in your food diary with all its nutrition info. Whether you're monitoring your macros, adding structure to how you eat, or just starting to count calories, you'll know how you did today and what to adjust tomorrow.
8 million+ people have found an easier way to track their meals, calories, and nutrition with HitMeal. You can too. Start your food diary today.
With HitMeal, you get:
• Four ways to log a meal—scan a barcode, snap a photo, search the database, or type it in.
• Meal plans when you need them—for weight loss or healthier eating.
• Progress you can see—calories, macros, and trends in charts and widgets.
• A habit you can keep—stay consistent without pressure or strict rules.
• Apple Health sync—your steps, activity, and nutrition in one place on your iPhone.
Here's what you can do:
COUNT CALORIES AND STAY ON TRACK
Log each meal and see how many calories you've had so far today. You'll know how much you have left by dinnertime.
TRACK MACROS ALONGSIDE CALORIES
Not enough protein at lunch? Too many carbs by dinner? See protein, carbs, and fats for every meal and balance your diet as you go.
SCAN PACKAGED FOOD TO SAVE TIME 
No time to search the database for the yogurt you grabbed on the way to work? Point your camera at the barcode and it lands in your diary—no typing required.
KEEP A FOOD DIARY, MEAL BY MEAL
Log breakfast, lunch, dinner, and snacks throughout the day. Look back to spot your eating patterns—what you reach for and when—and get a clear picture of your daily nutrition.
FIND THE FOODS YOU EAT EVERY DAY
Homemade soup or a café lunch—search the food database and add it straight to your diary. Unlike many trackers that make you create entries by hand, HitMeal lets you find most foods in a single search.
PLAN BREAKFAST, LUNCH, AND DINNER
Need a reset or more structure? Pick a meal plan that fits your goal—losing weight, maintaining it, or eating better—with dishes from nutrition experts.
CONNECT WITH APPLE HEALTH
Sync HitMeal with Apple Health to keep your steps, activity, and nutrition together, so what you eat and how you move become one routine.
HOW IT WORKS
• Log what you eat—scan a barcode, snap a photo, search the food database, or type it in.
• Check the calories and macros for each meal and your day so far.
• See how your daily nutrition comes together in your food diary and charts.
• Stay on top of your nutrition and weight goals, meal after meal.
Start with your next meal. Download HitMeal—the calorie tracker that helps you track calories, macros, and daily nutrition so you can focus on eating well.
FAQ
Q: Can I use HitMeal as a food diary? 
A: Yes. Record meals and snacks throughout the day; the diary shows your eating patterns, and charts show your progress.
Q: Can I track macros, not just calories? 
A: Yes. Protein, carbs, and fats are shown alongside calories for every meal.
Q: Can I scan food barcodes?
A: Yes. Scan packaged food barcodes to find products and add them straight to your food diary.
Health notice for meal plans and diets:
Before starting any meal plan, diet, or intermittent fasting routine in the app, consider consulting a qualified healthcare professional—especially if you’re pregnant, breastfeeding, under 18, or have any medical or psychological condition.
All personal data is protected in accordance with the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy:
https://aiby.mobi/nutrition/terms/
https://aiby.mobi/nutrition/privacy/
For questions or inquiries, please use our customer support form at
https://aiby.mobi/nutrition/support/
Stay healthy!
HitMeal team

bluejetty:00186399:ios.description:
My Pretend Preschool lets your kids pretend play in a Preschool & Kindergarten setting!
There are plenty of rooms in this School to explore including a Preschool Classroom, Music Room, Art Room, Cafeteria, Outdoor Playground, Bathroom & More!
Explore the Preschool Classroom & pick up books, paper, scissors, pencils, and other fun artwork! Change the wall art, and play and interact with different toys and blocks!
Music room lets you get creative with several instruments including the acoustic and electric guitars, drum sets, piano, tambourine, flute, triangle, wind instruments, and even the harp! So many fun musical instruments to play with, you will never want to stop playing in this room!
The art room lets you explore tons of fun and creative artwork including canvas painting, crafts, sponge shapes, paints & more! Dabble in a rainbow of colors and get creative in the Art room!
The outdoor playground lets you play on a see-saw, slide, musical steps, a bouncy ride, and even a swingset! Tons of rides, and fun toys to play with to get your energy out in an adorable outdoor setting!
The Lunch Room is where you can grab your favorite snacks, drinks, treats, and lunch! Interact with the drink machine, pick some donuts, fruit, and other yummy lunch options to munch on! Even turn the tap on, and throw dishes into the sink! Don't forget to explore the bathroom, where you can interact with the sink, potties, and a mini-shower!
My Pretend Preschool is fun for little ones who love exploring a fun, pretend school with so many items to interact with, you will never be bored and your senses will be put to the test!
A game that engages all senses including sight, sounds, and touch for creative and engaging pretend play!

bluejetty:00028366:ios.description:
Standing in a store and wondering if it is cheaper online? Scan the barcode and compare the price on Amazon - and, depending on your country, eBay and Walmart - in seconds. Free, fast and no sign-up.
HOW IT WORKS
1. Point your camera at the barcode
2. See the product, picture and price range instantly
3. Compare Amazon, eBay and Walmart right in the app - check price, deals and customer reviews
WHY YOU WILL LOVE IT
- Lightning-fast barcode scanner for EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A and UPC-E, including ISBN barcodes on books
- Price check right in the store: price range from current online offers and number of retailers (mostly US shops)
- Price comparison in the app: Amazon, eBay and Walmart side by side (eBay and Walmart depending on your country)
- A short, precise search term instead of a long product title - automatic, optionally created by AI
- Detail view with price range, all offers and your note
- One-tap Amazon search in 14 countries: USA, UK, Canada, Germany, France, Italy, Spain, Netherlands, Mexico, Brazil, India, Japan, Australia and China

bluejetty:00027276:ios.description:

- Double click to blast the same numbers(4-4, 9-9 etc) or pairs that added up to 10(4-6, 3-7 etc).

- The goal is to complete the target upon the board.

Brain-Training Fun – Improve your logical thinking while enjoying a calming puzzle experience.
Hundreds of Unique Levels – Fresh challenges keep you engaged and entertained.

Beautiful handcrafted wooden theme.
Smooth, polished animations and immersive gameplay.
Increasingly challenging puzzles that keep you coming back.
Relaxing sounds and visuals for a cozy puzzle atmosphere.
Download Wood Escape: Block Jam now and enjoy a timeless wooden puzzle adventure!
Can you solve every level and master the art of escape?

- Before you can get a California driver’s license (DL) of any
bluejetty:00139013:ios.description:
****** Download the "California State Driver's test 2026 Online" app now and be ready to pass your "CA DMV Driving test for Driver's License at DMV- Center" tomorrow! ****** 
- Before you can get a California driver’s license (DL) of any kind, you will need to pass knowledge and drive tests. Here are resources to help you prepare. 
The "CA Learner Permit Test 2026 Online" app provides an ideal way to prepare for the Drivers License California Test at any CA State Department of Motor Vehicles Center.
- Free 2026 California Permit Test 2026
This California DMV practice test includes road signs and rules questions taken directly from the official California Driver Handbook for 2026. Use genuine questions that are very similar (often identical!) to the DMV driving permit practice test and driver's license exam to prepare for the DMV driving permit test and driver's license exam.
- The written component of the official DMV test will consist of questions about regulations of the road, traffic signs, and driving statutes, as well as information from the Driver Handbook.
Use this DMV practice exam to help you prepare for your California instruction permit or driver's license.
- How does it work?
- California residents using any form of testing help during the test will result in an automatic failure, and the DMV may take further action against your driving permit, so please don't cheat.
- Ideally suited for: 
- California Driver’s License
- Driver's Learner Permit in California
- CA Refresher Test for Senior Citizens CA 
- CA Driver’s License Renewal
- The California DMV Practice test online is remote Permit Test exam preparation, allowing you to practice in Los Angeles, San Diego, San Jose, San Francisco, Fresno, Sacramento, Long Beach, Oakland, Bakersfield, Anaheim and other cities.
- Based on the official Driver's License California Handbook PDF issued by the Ministry of Transportation of the California State Department of Motor Vehicles, ensuring you're studying the latest materials.
- The majority of questions on the actual Permit Test at any California State Department of Motor Vehicles Center closely resemble the questions provided by the 'CA Practice Permit Test' app. Experience how closely the app mirrors the real exam!
- The ability to take tests online from any location.
- Monitor your progress by tracking the number and types of mistakes you make.
- It’s entirely free of charge
- The DMV CA Practice Test Online effectively prepares you for the Driver Permit Knowledge Test for California 2026.
****** Download the "California State Driver's test 2026 Online" app now and be ready to pass your "CA DMV Driving test for Driver's License at DMV- Center" tomorrow! ******

bluejetty:00176012:ios.description:
Traverse the dungeon in this awesome action / bullet-hell roguelite where every choice could make or break your run. Stack over 130 different items and create powerful synergies to become truly overpowered with 13 unique characters!
BALANCE RISK & REWARD
Balance risk and reward as your make your choices! Push your luck to grow your build, but don't overestimate your abilities, or your run could end on the spot. Navigate the dungeon wisely and reap the rewards to optimize your build to crush the dungeon with 13 unique characters!
BECOME OVERPOWERED
Over 130 unique items can be mixed and matched to create a devastating build, laying waste to every enemy in sight! Be careful not to hurt yourself with an item that doesn't fit, and experiment with synergies to become an overpowered behemoth!
FIND SECRETS
Uncover the secrets of the dungeon on your quest to slay the Villain to unlock hidden paths, uncover new items, and grow your band of adventurers! And for those who crave a challenge, the greatest rewards are locked behind the greatest trials!
PLAY WITH FRIENDS
Play solo or with others in local co-op, with up to 4 people! Combine character abilities to improve your odds, or do a mild amount of trolling, the choice is yours! Please note that extra controllers are required to play with others.

bluejetty:00119877:ios.name: Animal Pre-K Preschool Games
bluejetty:00119877:ios.summary: Explore the farm with a counting sheep named Sherman, Pete the mischievous matching frog and all the barn animals you love as you join Lily the farmer through 100 fun learning games on a quest to help her barnyard buddies find a way home!
bluejetty:00119877:ios.description:
Explore the farm with a counting sheep named Sherman, Pete the mischievous matching frog and all the barn animals you love as you join Lily the farmer through 100 fun learning games on a quest to help her barnyard buddies find a way home!
Playable by kids of all ages with lots of positive encouragement, professional narration and catchy music. Cute farm animals include cow, chicken, goat, pig, sheep, duck and frog! 
Designed by parents and teachers for pre-k kindergarten preparation, this app adheres to Common Core Standards for kindergarten math.
COUNTING & NUMBER RECOGNITION 
• Count forward from 1 to 10 
• Connect counting to numbers 
• Answer “How many?” questions 
• Compare numbers to groups of items
ADDITION & SUBTRACTION 
• Addition with objects 
• Subtraction with objects 
• Add and subtract within 5 
CATEGORIES, COLORS AND GEOMETRY 
• Classify objects into given categories 
• Correctly name shapes and colors 
• Analyze and compare shapes and colors
ADDITIONAL FEATURES: 
• Items, numbers and instructions are professionally narrated 
• Players are rewarded with positive encouragement 
• Parental controls: Turn off sounds, music, purchases and links to our other apps 
• We do not collect personal information from our users. 
COMMON CORE STANDARDS 
• CCSS.Math.Content.K.CC.A.1 
• CCSS.Math.Content.K.CC.A.2 
• CCSS.Math.Content.K.CC.B.4 
• CCSS.Math.Content.K.CC.B.5 
• CCSS.Math.Content.K.CC.C.7 
• CCSS.Math.Content.K.OA.A.1
• CCSS.Math.Content.K.MD.B.3 
• CCSS.Math.Content.K.G.A.2
Terms of Use (EULA)
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00036247:ios.description:
Stork Pregnancy Tracker and Baby development application is a very helpful and simple to use tool for pregnant women. This app will guide you through pregnancy day-by-day and week-by-week. Based on your data, you will receive personalized information, the latest parenting news and information about you and your baby. Now you have nothing to worry about – all necessary features like pregnancy calendar, weight control, blog and weekly tips are specially selected and combined in the app in the most convenient way.
Stork app is one of the top pregnancy apps for you, highly appreciated by users and recommended by industry experts worldwide. Embark on your pregnancy journey with Stork baby tracker – one of the top-rated apps for expectant mums! Personalized insights tailored to your due date will guide you week-by-week through every stage of pregnancy.
To get started, simply register for Free! All content is based on information from experts, so you can feel confident and prepared for the changes to your baby and body. 
What to expect from Stork Pregnancy Tracker:
- Tracking Tools: Stay informed with a contraction timer, weight log chart, baby size visualizer, and due date calculator.
- One-time payment, no subscriptions: Unlock all Premium features forever with a single purchase-no hidden costs or recurring fees. 
- Community Features: Connect with moms worldwide via our social network to share advice and support during your journey.
- Preparation Tools: Get curated hospital bag lists, newborn shopping guides, and weekly tips to feel confident every step of the way!
- Personalization: Capture memories with abdomen photos and use your personal diary for notes and notifications tailored to you!
- Ad-free experience: Enjoy a distraction-free journey focused entirely on you and your baby.
----------------------------

In turn, you understand that data you provide via the app does not constitute protected health information, as defined under us health insurance portability and accountability act (“HIPAA”) or under similar legislation in your local jurisdiction.

The most efficient app for finding secondhand clothing.
• One fast search for all resale sites and stores
• No additional fees 
• Keep track of your searches with push/email notifications
• Search with image

• Browse by decade, brand, gender
• Save favorites
• Buy the item on the store website
—
FEATURED IN
“Fashion writers, vintage collectors and costume designers all use this app”
– The New York Times
“You can find vintage or secondhand alternatives to items you’d normally buy new”
– Vogue US
“Anything I consider getting, I first search it on Gem”
– New York Magazine
“What We Love: Gem searches for items from independent stores and resale platforms—drawing from over 150 million listings across the internet.”

Gem is open to all online vintage & secondhand clothing stores. Contact us if you would like your store to be included.

bluejetty:00084921:ios.summary:
50 States from Smart Fox is a simple & fun quiz that will help you learn:
- US Capitals
- Flags of the United States of America
- Location of 50 US states on the US map
- New feature: learn interesting facts about the US
The United States
bluejetty:00084921:ios.description:
50 States from Smart Fox is a simple & fun quiz that will help you learn:
- US Capitals
- Flags of the United States of America
- Location of 50 US states on the US map
- New feature: learn interesting facts about the US
The United States is a big country, and it definitely takes more effort to learn the US geography, US capitals, US states & flags compared to other countries. Moreover, there are so many interesting facts about US geography, US history, and modern life! Smart Fox is on a mission to make you cleverer every day - in a fun and easy way! Whether you're a high school student or just a curious learner, our US geography quiz 50 States will help you master US capitals, states, flags & US map and learn some cool facts about the USA.
50 US States quiz has such features:
- US capitals quiz: you will see a US state on the map. You will be asked to choose the correct capital. A great opportunity to learn US capitals and a map of the United States of America in an easy way!
- US map quiz: try to guess which state is shown on the United States map
- US flags quiz: you will be surprised by the variety of beautiful flags of the US states. Guess & learn the US geography!
- Interesting facts quiz: guess and learn interesting facts about the US geography, US history, and modern life. Fun trivia!
- Useful hints: if you are not sure about a specific US capital, state or flag, use our hints. It is impossible to lose!
- Play offline: learn US geography any time you want. 50 States is available to play offline.
- Download & play for free! 50 States is free to download & play, with no in-app purchases included.
It is never too late to start learning. Download our free US geography quiz 50 States and start learning US capitals, states & flags of the United States of America! Get smarter every day - with Smart Fox :)

bluejetty:00122367:ios.summary:
Jetzt im neuen Design 
Das überarbeitete Design und die intuitive Navigation bringen dich schneller zu deinen Lieblingsinhalten und vielem mehr. Streaming und Fernsehen waren noch nie so einfach und unterhaltsam.
Stream dir mehr – im ZDF:
bluejetty:00122367:ios.description:
Jetzt im neuen Design 
Das überarbeitete Design und die intuitive Navigation bringen dich schneller zu deinen Lieblingsinhalten und vielem mehr. Streaming und Fernsehen waren noch nie so einfach und unterhaltsam.
Stream dir mehr – im ZDF: 
- On demand: Deine Lieblingsserien wie „Love Sucks“, „Doppelhaushälfte“ und „A Good Girl's Guide to Murder“ sind jederzeit im Streaming verfügbar. Tauche ein in packende Dokus wie „FC Hollywood“, „Terra X“, „37 Grad“ und unterhaltsame Formate wie „Bares für Rares“.
- Offline schauen: Lade deine Lieblingsinhalte wie „Neo Ragazzi“ oder „MaiThink X – Die Show“ herunter und genieße sie ganz ohne Internetverbindung, perfekt für unterwegs, sei es auf Reisen oder beim Pendeln. 
- Vor TV-Ausstrahlung verfügbar: Viele Inhalte wie „Terra Xplore“, „ZDF Magazin Royale“ und „heute-show“ sowie spannende Filme sind bereits vor der Ausstrahlung im Fernsehen online zum Streamen verfügbar. So bist du immer einen Schritt voraus. 
- Live-TV & Livestreams: Verfolge Sport-Events wie den DFB-Pokal, die Frauen-Fußball EM und packende Biathlon-Rennen oder schaue deine liebsten Sendungen wie „heute-show“ und „ZDF Magazin Royale“ live in der Streaming-App. 
- Öffentlich-rechtliche TV-Highlights: Erlebe ein breites Angebot an hochwertigen Programmen und Sendungen aus den Bereichen Kultur, Politik, Sport, Unterhaltung und Gesellschaft von ARTE, funk, 3sat, phoenix und ARD, z. B. „Kulturzeit“, „phoenix parlament“ und „ARTE Concert“. 
- Mein ZDF: Erstelle deine personalisierte Merkliste und erhalte Benachrichtigungen zu neuen Folgen. Verpasse nie wieder ein Highlight dank smarter Empfehlungen und gestalte dein individuelles Streaming-Erlebnis.
Erlebe Sport, Unterhaltung, Wissenswertes und Nachrichten im Livestream oder on demand – wann und wo du willst. Nutze die Merkliste und Push-Benachrichtigungen, um deine Lieblingsinhalte immer griffbereit zu haben. Lade die ZDF-App jetzt herunter und erlebe Streaming im ZDF – deine Welt aus Entertainment Live-TV, Filmen, Serien und Dokus! Stream dir mehr – im ZDF.

bluejetty:00030787:ios.description:
Mixology Made Easy with DrinkSmith: Your Ultimate Home Bartender Companion!
Become the master of your home bar with DrinkSmith, the ultimate app for aspiring and seasoned bartenders alike! Whether you're a seasoned mixologist or a newbie looking to shake up some fun, DrinkSmith is your go-to source for crafting tasty drinks and mastering the art of bartending.
ELEVATE YOUR MIXOLOGY SKILLS
Unlock hundreds of cocktail recipes from timeless classics to innovative concoctions. Whether you're a novice or a seasoned mixologist, DrinkSmith empowers you to craft 500+ delicious drinks with confidence.
GET INSPIRED WITH DYNAMIC COLLECTIONS
Discover DrinkSmith’s new dynamic collections, designed to keep your creativity flowing year-round. From seasonal favorites to drinks tailored to your home bar ingredients, these ever-evolving collections ensure you’ll always have the perfect cocktail recipe at your fingertips. Whether it’s a holiday gathering or a casual night in, DrinkSmith makes finding inspiration effortless.
AR MIXOLOGY
Step into the world of virtual bartending with DrinkSmith's augmented reality (AR) feature. Visualize recipes in real-time, follow step-by-step instructions, and perfect your techniques with immersive guidance right from your phone.
FIND YOUR PERFECT COCKTAIL
Effortlessly discover your next favorite drink with searchable filters in DrinkSmith. Sort recipes by ABV, ingredients, flavor profiles, or match percentage with your home bar. Whether you’re craving something refreshing, bold, or classic, our advanced filtering tools make exploring cocktails easier than ever. Unleash endless possibilities with just a few taps!
CHEERS TO CREATIVITY
Customize and experiment with a variety of ingredients, flavors, and garnishes to create signature drinks that reflect your unique style and taste. Share your creations with the DrinkSmith community and inspire fellow home bartenders!
EXPLORE INGREDIENTS
Unlock the secrets of every ingredient with DrinkSmith’s ingredient sheets. Tap any ingredient to discover its history, flavor profile, and expert tips for using it in cocktails. Plus, explore a curated list of recipes featuring the same ingredient, making it easy to expand your mixology skills and find inspiration for your next drink creation.
DISCOVER BY FLAVOR PROFILES
Find the perfect drink in seconds with DrinkSmith’s flavor profiles. Every recipe is categorized by taste, like sweet, sour, bitter, or refreshing, helping you quickly discover cocktails that match your mood. Whether you’re craving a bold whiskey sour or a light, citrusy spritz, DrinkSmith makes it easy to explore drinks by flavor!
STAY UPDATED & INSPIRED
Get access to regular updates featuring the latest drink trends and seasonal favorites. Never run out of fresh ideas to quench your thirst for cocktail creativity.
SHAKE UP YOUR SOCIAL GATHERINGS
Transform any occasion into a memorable event with handcrafted cocktails that rival those of professional bars. Impress your friends and family with your newfound bartending prowess, and become the life of the party with DrinkSmith by your side.
Whether you're hosting a gathering, unwinding after a long day, or simply exploring the art of mixology, DrinkSmith is the mixology app for you. Download now and let the cocktail adventure begin! Cheers to endless possibilities!

Privacy Policy: https://www.drinksmith.app/terms-of-use
