bluejetty:00022192:ios.description:
NS MIDI Player is a simple MIDI player for iPhone, iPad, and Mac.
Features include:
- Free!
- No ads, subscriptions, or data collection
- Play standard MIDI files (SMF) with file extensions .mid, .midi, and .kar
- GM and GS standards supported with the default SoundFont
- Use custom SoundFonts with file extension .sf2 or .dls
- View time-synced lyrics
- Connect to MIDI outputs with Core MIDI*
- Export MIDI files as audio*
- Queue multiple songs to be played in order*
- "Open with" from other apps, such as Safari
- Integrated with the Files app (iOS and iPadOS)
- Supports drag-and-drop
- Supports Quick Look previews
- Share MIDI files directly from the app
- Supports background audio and AirPlay
- Lock screen and Control Center controls with scrubbing
- Gapless repeat mode
- Playback speed control with tap tempo
- Customizable reverb
- Transpose*
Note: Features marked with an asterisk (*) require upgrading to the full version before they can be used. This is a one-time purchase shared across all of your devices and helps support further development. All other features are free.
Included FluidR3Mono GM SoundFont is licensed under the MIT License.
Included Sample MIDI file is "Hard Times" from http://www.soundswell.co.uk/pages/swmids.htm and is in the public domain.
This app and its creator are not affiliated with the creators of these files in any way.

bluejetty:00062307:ios.description:
Ready your child for school with IntellectoKids Learning Games for Kids, an educational app for kids ages 2-7.
So learning is boring, huh? Phonics, counting, colors, and musical puzzles will help kids get ready for school. With Intellecto Kids app, learning becomes a colorful and exciting adventure. Install the free IntellectoKids app, and teaching your child will become a fun game!
This app for preschoolers is an educational game developed with the direct involvement of teachers who have extensive experience teaching logical thinking and memory to small children and inspiring a love for reading, learning, writing and counting in them. This app also gives children their first introduction to musical instruments. Fun facts from the world of art and science will also be added to the program in the near future. The teaching process is based on a game-like method that serves as the foundation for the most modern and effective techniques for teaching preschoolers, toddlers and babies.
The educational games make learning even more engaging and fun. They are built on the nuances of children’s mental development and factor in their capabilities. IntellectoKids is perfect for children in the following age groups:
– 2-3 years old
– 3-4 years old
– 4-5 years old
– 5-6 years old
Large selection of educational games for kids:
- English Alphabet, Phonics and Letters for kids
Interactive Alphabet Cartoon: this is a fun educational ABC game with animals and dinosaurs that teaches kids the alphabet and phonics in a fun, casual way. This game also develops spelling, reading, handwriting and letter tracing skills.

bluejetty:00177976:ios.name: Doctor Games for Kids!
bluejetty:00177976:ios.summary: Our diverse collection of games keeps kids engaged and motivates them to learn more! We've developed an extensive curriculum that covers number sense and math tasks, tracing letters and numbers, writing words, phonics, interactive reading,
bluejetty:00177976:ios.description:
Our diverse collection of games keeps kids engaged and motivates them to learn more! We've developed an extensive curriculum that covers number sense and math tasks, tracing letters and numbers, writing words, phonics, interactive reading, and more. Curated by experts, the content fosters curiosity, creativity, and confidence in young learners, assisting them as they grow.
Smarter, Inclusive Learning for Every Child
SKIDOS now supports kids with ADHD, Dyslexia, Dysgraphia & Dyscalculia. Built with accessibility guidelines, the experience is tailored to every child’s unique learning needs—making learning more personalized, inclusive, and enjoyable for neurodivergent learners too
SKIDOS PASS: ALL IN ONE
With the SKIDOS Pass, children explore a safe and age-appropriate space with 1000+ fun and engaging activities, gaining life skills and receiving positive reinforcement for academic success. Parents can create up to 6 personalized profiles for their kids. and customize each according to age, gameplay preferences, and subjects to learn. Monitoring kids' progress is easy - learning reports in the app or via email give you a simple overview of their growth and challenges.
Gameplay:
Let your child play SKIDOS Doctor and treat 3 patients, boosting Cognitive Development with problem-solving, Executive Function via planning, Creative Imagination through role-play, and Social & Emotional Development by fostering empathy. Motor Skills grow with taps and swipes. From runny noses to broken bones, kids explore medical tools and learn how to help others feel better.
5 Fun Scenes:
Treat flu
Cure earaches
Care for teeth
Take X-rays
Clean wounds
Along the way, kids learn to use thermometers, nose & ear drops, plasters, and more!
LEARNING CURRICULUM
Our curriculum mixes engaging games with learning content, improving your child's learning skills and promoting active play.
MATH: Our math exercises cover a comprehensive list of topics, including number sense, addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, geometry, and more. Tasks evolve as your child progresses. Interactive design and animations help support learning - three cute SKIDOS mascots will offer assistance, encouraging kids while they work on the assignments.
TRACING LETTERS & NUMBERS: You can pick tracing letters and numbers for your child to practice. A ladybird will show your little learner how to trace with their finger, while visuals and voiceovers teach new words and counting.
READING: Children will be introduced to the world of phonics, sounds, letters, and reading. Interactive designs and smart prompts help kids make their first confident steps toward reading, while storytelling with songs keeps them engaged and curious about new learning journeys.
EMOTIONAL WELLBEING: Through engaging activities, kids learn to understand and express their emotions and nurture positive attitudes.
EDUCATIONAL VIDEOS: Our video content piques kids' curiosity in a fun and easy way. We've curated just the right mix of entertainment & learning in our video catalogue.
KIDS SAFE:
Our apps are COPPA & GDPR-compliant.
ABOUT THE SKIDOS PASS SUBSCRIPTION:
- We offer monthly and annual auto-renewable subscriptions
- Every subscription starts with a 3-day Free Trial
- Payment is charged to your Apple Account only after a free trial period, wherever applicable
- Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing cycle
- The user may turn off the subscription auto-renewal in the user's device Account Settings
- Cancellation goes into effect at the end of the current billing cycle
- Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when the user purchases a SKIDOS pass, where applicable
Privacy Policy: http://skidos.com/privacy-policy
Terms & Conditions: https://skidos.com/terms/
Support: support@skidos.com

bluejetty:00026658:ios.summary:
Share moments instantly. Connect families forever.

ONE FRAME FOR YO
bluejetty:00026658:ios.description:
Share moments instantly. Connect families forever.
Send photos and videos from your phone to any Frameo frame – your own, or your family's, wherever they are. Downloaded over 30 million times by families around the world.
ONE FRAME FOR YOUR MEMORIES AND YOUR PLANS
Frameo turns a WiFi photo frame into a family hub. A toddler's first steps, next week's soccer game – your moments and your schedule, on the frame in your living room and in the homes of the people you love.
FREE, AND ALWAYS WILL BE:
- Send up to 10 photos or 15-second videos at a time, as often as you like. They appear in seconds.
- Sync one calendar so birthdays, events, and plans show up on the frame.
- Add captions, or use Greetings – fun graphics for holidays and celebrations.
- Group photos into Albums for weddings, holidays, and vacations.
- Connect to any frame with a code, invite as many people as you like, and get a notification when someone likes your photo.
Every feature listed above is free, and stays free. There are no fees to send or receive.
WHAT YOU CAN COUNT ON:
Private by design, end-to-end encryption and full compliance with GDPR, CCPA, and PSTI. Your photos stay yours.
Regular updates for your app and frame, always included.
WANT MORE? TWO OPTIONAL UPGRADES:
Everything above stays free. Frameo+ and Premium simply add more on top.
FRAMEO+ – MORE WAYS TO SHARE:
Send up to 100 photos at a time
Send videos up to 2 minutes
Hide or delete frame photos from your phone
Cloud Backup with client-side encryption
Cast to your TV with Google Cast
$1.99/month or $16.99/year*
PREMIUM – THE COMPLETE EXPERIENCE:
Everything in Frameo+ including the full calendar:
Unlimited calendar syncs across up to 5 frames
Send Events: create an event with a photo, place, and description, and send it to your own frame or a loved one's
Countdown to birthdays, trips, and milestones
Timed Calendar View: show the calendar during the hours that suit your family, then switch back to photos
Custom event colors
$7.99/month or $69.99/year*
Both paid plans include a 14-day free trial. Read more: http://frameo.com/subscriptions 
SETTING UP OR JUST SENDING?
The app is all you need either way - set up your own new frame, or connect to a loved one's and start sending. Works with official Frameo WiFi photo frames only. Find a retailer: http://frameo.com/#Shop 
Stay updated by following Frameo on social media:
facebook.com/frameoapp
instagram.com/frameo_app
youtube.com/@frameoapp
*Price may vary depending on country.

bluejetty:00145813:android.name: Screen Mirroring & Cast To TV
bluejetty:00145813:android.summary: Pair your phone with your TV and cast your favorite media (Photos, Videos, Audios) directly to it, as well as mirror your phone screen to your TV without any delay. It works with all major TV brands available today, no need to buy any extra
bluejetty:00145813:android.description:
Pair your phone with your TV and cast your favorite media (Photos, Videos, Audios) directly to it, as well as mirror your phone screen to your TV without any delay. It works with all major TV brands available today, no need to buy any extra hardware and wires.
Key Features:
- Screen Mirroring to TV
This app makes screen mirroring simpler than you think! It offers a quick way to share your Android phone screen with your TV. It supports wireless connection where you just need to connect both your phone and TV to the same WIFI. Designed with a simple interface making it easy for you to use and enjoy watching videos, playing games and more on a wider screen!
- Screen Mirroring to a browser
Mirror your phone screen to any browser with ease using our intuitive app. Perfect for sharing photos, videos, or audios, it delivers smooth, real time streaming with just a few taps. Just make sure your phone and browser are connected to the same WIFI, allow the permission to start recording the screen, open the provided address on your browser and the mirroring will start immediately.
- Cast media to TV
Cast a wide variety of media sources directly to your TV with simple steps. You can cast videos, photos and audios from your gallery. It is fairly simple to use. Launch it, select a media you want to cast, then select the device you wish to cast it on, and enjoy a better viewing experience!
- Cast web videos to TV
Seamlessly cast your favorite web videos directly to your TV or Chromecast. Whether it is binge-watching shows, streaming tutorials, or enjoying viral clips, our app brings it all to the big screen with just a tap. 
- Access recently casted videos & create and cast unlimited playlists
We save your casted videos in a custom page making them easily accessible later on. With this app, you can create playlists of videos or music or even a mix of both and cast the entire playlist on your TV making it great for listening to your favorite music or maybe watching videos of your recent trip!

bluejetty:00183470:ios.description:
Stop checking the XRP price. XRP Alerts checks it for you.
Everything XRP. One app. Set the alerts that matter, see what your holdings are worth, and follow the news behind every move without constantly watching the chart.
KNOW WHEN XRP MOVES
Create high and low price alerts for XRP or set targets based on your total portfolio value. See how close XRP is to your targets and get notifications when they're reached.
YOUR XRP, AT A GLANCE
See the live XRP price, daily change, and key market stats. Keep the price on your Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island with Live Activities, or check Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets.
DITCH THE SPREADSHEET
Record your XRP purchases to track your holdings, average purchase price, and profit or loss. You can also watch the balance of a public XRP Ledger address without connecting a wallet or sharing private keys.
MAKE SENSE OF EVERY MOVE
Explore interactive line and candlestick charts, zoom into price history, and see how your XRP portfolio has performed over time.
KNOW WHY XRP MOVED
Catch the latest XRP news in one place. Search, save, and read stories, with bullish and bearish sentiment labels to help make sense of the headlines.
BUILT FOR YOUR DEVICES
- Interactive price, portfolio, chart, market stats, and news widgets.
- Apple Watch app with charts, portfolio details, and complications.
- Native experiences for iPhone, iPad, and iPhone Duo.
- View XRP in U.S. dollars or choose from 34 supported currencies.
- Customize your Home Screen with 13 app icons.
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account required. Your purchases, alerts, and saved stories stay on your devices and sync through your own iCloud account when enabled. No ads.
Some features require an optional XRP Alerts Pro subscription. Plans and pricing are shown in the app before you subscribe.
Market data may be delayed. XRP Alerts is for informational purposes only, not financial advice. XRP Alerts is independent and not affiliated with Ripple Labs or the XRP Ledger Foundation.

bluejetty:00178517:ios.summary: MySTRATA_HEAT works with your STRATA_HEAT WiFi Thermostat to keep your house at the right temperature automatically. It uses the location services already built in to your smartphone to calculate in the background how long it will take you
bluejetty:00178517:ios.description:
MySTRATA_HEAT works with your STRATA_HEAT WiFi Thermostat to keep your house at the right temperature automatically. It uses the location services already built in to your smartphone to calculate in the background how long it will take you to get home and set the temperature accordingly, so your home is automatically comfortable when you're there and always running efficiently.
It's great for single heating zones such as central heating and works even better with multi-zone systems like underfloor heating.
By using the automatic settings for different room types, MySTRATA_HEAT can keep zones you're not likely to be using at that time at a comfortable, but more efficient temperature when you're at home, ensuring bedrooms aren't unnecessarily heated during the day and just up to your comfort temperature when you're ready for bed.
With Natural Language Programming it's easy to make quick adjustments to your automatic program, or just set a simple time based heating program.
Don't have a STRATA_HEAT Thermostat? Visit laticrete.com for details
Please note, continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.

bluejetty:00159421:ios.description:
Healthy feels good. Paceline helps it stay that way.
Paceline is your everyday health ally, helping you stay active with rewards that recognize consistent effort.
Track activity with your phone or wearable device, work toward weekly activity goals, and unlock offers from premium wellness brands along the way.
However you move — a run, a ride, a class, a walk that gets your heart going — it counts. No pressure. No extremes. Just steady progress that supports the life you want to live.
Features:
• Activity tracking with your phone or compatible wearable devices
• Connect with Apple Health, Apple Watch, Garmin, Fitbit, Oura, and more
• Weekly goals based on the American Heart Association's recommendation for 150+ minutes of exercise a week.
• Rewards and offers from trusted wellness brands
• Private by design. Your health data stays yours and is never sold to third parties
Paceline connects to the Health app via HealthKit to read activity and biometric data.

bluejetty:00062753:ios.description:
Tempi is a live BPM counter and beat tracking app. Think of it as a reverse metronome — instead of keeping time for you, it listens to the music and detects the tempo in real time.
Whether you're a musician, DJ, or VJ, Tempi gives you a real-time tempo tracker that follows along as you play, with remarkable accuracy across every genre.
* Listens while you (or your entire band) play
* Reports the BPM (beats per minute) of your performance in real time with remarkable accuracy
* Analyze your sessions to pinpoint and improve problem areas
* Flash the screen on the beat with BeatSync
* Sync pedals, loopers, and apps to the beat via Ableton Link
* Tap for Tempo to quickly get a BPM reading at any time
* Switch themes for easy nighttime use or just to suit your style
* Save recording sessions for later analysis
* Sync lighting, VFX, and other devices to the beat via Ableton Link
* Graphs the BPM of tracks in your set over time
* Includes an EQ visualizer
* Fine-tune responsiveness, frequency filters, and detection sensitivity

bluejetty:00133496:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00133496:ios.description:
For a limited time, all Fuel Rewards members receive instant Gold Status.
The Fuel Rewards® program (aka Fuel Rewards Network or FRN), is a free loyalty program that helps you save money on fuel at over 11,000 Shell stations, nationwide. Fuel Rewards members with Gold Status save at least 5¢gal on every fill-up. You can earn additional Fuel Rewards savings when you shop, dine, book travel and more. Rewards are cumulative, and there is no limit to how much you can save. Rewards apply to any fill-up, up to 20 gallons.
APP FEATURES
• Track rewards balance, current tier, & tier progress
• Activate offers
• Link Credit & Debit cards for earning (always use as credit)
• Opt Credit & Debit cards in to allow faster redemption and fueling
• Find ways to earn rewards
• Locate nearby Shell stations
WAYS TO EARN REWARDS
At Shell: With Gold Status, you’ll save at least 5¢/gal on every fill-up at participating Shell stations. Also, you can earn rewards at select Shell stations when you purchase snacks, beverages, car washes and more.
Dine: Earn 10¢/gal for every $50 you spend dining with a linked Mastercard, Visa, or American Express at more than 10,000 participating restaurants nationwide.
Shop: Earn at least 5¢/gal for every $50 you spend at select local and online merchants.
Travel: Earn 5¢/gal for every $50 spent when you book hotels, flights and rental cars, through the Fuel Rewards program.
With Mastercard: Look for exclusive offers from Mastercard to accelerate your savings.
More: Find additional promotions at select regional grocery stores, other affiliated programs, and online at fuelrewards.com.
Some offers must be activated prior to earning. Use the mobile app to easily activate these offers.
HOW TO SAVE AT THE PUMP
• Use the app to find a participating Shell or other participating fuel stations.
• Enter your ALT ID (or swipe your Fuel Rewards loyalty card) at the pump before you pay
• Watch the price roll back.
Shell is the official fuel provider of the Fuel Rewards program. Participation varies by market.
Mastercard is the preferred payment card of the Fuel Rewards program.

bluejetty:00021351:ios.description:
TOP GEAR is the world’s greatest MOTORING MAGAZINE, bringing you unrivalled access to the very best cars on the planet. There’s everything from family SUVs to mind-blowing supercar exclusives, as well as driving adventures from across the globe, honest appraisals and reviews of every new car that matters. Plus, TopGear TV presenter Chris Harris features every month alongside other opinionated columnists and of course, The Stig.
Our AWARD-WINNING digital edition on iPhone and iPad lets you download the latest issue direct to your mobile device. Every issue has stunning HD photography, epic features on just about anything from the world of cars, the world’s best motoring journalists, group-test reviews and comprehensive buying guides from the TopGear experts, a brand-new retro section, first-drives of the most important new cars, all the latest motoring news, insights into global car culture and motorsport updates.
You’ll also get the latest from TopGear TV and plenty of entertainment in the way only TopGear knows how…
Content is designed to fit your specific device and you can download each issue to read offline.
Get the world’s greatest car magazine now!
We’d love to hear what you think of our digital edition; please contact us at editor@bbctopgearmagazine.com
SUBSCRIBE AND SAVE
You can receive generous savings when you subscribe, choosing the term which suits you best:
1 month - £4.99 / $4.99 / €5.49
6 months - £23.99 / $24.49 / €26.99
1 year - £45.99 / $46.99 / €51.99
(Single-issue copies are also available)
The subscription will include the current issue if you do not already own it and subsequently published future issues. Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. This subscription will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. The cost of the renewal will match the initial subscription price. You can manage your subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal by going to your ‘Account Settings’ after purchase. No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during active subscription period.
RESTORE PREVIOUS PURCHASES
To restore any previous purchases after updating the app, go to your TopGear magazine UK library, click the menu button in the top right of the app, then tap the cog icon button in the bottom right of the screen and select ‘Restore Purchases’. Then select ‘Restore’ on the pop up, and your previous purchases will be restored.
Unfortunately, from time to time, an app may crash, and on the odd occasion this happens, we will endeavour to fix the issue as soon as possible. In order to diagnose a problem, we would really appreciate it if you the cog icon in the menu, then tap "Report a problem" and send us details of your issue.
Please read our Terms of Service:
http://www.immediate.co.uk/terms-and-conditions/
Please read our privacy policy:
https://policies.immediate.co.uk/privacy/

MUSCLE BOOSTER WILL HELP YOU TO:
Build muscle, sync with Apple Health, and boost your fitness schedule from home! With an integrated calorie tracker, body editor plan, and step-by-step gym workouts, you can stay motivated, get your belly flat, monitor your health, and achieve your fitness goals anywhere. 
Anywhere, Anytime!
Whether you prefer home workouts, calisthenics, core, or weight loss, Muscle Booster provides personalized training plans for all levels. Work with your own digital coach and follow structured gym routines inspired by popular fitness and gym pros. Track your strength gains, body measurements, and fat loss with smart analytics and stay consistent in building a strong exercise routine and a healthy body.
Explore hundreds of exercises and plans.
Workout tracker, AI calorie tracker, and weight loss
Strength training, HIIT, core, weightlifting, bodyweight calisthenics. 
Abs and belly training.
Enjoy personalized sessions tailored to your fitness level.
Build muscle, burn fat, and maintain overall health.
Use the workout planner to schedule sessions and combine gym routines.
Track your performance and measure your progress over time on Apple Health.
Personalize your home workouts
Workouts, calories burned, and heart rate in real-time. Customize your home workout sessions or gym routines with guided workouts, a training planner, anytime fitness, and exercises targeting your core, arms, legs, and full body. Whether your goal is to lift, get fit, or simply stay active, Muscle Booster keeps your activity high with interactive videos, progress tracking, and social features to connect with friends and fitness hotschedules.

Join the community of weightlifting enthusiasts and get inspired by training programs from pros, and more. Train at home, in the gym, or on the go, with the flexibility to adapt exercise routines anytime. Track your progress with smart analytics, manage your diet, and see real-time results with Apple Watch integration. Whether you are following a body coach plan, a workout app program, or creating your own custom gym routines, Muscle Booster makes it easy to stay consistent and achieve your objectives.

Perfect for all levels, from beginners to advanced athletes, the app ensures your training is smart, effective, and fun.
Follow your progress, stay inspired
Take control of your health and training today. Use Muscle Booster for gym workout, home workouts, core, running, and all your sports needs. Track your progress, stay motivated, and become the strongest, healthiest version of yourself. With a full workout planner, personal coach features, and integration with your device, your goals are within reach.

bluejetty:00113615:ios.name: Fruity Cat Pop: bubble shooter
bluejetty:00113615:ios.summary: Are you a fan of bubble pop games? If so, you'll definitely want to try our brand-new game: Fruity Cat - Bubble Shooter! This fun and challenging puzzle game is perfect for those who love to train their brain, match colors, and pop some bub
bluejetty:00113615:ios.description:
Are you a fan of bubble pop games? If so, you'll definitely want to try our brand-new game: Fruity Cat - Bubble Shooter! This fun and challenging puzzle game is perfect for those who love to train their brain, match colors, and pop some bubbles.
What sets this game apart from others is the cute fruity cat that you get to have as your very own pet. As you progress through the puzzle levels, you'll be able to grow and care for your furry friend, and even collect other cute pets to add to your collection. With over 1000 levels to play through, there's no shortage of exciting adventures to be had in Fruity Cat - Bubble Shooter.
But that's not all! Fruity Cat - Bubble Shooter has a host of top features that make it stand out from the competition:
Match 3 bubbles of the same color to pop them and clear the level
Play through over 1000 levels with unique obstacles
Use special booster bubbles to help you pass those tough levels
Try out awesome special bubbles like chilli and pomegranate
Enjoy cute fruity graphics and animations as you play
Connect to Facebook and play with friends
Play without a Wi-Fi connection as much as you like
One of the best things about Fruity Cat - Bubble Shooter is that it's easy to learn but challenging to master. Whether you're a seasoned puzzle gamer or a newcomer to the genre, you'll find plenty to enjoy in this addictive bubble shooter game.
If you love Fruity Cat - Bubble Shooter, don't forget to leave a rating and review to show your support. We're always working on improving the game and adding new exciting features, so be sure to check back often for updates.
Please note: while Fruity Cat - Bubble Shooter is completely free to play, some in-game items and functions can be purchased for real money. If you don't want this option enabled, simply disable in-app purchases.
So what are you waiting for? Start your bubble popping adventures with Fruity Cat - Bubble Shooter today!
Please Note!
Cat Bubble Pop - Fruit Shooter is completely free to play, but some in-game items and functions can be purchased for real money. If you don't want this option enabled, please disable in-app purchases.

Your All-in-One Budget Planner and Bill Tracker for Smart Money Management. It is now easy to reach financial freedom with a 50/30/20 Personal Capital Planner. 
Utilize a monthly budget planner to create and manage your budget effectively each month.
• Keep track of all your income
• The best way to split your income using the 50/30/20 rule
• Be aware of your budgeting and spending habits and cut back
FINANCIAL NEEDS
Your needs are:
• Utilities
• Housing
• Transportation
• Food, water and clothes
The app helps you to keep your needs at 50% of your total net income.
FINANCIAL WANTS
Your wants are:
• Clothing that isn't essential
• Dining out or ordering takeout
• Hobbies, traveling, large house, and new expensive car
The app helps you to budget your wants within 30% of your monthly net income.
SAVINGS
Pay yourself every month towards:
• Retirement or long-term savings
• Short-term savings for a new car or vacation
• Emergency funds of 6-12 months of living expenses
Put 10% of your net income towards savings each month.
*** Key Features ***
* Free Budget Tracker:
Effortlessly track your budget with our free and user-friendly app.
* Personal Finance Insights:
Gain valuable insights into your personal finance for informed decision-making.
* Money Saving:
Achieve your savings goals with smart money-saving features and tips.
* Financial Planner Monitoring:
Let our financial planner monitor and optimize your budget using the 50/30/20 rule.
* Expense Monitoring and Keeping:
Easily record and categorize expenses for a clear overview of your spending.

bluejetty:00162631:ios.summary: PickMe is the #1 transportation hailing platform for the Western Province of Sri Lanka with more and more of the island being covered every day. Whether you need one of Sri Lanka’s signature three-wheelers, a luxury car to impress, to anyth
bluejetty:00162631:ios.description:
PickMe is the #1 transportation hailing platform for the Western Province of Sri Lanka with more and more of the island being covered every day. Whether you need one of Sri Lanka’s signature three-wheelers, a luxury car to impress, to anything in between, PickMe will get you where you need to go safely and comfortably with just a few taps on your phone. 
With every PickMe ride, enjoy cash or cashless payments, live driver tracking, and fare estimates for a convenient and hassle free experience.
Do you need to get somewhere right now? It couldn’t be simpler with PickMe.
1. Fire up the app and make sure your current location is correctly displayed as your pick up location.
2. Enter where you want to go and get a fare estimate.
3. Select what kind of vehicle (Tuk, Nano, Mini, Sedan, Van) you want for your ride. An estimated time of arrival is also displayed to help you decide which kind of vehicle can pick you up the soonest.
4. Double check your payment method. You have the option to pay with cash or credit card.
5. If you have a discount promo code (we love giving those out!), don’t forget to enter it.
6. Lastly, tap “Book Now” and let us work our magic to get you a ride. Once matched, you can track the driver in real time with the driver’s name, picture, vehicle type, and vehicle license plate number clearly displayed on the app to help you identify your driver.
Don’t forget to kick back and enjoy the ride with PickMe!
If you need a vehicle for the day or schedule a ride in advance, you can do it right from the app as well.
We would love to hear from you so please follow us on social media:
http://facebook.com/pickmelk
https://twitter.com/pickmelk

Count down to the moments that matter—and plan everything around them.
Remainders is a collaborative countdown app for vacations, birthdays, anniversaries, holidays, projects, entertainment releases, and everything else you’re looking forwa
bluejetty:00159682:ios.description:
Count down to the moments that matter—and plan everything around them.
Remainders is a collaborative countdown app for vacations, birthdays, anniversaries, holidays, projects, entertainment releases, and everything else you’re looking forward to.
DISCOVER WHAT’S NEXT
Explore the Event Gallery to quickly add upcoming holidays, movies, games, sports, technology events, and more.
KEEP EVERY EVENT ORGANIZED
Group events into categories, filter by category or status, and quickly find the countdown you need. Countdown spans show the time between events, helping you see what’s coming next.
FOLLOW THE WHOLE JOURNEY
Add start and end dates to track an event’s countdown, duration, and progress. View the complete journey in a detailed event timeline.
PLAN AND COUNT DOWN TOGETHER
Share events with friends, family, and teammates. Everyone receives updates, so you can plan trips, prepare for celebrations, and follow important milestones together.
TASKS, NOTES, AND LINKS
Add checklists for packing, projects, shopping, or event preparation. Keep notes and attach useful website links with rich previews.
WIDGETS AT A GLANCE
Follow your events without opening the app using colorful Home Screen, Lock Screen, and StandBy widgets. Pin a specific countdown or automatically display your next event.
MAKE EVERY COUNTDOWN YOURS
Personalize events with your own photos or create unique cover images using Apple’s Image Playground.
MORE WAYS TO STAY ON TRACK
• Set multiple time-sensitive reminders
• Create repeating events for birthdays and anniversaries
• Import events from your calendar
• Find events using Spotlight Search
• Archive completed events without deleting them
• Sync across iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, and Apple Vision Pro
• Use keyboard shortcuts and multitasking on iPad

Count down to the moments that matter—and plan everything around them.
Remainders is a collaborative countdown app for vacations, birthdays, anniversaries, holidays, projects, entertainment releases, and everything else you’re looking forward to.

DISCOVER WHAT’S NEXT
Explore the Event Gallery to quickly add upcoming holidays, movies, games, sports, technology events, and more.

KEEP EVERY EVENT ORGANIZED
Group events into categories, filter by category or status, and quickly find the countdown you need. Countdown spans show the time between events, helping you see what’s coming next.

FOLLOW THE WHOLE JOURNEY
Add start and end dates to track an event’s countdown, duration, and progress. View the complete journey in a detailed event timeline.

PLAN AND COUNT DOWN TOGETHER
Share events with friends, family, and teammates. Everyone receives updates, so you can plan trips, prepare for celebrations, and follow important milestones together.

TASKS, NOTES, AND LINKS
Add checklists for packing, projects, shopping, or event preparation. Keep notes and attach useful website links with rich previews.

WIDGETS AT A GLANCE
Follow your events without opening the app using colorful Home Screen, Lock Screen, and StandBy widgets. Pin a specific countdown or automatically display your next event.

MAKE EVERY COUNTDOWN YOURS
Personalize events with your own photos or create unique cover images using Apple’s Image Playground.

MORE WAYS TO STAY ON TRACK
• Set multiple time-sensitive reminders
• Create repeating events for birthdays and anniversaries
• Import events from your calendar
• Find events using Spotlight Search

bluejetty:00075630:ios.description:
Pass your Cosmetology exam with flying colors! Boost your confidence in passing the first time with our mobile app and a personal study plan based on your current skill and requirements.
Ever wanted to become a certified cosmetologist? The Cosmetology exam offered by the National-Interstate Council of State Boards of Cosmetology is the only thing standing between you and licensing. So be sure to be as prepared as possible on Cosmetology test day by starting your study as early as possible. The Cosmetology state board exam is broken down into two components that both need to be passed in order to gain licensing- a practical portion and a written portion.
Follow a specially designed personal study plan and train yourself to pass the first time!
Key features:
- Choose from different topics required to pass a certification
- Practice with 700+ questions
- Track your strengths and weaknesses within Stats section of the app
- Study detailed statistics of every test you take
- Compare your score to the community average for almost any type of exam
- - - -
Purchases, subscriptions and terms
You need to buy a lifetime access or subscribe to get access to all features, courses and questions. The cost of the purchase is charged to your iTunes account. Subscriptions are auto-renewable and are billed at the rate and period selected depending on the subscription plan. Users’ accounts are charged for auto-renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period.
Subscriptions can be managed and auto-renewal can be turned off in Account Settings in iTunes after the purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.

With ViewCaller, powered by a robust crowdsourced database of over 100 million phone IDs, you can accurately distinguish between important calls and those you’d rather block. 
Our call app ensures you have the most accurate information at your fingertips.
Why Choose ViewCaller for Call Blocking and Caller ID?
In today’s world, unwanted calls are more than just an annoyance—they’re a disruption. ViewCaller empowers you to manage these interruptions and take control of your communication. With advanced features, ViewCaller is your ultimate tool for privacy, security, and peace of mind.
Advanced Caller ID & Spam Detection
Real-Time Spam Detection: Automatically detect and block spam, fraud, and robocalls before you answer. Our AI-powered algorithms analyze call patterns to identify potential threats.
Global Community Insight: Benefit from our community-driven database, offering up-to-date information on millions of numbers worldwide, helping you avoid unwanted interactions.
Customizable Blocking: Tailor your blocking preferences. Whether blocking specific numbers, entire area codes, or suspicious calls, ViewCaller lets you set your boundaries.
Enhanced Caller ID: Access our advanced Caller ID features, with auto-updates to ensure you always have the latest information.
Know the Caller ID Before You Answer
Identify Callers Instantly: Enter any number to look up phone numbers and caller details, perfect for screening calls before answering.
Smart Search in Call History: Easily search through your call history to find information on past calls.
Caller ID Beyond Borders: Whether you’re traveling or receiving international calls, ViewCaller ensures you have the information you need.
Your Privacy, Our Priority
ViewCaller is committed to protecting your personal information. Your contacts are never made public, and our app respects your privacy at every turn.
Data Security: We use state-of-the-art encryption to protect your data, ensuring it’s safe whether stored on your device or in our secure servers.
Privacy Controls: Customize your privacy settings to decide what information is shared.
Transparency: Our privacy policy clearly outlines how your data is used, keeping you informed.
Comprehensive Feature Set
ViewCaller isn’t just about blocking spam—it’s a complete communication management tool:
Spam Identification and Blocking: Automatically block spam numbers, robocalls, and fraudsters. Customize your blocking settings as needed.
Verify Caller ID: Ensure you’re speaking to the right person by verifying the Caller ID against our extensive database.
Smart Search Functionality: Manage your call history easily with our intuitive search feature.
International Number Lookup: Deal with international contacts confidently using our global database.
Reverse Phone Lookup: Identify unknown numbers with our reverse phone lookup feature, ensuring you stay informed.
Easy-to-Use Interface: Navigate the app effortlessly with a user-friendly design.
Get Started with ViewCaller Today
Download ViewCaller and join millions who trust our app to keep their communication safe and organized. Whether blocking spam, verifying Caller IDs, or managing calls, ViewCaller has the tools you need. Use our phone lookup, reverse lookup, and number lookup features to ensure you never miss an important call.

bluejetty:00152213:ios.description:
Welcome to Rooms Stickers - the cozy sticker decorating game from Abovegames!
If you love cute games, relaxing puzzles, and decorating beautiful rooms with adorable items, this is the game for you. Match the perfect stickers to complete dreamy interiors, unlock new friends, and enjoy a calming, feel-good experience.
Rooms Stickers is a sweet and simple offline game designed for everyone who loves cozy decorating and wholesome vibes. Discover dozens of unique rooms, each hand-crafted in aesthetic isometric style, inspired by the spirit of adorable home and loved by fans of our other kawaii coloring books like Cozy Home and My Cute Friends.
In each level, you’ll enter a new room, filled with subtle shadow hints. Your job is to choose the right sticker and drag it into place. It’s not just about matching shapes. It’s about making each room come to life in its own dream-like way. The relaxing gameplay, delightful animals, and returning friends from our cozy universe create a warm, familiar world.
Whether you're placing a teapot in a sunny kitchen, a soft cushion in a comfy living room, or a stack of books in a dreamy bedroom, every sticker feels like part of a perfect deco. The more rooms you finish, the more coins you earn. And those coins help unlock premium levels with even more fun. You can boost rewards by watching optional ads or support the studio with special coin packs.
* Features:
 - Explore many dreamy rooms: cafés, bedrooms, kitchens, bathrooms, and more
 - Match and stick the correct stickers in each cozy and kawaii scene
 - Meet cute friends like a fashionable kitty, smiling dog, adorable bear twins, fluffy sheep, clever fox, happy panda, and a gentle hedgehog
 - Collect coins and unlock premium locations full of new deco and cozy details
 - Enjoy soothing music and a calm, relaxing game loop with no stress
 - Perfect for all ages – teens and adults alike will love this simple and fun experience
 - Works great as an offline game – no wifi games or no internet games needed
You’ll explore a growing gallery of relaxing and delightful locations. For example: Little Café, Dreamy Bedroom, Cool Bedroom, Comfy Living, Sunny Kitchen, Fresh Laundry, Bubble Bath, Warm Hall, Baby Room, Sweet Creamery, Reading Nook, Lovely Salon, Teen Room, Smart Living, and Happy Gym. Each space feels like a page out of your dream home. Whether you love reading in a cozy nook, relaxing in a bubble bath, or sipping tea in a little café, there’s a room that fits your mood.
Rooms Stickers is developed by Abovegames, the studio behind millions of downloads and other relaxing kawaii experiences like Cozy Home and My Cute Friends. This new game carries on our tradition of aesthetic, calm, and family-friendly gameplay with soft visuals, soothing music, and relaxing mechanics. You’ll recognize returning friends, now starring in new environments full of decorating fun.
This is more than just a game. It’s your personal dream space of decorating joy. Play at your own pace, stick with your style, and make every room uniquely yours. There’s no timer, no stress, and no wrong answer – just creativity, calm, and cozy fun.
Whether you're into decorating, relaxing games, adorable home vibes, or just looking for an antistress offline game, Rooms Stickers is your perfect kawaii escape. No wifi needed, no internet games required – just calm and cute fun with your favorite friends.
Download now and enter a cozy world full of stickers, rooms, and relaxing game moments.
Privacy Policy: https://abovegames.com/privacy-policy
Terms of Service: https://abovegames.com/terms-of-service

Rooms Stickers is a sweet and simple offline game designed for everyone who loves cozy decorating and wholesome vibes. Discover dozens of unique rooms, each hand-crafted in aesthetic isometric style, inspired by the spirit of adorable home and loved by fans of our other kawaii coloring books like Cozy Home and My Cute Friends.

In each level, you’ll enter a new room, filled with subtle shadow hints. Your job is to choose the right sticker and drag it into place. It’s not just about matching shapes. It’s about making each room come to life in its own dream-like way. The relaxing gameplay, delightful animals, and returning friends from our cozy universe create a warm, familiar world.

Whether you're placing a teapot in a sunny kitchen, a soft cushion in a comfy living room, or a stack of books in a dreamy bedroom, every sticker feels like part of a perfect deco. The more rooms you finish, the more coins you earn. And those coins help unlock premium levels with even more fun. You can boost rewards by watching optional ads or support the studio with special coin packs.

* Features:
  - Explore many dreamy rooms: cafés, bedrooms, kitchens, bathrooms, and more
  - Match and stick the correct stickers in each cozy and kawaii scene
  - Meet cute friends like a fashionable kitty, smiling dog, adorable bear twins, fluffy sheep, clever fox, happy panda, and a gentle hedgehog
  - Collect coins and unlock premium locations full of new deco and cozy details
  - Enjoy soothing music and a calm, relaxing game loop with no stress
  - Perfect for all ages – teens and adults alike will love this simple and fun experience
  - Works great as an offline game – no wifi games or no internet games needed

You’ll explore a growing gallery of relaxing and delightful locations. For example: Little Café, Dreamy Bedroom, Cool Bedroom, Comfy Living, Sunny Kitchen, Fresh Laundry, Bubble Bath, Warm Hall, Baby Room, Sweet Creamery, Reading Nook, Lovely Salon, Teen Room, Smart Living, and Happy Gym. Each space feels like a page out of your dream home. Whether you love reading in a cozy nook, relaxing in a bubble bath, or sipping tea in a little café, there’s a room that fits your mood.

Rooms Stickers is developed by Abovegames, the studio behind millions of downloads and other relaxing kawaii experiences like Cozy Home and My Cute Friends. This new game carries on our tradition of aesthetic, calm, and family-friendly gameplay with soft visuals, soothing music, and relaxing mechanics. You’ll recognize returning friends, now starring in new environments full of decorating fun.

This is more than just a game. It’s your personal dream space of decorating joy. Play at your own pace, stick with your style, and make every room uniquely yours. There’s no timer, no stress, and no wrong answer – just creativity, calm, and cozy fun.

Whether you're into decorating, relaxing games, adorable home vibes, or just looking for an antistress offline game, Rooms Stickers is your perfect kawaii escape. No wifi needed, no internet games required – just calm and cute fun with your favorite friends.

Download now and enter a cozy world full of stickers, rooms, and relaxing game moments.

bluejetty:00018878:ios.summary:
The Powers of Darkness have spread in the Real of Auria, you must forge your own destiny with this action packed RPG Hack & Slash and fight your way through endless hordes of orcs, undead, demons and all sorts of terrifying creatures.
Merc
bluejetty:00018878:ios.description:
The Powers of Darkness have spread in the Real of Auria, you must forge your own destiny with this action packed RPG Hack & Slash and fight your way through endless hordes of orcs, undead, demons and all sorts of terrifying creatures.
Merciless dungeon hunter or savior of the peace? Build your own legend, level up and create your character to match your favorite combat style. With no standard classes, your imagination is the only limit to grow the final warrior. 
Complete dozens of primary and side quests, entertain yourself with mini games to break the action, hire the best ally to participate in this great adventure. 
The gameplay returns to the origins of the true hack & slash games. No auto combat or endless grinding, your own skills will determine your success. Face gigantic bosses to unveil the true nature of your hero!
**GAME FEATURES**
PURE CLASSIC ACTION RPG
• Hack and slash your way through hordes of terrible monsters
• Collect loot and upgrade your equipment to get ready for the final battle
• Classic action RPG mechanics, forget endless grinding, your skills will be your only ally to defeat your enemies
BEST RPG OFFLINE EXPERIENCE
• Enjoy stunning 3D visuals travelling across the Realm of Auria
• Play offline, on the road or at your home, the game does NOT require an internet connection
EPIC STORY LINE
• Delve one more time into the Real of Auria, in this prequel to the Arcane Quest guild wars
• Uncover the mystery surrounding your hero’s past, join the Baron’s forces to save the Realm from this evil menace
COMPLETE CHARACTER CUSTOMIZATION
• Don’t get limited by standard character classes, build your own hero according to your favorite style: warrior, wizard, ranger, or mix it up for more fun!
• Choose from dozens of different abilities to create the perfect monster slayer
IN-APP PURCHASES
• Play the first act of the game completely for free, and unlock further acts only if you are enjoying your experience
• No tricky money grabbing schemes, consumable IAPs are absolutely optional and only if you need a boost to complete your adventure
Visit our official site at https://arcane-quest.com/
Check out the developer’s blog at https://nexgamestudios.com/
Don't forget to follow us on social media:
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/arcanequestlegends/
Twitter: https://twitter.com/NexGameStudios
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/nexgamestudios

bluejetty:00061365:ios.description:
The LEAD app equips you as a ministry or lay leader with the tools and information you need to know the story of your people so you can better disciple them — from wherever you are.
GROUPS
 • Stay in touch with your Group members and facilitate communication and connection between them
• Keep track of who’s staying connected and who’s slipping through the cracks by easily taking attendance from your phone
• Never miss a birthday or anniversary with your group Special Days list
• Create, view, and assign Needs to give your group members opportunities to support each other and their community
• Use Calendars to see the events in your group and peruse the guest list to keep track of who is staying connected
PEOPLE
 • See and edit information about your people and their family, and contact them easily with the built-in tools
 • Quickly understand a person's history and involvement in the church with the Timeline
 • Get a sense of the consistency of their connection with an overview of their Serving, Attending, and Giving patterns**
• Add new people to your system with the Create Profile feature, and make sure their data is correct by importing information from your phone's Contacts and using google's address validation**
SCHEDULES
 • See where there are holes in your schedule and easily fill them on the go
 • Update your volunteers' statuses for real-time schedule management
 • Send messages to your volunteers to keep them informed about their serving opportunities
 • Add more Schedule Weeks 
SERVICE PLANS
 • Create, Edit, or Add a Service Plan
 • Add more Schedule Weeks
CALENDARS
 • Use Admin Calendars to see the details of all the events happening in your church across your various campuses
 • Hone in on your Group's events and see where things are happening and who is coming
PROCESS QUEUES
 • Provide quick, intentional follow-up for your people, and keep them moving along the path of discipleship
 • Leave notes for people as you move them through a process so all leaders can stay informed about a person's journey
NOTES
 • Use Notes to share and view vital information among ministry leaders, keeping all of that important context in one place to tell a person's story
*You must have a current Church Community Builder software account in order to use this app.
** All functionality is based on your current Church Community Builder software permissions

bluejetty:00182881:ios.description:
Pull up a chair at the Hardwood Inn. Backgammon is one of the oldest games in the world -- and Hardwood Backgammon has been bringing players together for over 20 years. Whether you're a seasoned player or just learning the board, you'll find a welcoming atmosphere, good company, and a great game. Free to play, always.
If you're tired of board games dressed up as casinos, you've found your Hardwood Inn.
Play online with players worldwide, challenge a friend sitting next to you, or test yourself against our world-class Neural Net AI. For the ultimate face-to-face experience, our exclusive Tablet Board Mode lets you place your device flat on the table like a real backgammon board -- the UI flips automatically between players on each turn.
Why Players Keep Coming Back:
• A Mature Community: Moderated and friendly -- sportsmanship comes first
• World-Class AI: Neural Net engine plays like a real opponent, not a pushover
• Play Anywhere: Solo, online, or local multiplayer -- no internet required for solo
• Tablet Board Mode: Place your device flat and play face-to-face just like a real board
• Full Match Play with doubling cube support
• Competitive Edge: Online tournaments and global leaderboards
• Immersive Experience: Stunning environments and high-quality audio
• Total Customization: Unique boards, checkers, dice, and backgrounds -- available with tokens, purchasable anytime
Sign in with your Hardwood account across all our games and your cosmetics come with you. One collection, every game.
Want chat, rated games, an ad-free experience, and 200 tokens every month? Plus membership is optional and affordable.
More Hardwood Games:
• Hardwood Spades -- the classic trick taking game
• Hardwood Euchre -- Jacks are Trump
• Hardwood Hearts -- avoid the points
• Video Poker Duel -- competitive video poker for two
Prefer a quiet game alone? All of our games can be played solo -- but for the ultimate single player experience, check out Hardwood Solitaire IV, also available on the App Store.
Questions, suggestions, or found an issue? We love hearing from our players at support@silvercrk.com
____________________
Hardwood Games Subscriptions are optional and available at a rate of 1 month for $4.99, 3 months for $14.99 or 1 year for $29.99. Payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions will auto-renew unless turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your iTunes account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. Your subscriptions can be managed from your iTunes account settings. Cancellation of subscriptions is not allowed. Our privacy policy may be viewed at http://www.hardwoodgames.com/about/privacy/ Our terms of service may be viewed at http://www.hardwoodgames.com/about/terms/

bluejetty:00022828:ios.description:
Cloud Mail.Ru for iPhone, iPad and iPod touch - a free service for saving photos, videos, music, presentations, documents and other files.
With Cloud Mail.Ru, all your photos will always be at hand. Upload your files to your cloud drive, and they’ll automatically be available on all of your devices.
* Upload photos from your mobile phone. Adjust the automatic “save to disk” in your gallery. In order to save bandwidth, it is recommended to perform downloads while connected to a Wi-Fi.
* Free space on your device, because all of your photos are already in Cloud.
* Share files and folders with friends and colleagues in just one click.
* Save bandwidth. You can send a link to an image, video, or document by SMS, email, instant messenger or thru a social network.
* View MS Office documents: Word, Excel, PowerPoint and PDFs, as well as files in other formats.
* Cloud Mail.Ru allows you to watch videos (including the most popular video formats: avi, mkv, mp4, mov, wmv) and listen to music. Cloud can play a video file without downloading it on the device.
* Manage your files from anywhere; rename, delete and move them between folders.
* Create shared folders with other users, add any files together. Use shared folders with friends to collect photos from party or travelling. bluejetty:00184604:ios.description:
Truth or Dare is the go-to party game when you want to break the ice, start some trouble, or find out what your friends are really like. Whether you’re at a party, on a date, or just killing time with your crew, this app brings the right mix of awkward questions and bold dares to keep things interesting.

ICE BREAKERS – Light questions to get people talking 
PICK YOUR POISON – Push boundaries with deeper dares 
NEVER HAVE I EVER – Admit it, or take the hit 
DO YOU DARE? – All dares, no backing out 
MOST LIKELY TO – Call out your friends and start some debates 
LOVERS – For couples who want to turn up the heat 
FRENEMIES – Friendly fire and honest shots
WHAT’S INSIDE
• Over 1000 questions and dares, with more added regularly 
• Different modes for every group and mood 
• No internet required, perfect for any setting 
• Works for parties, dates, trips, or random nights in 
• Still delivers at 3AM, unlike your friends
Most party games get boring fast. This one doesn’t. Just open the app, pick a mode, and let things play out.
DOWNLOAD TRUTH OR DARE NOW, AND SEE WHO CAN REALLY HANDLE THE TRUTH.

GARDEN TEA PARTY (FREE)

• When you purchase a subscription, you forfeit any unused portion of a free trial period.

bluejetty:00187301:ios.summary:
Simplify tracking and managing your cattle -- no more pen and paper, spreadsheets or outdated, expensive software. Ranchr gives you (and your hired help) a single app to manage all your cattle information from your phone or iPad.
By using
bluejetty:00187301:ios.description:
Simplify tracking and managing your cattle -- no more pen and paper, spreadsheets or outdated, expensive software. Ranchr gives you (and your hired help) a single app to manage all your cattle information from your phone or iPad.
By using Ranchr's cattle management software you will save time, money and stress. It was built by cattle farmers to make the job much easier.
The product includes a mobile app and a dashboard in the cloud, so that you can access and update cattle records in the field, at home or in the office
With Ranchr, you can track basic info about your livestock such as name, ear tag, date of birth, breed, and sex. Ranchr also makes it easy to add additional details and keep track of changes (cattle health, calves, cattle sales, etc) over time.
You can also report when you sell the cow, when the cow gets a treatment, when there is a health change such as a sickness to the cow, and when you record a weight of the cow, along with the option to add notes and the date you applied the record.
Ranchr was been designed by farmers for farmers. Its mission is to eliminate the time it takes to record information of your livestock/cattle so you can keep better track of your cattle's information. Having complete and accurate livestock records will give you the tools to make your ranch very profitable and eliminate waste
The cattle records you enter on your phone will instantly be available on the online dashboard and to other app users who belong to your ranch. Having this ease of access to your cattle records will make your day to day ranch management operations simple and easy.
Ranchr is the easiest to use cattle management software on the market. It eliminates the need of carrying around a pen and paper by bringing the power to your fingertips with a mobile app along with an online dashboard for your computer.
We appreciate your time and encourage you to give us feedback on how we can better improve your experience in recording your cattle records.
Terms if Service: https://ranchr.ag/terms/

bluejetty:00156761:ios.description:
Your story lives in Roanoke. From reporting on all of your favorite teams to the news that matters most in your community, we cover it all. Get in-depth stories from the Roanoke area and beyond – including news, sports, opinion, obituaries, entertainment, and politics.
Easily access the very latest news in an app built for you. Read, see, and hear exclusive commentary, stunning photography, video updates, and binge-worthy podcasts.
Plus, subscribers have the ability to upgrade to News+, our premium ad-free experience! That means faster-loading pages and an uninterrupted reading experience. 
Our app features:
* Your Stories – personalize your experience by selecting the local news topics that matter most to you
* Get notified – stay in the loop by selecting alerts for news, sports, weather, and more
* Easy navigation – see all the latest local stories by simply swiping up/down, and left/right.
* Read stories your way – either in the News Feed or via the E-edition
* Breaking news updates – top banners let you know what’s happening right now
* Follow author – get notifications whenever your favorite writers post a story
* Bookmark for later – save stories to enjoy at your leisure
* Listen to articles – press the play button to listen instead
* Customize your text size – make the content bigger or smaller in your profile settings
* Weather where you are – hourly, 10-day forecasts, and frequent video updates
Free to download. Subscribers enjoy unlimited access.

bluejetty:00187400:ios.description:
Odoo Mobile:
The new Odoo Mobile app for iOS provides access to all Odoo applications directly from your mobile phone. Optimized for interfaces on any iOS device, Odoo Mobile provides the next level of flexibility in your business management software. 
Every application in your Odoo database is available from one native app, allowing you to maintain your records, reports, sales, content management, and more while on-the-go. Push notifications keep you informed of every task or action you follow, and the adaptive content delivery system ensures that every screen is optimally viewable from any device size. 
Get more out of your Odoo database and stay on top of all of your priorities without worrying about time spent away from your computer. Take your work out of the office and on the go with Odoo.
Supported Versions: 
Odoo 16 or higher (Enterprise)
About Odoo:
Odoo is a suite of open source business apps that covers all your company needs: CRM, eCommerce, Accounting, Inventory, Point of Sale, Project Management, and more.
The mobile app offers a smooth and friendly user experience that has been carefully built to ensure quick and seamless user adoption.
Fluidity and full integration cover the needs of even the most complex companies. With Odoo you have the flexibility to add apps whenever a new need is determined according to the growth of your company, adding one app at a time as your business evolves and your customer base grows.

bluejetty:00145355:ios.description:
Receive the wisdom of God's Word, from the Book of Proverbs, on your mobile device every day. Verse selections are hand-picked each day and thought provoking commentary is available a few times a week to enrich your Proverb-A-Day experience.
Below are a few of the features you'll love about Proverb-A-Day:
- Provides the ability to share your experience with friends over e-mail, SMS, and social network mediums such as Facebook. 
- Reminder feature to enhance your daily experience. This reminder feature can be configured to pop up daily reminders at a user-specified time each day to help you remain consistent your daily reading. 
- Ability to view Proverbs Bible verse selections published in the past at your convenience. 
- Occasional commentary is offered to engage you about a Proverbs Bible verse selection. Commentary will be available at least 1-2 times per week. 
- Select a preferred translation 
Now you can also bookmark Proverbs Bible verses (and commentaries) that you really like so that you can review them again later. Plus your bookmarked verses/commentaries will automatically sync across all your iDevices through your iCloud account. The bookmarking feature can be purchased through the In-App Store. 
We hope that Proverb-A-Day will help everyone cultivate a deeper relationship with God and serve as a daily launchpad into His Word.
Preferred translations for Proverbs Bible verses include: 
NET (New English Translation) 
NIV (New International Version) 
NKJV (New King James Version) 
NLT (New Living Translation) 
KJV (King James Version)

bluejetty:00014682:ios.description:
Salto KS | Smart access control, managed from anywhere.
Salto KS puts cloud-based access control in your pocket. Whether you operate a single office or manage multiple sites worldwide, the Salto KS app gives you real-time control over every door, user, and location.
Keyless entry made effortless
• Unlock doors with your phone by tapping the lock. No mechanical keys required.
• Open doors remotely, anytime, from anywhere.
• Securely verify and unlock with Face ID or Touch ID.
Powerful administration in the app
• Create users and assign, update, or block credentials on the go.
• Grant and manage guest access with customizable permissions, check-in/check-out dates, and time-based access schedules.
• Instantly block or unblock tags and digital keys if credentials are lost or stolen.
• Keep authorized users moving during network outages with Offline Access credentials.

bluejetty:00016955:ios.description:
This game includes optional in-game purchases of virtual currency that can be used to acquire virtual in-game items, including a random selection of virtual in-game items.
 From the makers of Plants vs. Zombies 2 and Plants vs. Zombies Garden Warfare 2 comes the next epic battle between doom and bloom – Plants vs. Zombies Heroes. Build your team of heroes in this courageous collectible card game. Embark on a journey to discover new characters and confront mighty opponents along the way. And, for the first time ever on mobile, play as either plants or zombies. It’s the lawn of a new battle!
 COLLECT YOUR HEROES
 Discover 20 unique plant and zombie heroes, unlock their lawn-inspiring super powers, and choose your favorites based on their signature styles and abilities. Will you pick plants and deploy the masked, sharp-shooting avenger Green Shadow? Or will you choose a zombie hero, like the superbly superficial Super Brainz? Each hero’s unique selection of super powers helps define your team’s winning strategy.
 GROW YOUR TEAM
 Every hero needs a crew. Build yours and diversify your skills by collecting or crafting hundreds of cards – from the PvZ characters you know and love, to daring original plants and zombies. Devise distinct strategies when you select cards compatible with your hero, and experiment with devastating combos. Use the Deck Builder to quickly construct winning decks, try out strategies, and upgrade your decks as you collect and craft characters.
 BATTLE FRIENDS AND FOES
 Test your deck when you take on other players or challenge your friends in exciting real-time matches. Practice tactics in casual multiplayer battles or enter competitive ranked play to compete with the best players in the world. Earn rewards for defeating the bite-iest adversaries, and build your bank when you complete Quests from Crazy Dave and Dr. Zomboss.
 GO ON COURAGEOUS ADVENTURES
 Journey through the universe of PvZ Heroes as each action-packed skirmish takes you further along an ever-blooming map. Take on brain-thirsty or botanical foes along the way and hone your skills – each side has a different path to follow. Defeat challenging bosses to unlock fresh characters and new rewards. Even take your team with you when you switch between mobile devices – just sign into Facebook or Game Center to save your collection.

Collects data through third party analytics technology (see Privacy & Cookie Policy for details). Contains direct links to the Internet and social networking sites intended for an audience over 13.

bluejetty:00080692:ios.description:
Become the Ultimate Supermarket Store Manager!
Ready to transform your humble grocery shop into a bustling hypermarket? 
Dive into My Perfect Shop, the most engaging supermarket simulator that lets you manage customers and run a successful cash register! Your journey to becoming a supermarket legend starts here!
Unlock Exciting Items as You Grow! 
In My Perfect Shop, every level brings new and exciting challenges. As you progress, you’ll unlock a wide variety of items that will help you create the ultimate grocery store experience. The longer you play, the more treasures you’ll discover to showcase in your store!
Master the Art of Organization! 
Keeping your grocery store organized is crucial! Sort your items and stock your shelves with precision. A tidy store not only helps customers find what they need, but it also enhances their shopping experience. Show off your skills as a supermarket manager in this thrilling store game!
Enjoy Fun Shopping Tasks! 
From handling the cash register to assisting customers, every task is an adventure! Complete thrilling shopping game tasks that will test your skills and keep you engaged. My Perfect Shop is not just about managing; it’s about thriving in a vibrant supermarket environment!
Race through Shopping Cart Adventures! 
Take a break from the daily hustle and enjoy cart-surfing adventures! Speed through the aisles and parking lot on your shopping cart for a fun twist. Can you master the art of cart-surfing without crashing into obstacles?
Cleaning Frenzy to Impress Customers! 
A clean grocery store is a happy store! Grab your mop and ensure your supermarket sparkles. Keeping your retail store clean will attract more customers and boost your reputation as a top supermarket manager!
Colorful Levels with Unique Challenges! 
Each level in My Perfect Shop is filled with colorful graphics and unique challenges that will keep you on your toes. Build your supermarket empire by completing exciting stages that test your managerial skills!
Simple Controls, Endless Fun! 
With easy-to-learn controls, My Perfect Shop provides a fun and immersive cashier game experience. Just touch, drag, and swipe your way to success as you navigate various tasks and challenges in this vibrant store game.
More Items Than a Real Supermarket! 
If you love shopping, you’re in for a treat! My Perfect Shop features more items to discover than in a real grocery store. From everyday essentials to rare finds, your inventory will be diverse and exciting!
Experience the Ultimate Grocery Game! 
As a supermarket manager, you’ll handle everything from the cash register to stocking shelves. Your decisions will shape your store’s success. With vibrant 3D graphics, My Perfect Shop immerses you in a bustling supermarket atmosphere!
Ready to Build Your Grocery Empire? 
Embark on the most exciting grocery store simulation adventure! See if you have what it takes to become the ultimate supermarket manager!
Download My Perfect Shop now!

bluejetty:00064793:ios.description:
The mission of this app is helping you become debts free by Snowball method which is most popular used and recommended by many financial experts. 
There are five strategies provided, Highest Interest Rate First, Lowest Balance First. Highest Balance First, Earliest Payment Date First and Custom Order, Debts Break will show you pay off date and interest saved by each strategy. Use this app to manage your debts and track the pay off processes visually. 
Key Features: 
⁃ Shows remaining balance, monthly payments, paid amount and percentage of each debt. 
⁃ Update remaining balance automatically. 
⁃ Lists payment logs, mark them as paid or unpaid. 
⁃ Add extra payment for any debts. 
⁃ Supports zero interest rate. 
⁃ Add notification for each debt. 
⁃ Send Debt payments by email. 
⁃ Five Snowball Payoff plan: Highest Interest Rate First, Lowest Balance First, Highest Balance First, Earliest Payment Date First and Custom Order. 
⁃ Shows pay off date and interest saving of each strategy. 
⁃ Turn Snowball method ON or OFF. 
⁃ Four calculators: Loan, Payoff Date and Mortgage and Affordable Loan, send amortizations out by email. 
⁃ Reports for percentage and balance amount of each debt, pie chart for balance and interest. Chart view of monthly amount of each debt. Chart view of yearly total debts payment and each debt. 
⁃ Passcode protection. 
⁃ Supports Touch ID as passcode.
⁃ Supports Wifi Backup and Restore. 
⁃ Supports iCloud Backup and Restore. 
⁃ Supports universal version (available on both iPhone and iPad).
⁃ Adds 3D Touch function.
⁃ Supports Apple Watch.

bluejetty:00023756:ios.name: My Family: Find Friends Phone
bluejetty:00023756:ios.summary: My Family GPS Locator app is designed for family safety and parental control. The app cannot be installed secretly, the use permitted only with explicit consent. GPS data is stored in accordance with GDPR policy. The app is visible in progr
bluejetty:00023756:ios.description:
My Family GPS Locator app is designed for family safety and parental control. The app cannot be installed secretly, the use permitted only with explicit consent. GPS data is stored in accordance with GDPR policy. The app is visible in programs. Users can share location only inside application.
My Family GPS Locator app is the most accurate and easy to use service which can help your family stay connected all over the world. It’s simple way to be a little more safe 24/7
Application provides a realtime location finder service allowing relatives to privately share their gps location. My Family locates you and your loved ones on map.
With My Family app you can:
- View the realtime location of relatives on a private family map that’s only visible on Family Locator
- Receive realtime smart alerts when your loved ones arrive home, school, or any places you set. (It’s the best way to protect your kids and keep your kids safe!)
- Browse location history for 30 days in a convenient way
- Share your own battery charge level
- GPS Location finder for stolen phones or lost phones 
- You no longer have to bother your child with “Where are you?” calls or texts
- Receive automatic notifications when a family member is nearby
To get automated alerts when your relatives arrives somewhere, create Places, (e.g. gym, cinema, restaurant)
When your family members enters or leaves these areas, your phone receives a notification.
When the phone's battery level falls below 10%, My Family tracker sends alerts about this phone, and you can remind your child to charge the phone.
My Family offers deluxe service as a recurring subscription.
Premium available by subscription includes: 
- Unlimited number of Places
- 30 days of location history
- Statistics of movements (Walks, Trips, Time in traffic jams)
- Analysis of driving style (acceleration, braking, speed above 130 km/h) 
Premium subscription comes with a 7 days free trial and renews automatically to a paid plan. Two subscription options are available: Quarterly at $49.99, Weekly at $7.99 and Yearly at $79.99. Prices may vary by location. Subscription with a free trial period will automatically renew to a paid subscription unless auto-renewal is turned off.
Subscription information:
- Payments will be credited to your iTunes account upon confirmation of purchase
- Subscription automatically renews if automatic renewal is not turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period
- Accounts will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period and determine the cost of renewal
- Subscriptions can be managed by the user, and automatic updating can be disabled by going to the user account settings after purchasing
- During the active subscription period, the current subscription is not canceled
- Any unused part of the free trial period, if offered, will be confiscated when the user purchases a subscription to this publication, if applicable.
Privacy Policy https://familylocator.life/privacy
Terms of Service https://familylocator.life/term_and_conditions
