bluejetty:00118169:android.description:
Pocketly–Your Go-To Instant personal loan app!
Need a quick loan? Say goodbye to long bank queues & endless paperwork! Welcome to Pocketly, the ultimate instant personal loan app designed to give you financial freedom exactly when you need it. Whether you are a student needing tuition fees or a salaried professional facing an end-of-month crunch, Pocketly is the secure online loan solution you have been waiting for.
With the Pocketly money app, credit is just a tap away. We offer a seamless experience that lets you get credit up to ₹25,000. Our smart technology ensures that once your KYC is approved, the loan amount is disbursed into your account within seconds!
Why Choose Pocketly?
We understand that financial needs can be urgent. That is why our quick loan process is designed for speed & simplicity.
- Zero Physical Documentation: Complete your KYC online. No paper forms, no fuss. Everything is 100% digital.
- Lightning-Fast Disbursal: Get cash in your bank account in seconds after KYC approval.
Key Features:
- Credit up to ₹25,000: Bridge your financial gaps with Pocketly. Get instant access to funds from small amounts up to ₹25,000 anytime!
- Instant Disbursal: Complete your 100% online KYC in minutes on our instant personal loan app. Once verified, your quick loan is transferred immediately to your account.
- Specialized for Everyone: Manage your cash flow seamlessly with Pocketly, the widely trusted personal loans for student and salaried individuals .
- Flexible Repayment Plans: Repay on your own terms! Choose a payback period of 61 to 180 days. Our interest rates are affordable, starting from just 2% to 3% per month.
- Referral Rewards: Spread the word about our online loan platform! Refer your friends to Pocketly & earn up to ₹10,000 in benefits.
Who is Pocketly Money App For?
- Students: Do you need extra cash for books, exams, or a trip? Pocketly is the perfect student loan companion to keep your studies & lifestyle on track.
- Salaried Professionals: Facing an unexpected medical bill or utility expense? Use our quick loan feature to bridge the gap until payday.
- Self-employed Professionals: Need urgent funds to cover small business expenses? Our loan assist feature provides the financial backup you need instantly.
Transparent Fees & Charges
Transparency is the core of our loan assistance promise.
- Interest Rates: 2% to 3% per month.
- APR: 30% to 132%.
- Processing Fees: 0% - 7.5% (GST extra as applicable).
- Tenure: 61 days to 180 days.
Representative Loan Example
Here is how our online loan calculation works:
Loan Amount: ₹5,000
Tenure: 90 Days
Interest Rate: 36% per annum
Processing Fee: As applicable (assumed small fee for calculation)
Calculation:
Interest = ₹5,000 x 36% x 90/365 = ₹443.8
Total Repayment Amount: ₹5,000 (Principal) + ₹443.8 (Interest) = ₹5443.8
(Note: GST & processing fees will be extra as applicable)
Lending NBFC
Speel Finance Company Pvt. Ltd. (CIN: U65920MH1995PTC090558). Speel Finance Company Pvt. Ltd. is a RBI registered NBFC. 
Speel Finance Company Pvt. Ltd. provides the loans as well as owns and operates the digital lending platform application Pocketly.
Take Control of Your Finances Today!
Get access to funds exactly when you need them. Whether you need a student loan for college expenses, loan assistance to manage monthly budgets, or a quick loan for a medical emergency, we are here to help. Funds are just seconds away!
Join thousands of satisfied users who have made Pocketly their preferred online loan partner. Experience a true instant personal loan app where money reaches you in a flash.
Contact Us
If you have any queries or need help with our loan application, please reach out: care@support.pocketly.in
Privacy & Policy : https://speelfinance.com/privacy-policy ; https://pocketly.in/privacy-policy
Download Pocketly now—the smart loan assist & borrowing solution for modern India!

bluejetty:00099700:ios.description:
Turn spoken words into organized knowledge — instantly.
NoteSpeak records any talk and transforms it into clean transcripts, concise AI summaries, and notes. Capture lectures, meetings, interviews, and podcasts. Get the key points, action items, timestamps, and categories—so you can review in minutes, not hours.
Why NoteSpeak?
- One-tap capture: Start recording fast—focus on the moment, not the mic.
- Accurate transcripts: Clear, readable text for lectures, meetings, and voice notes.
- AI key points: Automatic summaries with highlights, action items, and decisions.
- Chapters & timestamps: Jump to the exact moment that matters.
- Auto-organized notes: Categories, tags, and smart folders keep everything tidy.
- Works across languages: Record and transcribe in multiple languages for global workflows.
- Share & export: Send summaries or full transcripts; export for study or collaboration.
What You’ll Get?
- From speech to text—fast: High-quality transcription you can trust for study, work, or research.
- From text to insight: AI distills long recordings into clear bullet points and follow-ups.
- From chaos to clarity: Automatic topics, categories, and tags make notes easy to browse.
- From scattered files to a system: All your lectures, meetings, and voice memos live in one organized library.
Built for Real Life
Students & learners: Capture lectures, get clean notes, and review key ideas before exams.
Professionals & teams: Turn meetings into minutes with action items you can share.
Researchers, journalists, creators: Transcribe interviews and podcasts; pull quotes and highlights.
Multilingual workflows: Record in any language no need to change your settings AI organize them together perfectly.
Details that Delight
- Speaker-aware notes (when applicable): Attribute points to the right voice for clearer minutes.
- Noise-aware recording: Optimized for classrooms, conference rooms, and on-the-go capture.
- Smart formatting: Headings, bullets, and sections make summaries and key points effortless to skim.
How it fits your day?
-Lecture first thing: Hit record → get transcript + summary + key terms before your next class.
Stand-up before lunch: Auto minutes with decisions & owners—no manual note-taking.
Interview after work: Capture everything, then scan highlights to write faster.
Highlights (at a glance)
Record • Transcribe • Summarize
Key points • Action items • Decisions
Auto categories • Tags • Organized library
Multilanguage recording & transcription
Copy & paste when you’re ready
Give your ideas a better memory.
Download NoteSpeak today and turn every lecture, meeting, and conversation into organized knowledge.
Developed by Fastemy - Fast and Fun Education

Game Features
- Action buttons to select what to do and enhance abilities
- Automated battles
bluejetty:00161501:ios.description:
"Let's begin your own story."
This is a text-based idle RPG game.
There are already more than 3,000 unique story actions and it's still growing.
Game Features
- Action buttons to select what to do and enhance abilities
- Automated battles in Dungeon
- A system to summon monsters and strengthen them
- Skill and Equipment for summoned monsters
- An upgrade system called Routine with offline bonus
- A system to automate Action and Dungeon
Other features can be unlocked as you progress through the game.
System Features
- A multi-ending system where the ending changes depending on your choices.
- Offline bonus allows the progress made when the game is closed to be reproduced when the game is launched.
Story
You'll start this game from the village.
Your father says "Be strong, and save your mother.".
Clear many quests and battle against monsters to be strong.
Making friends may be good for your journey.
Everything starts from here.
Controls
Tap buttons to select action.
Read the help section in game for detail.

bluejetty:00170574:ios.description:
Transform your living space into a haven of convenience and ambiance with Monster Smart
Lighting, the ultimate smart home control app. This powerful and intuitive application
seamlessly integrates with your Monster Smart Lighting devices, putting the power of
customization and control right at your fingertips.
Key Features:
1. Effortless Control:
• Easily control your Monster Smart Lighting devices with just a few taps.
• Advanced device list display shows the status and state of each product for at-a-glance
control.
• Adjust brightness, color, and color scene with precision and ease.
2. Dynamic RGBIC Lighting:
• Experience the patented technology of RGB+IC (Independent Chip) dynamic lighting
effects. Individually control multiple colors simultaneously to display colors that flow
dynamically along your Monster Smart Lighting strips.
• Choose from a mesmerizing array of colors and patterns that create a captivating visual
display.
3. Customizable Scenes:
• Create personalized lighting scenes for every occasion. Set the perfect mood for movie
nights, parties, and relaxation.
• Schedule scenes to activate at specific times, ensuring your home is always ready for any
event.
4. Voice Control:
• Seamlessly connect with voice assistants like Amazon Alexa and Hey Google for hands-
free control. Set up Siri Shortcuts to customize even more actions!
5. Group and Individual Control:
• Manage multiple devices at once by grouping them for simultaneous control or fine-tune
each device individually for a tailored smart home experience.
6. Scheduling:
• Set schedules to automate your lighting devices. Wake up to a soft illumination or have
your lights turn off at bedtime.
• Perfect for simulating your presence while you're away, enhancing your home's security.
7. Easy Setup:
• Setting up a Monster Smart Lighting device is a breeze. Just follow the simple in-app
instructions to get started.
8. Security and Privacy:
• Rest easy knowing your data and privacy are protected, and your smart home is secure
from unauthorized access.

any time and enjoy a personalized and secure smart home. Download the Monster Smart
Lighting app now and take the first step toward making your home truly smart.

bluejetty:00065008:ios.description:
Interior Federal’s digital banking was designed with you in mind! You can manage your account quickly, securely, and easily 24/7 whether you’re at home or on the go. Quickly sign in using Touch ID® or Face ID® to access your account. You can also apply for loans, open new accounts, or find your nearest ATM or branch location.
Features:
• Securely access your account 24/7.
• View balances and transaction history.
• Transfer between accounts or access member to member transfers.
• Zelle®: Use the largest person to person network to facilitate transfers.
• Schedule and pay bills using Bill Pay.
• Deposit checks to your account using Mobile Deposit.
• Credit Score: View your credit score, view credit report activity and see how it impacts your score, and even get alerts for credit score updates.

• Much more!
To sign in to digital banking, use your Interior Federal username and password. If you haven’t registered for digital banking, click “Sign Up”. If you are unable to login, select “Forgot Login?” to reset your password or to retrieve your username. If you are not a member, you can apply online by visiting www.interiorfederal.org.
Federally insured by NCUA. 
Equal Housing Lender.

bluejetty:00118752:ios.description:
Easily manage your DaySmart Appointments business scheduling account from your iPhone or iPad with the DaySmart Appointments app.
DaySmart Appointments lets you take your business schedule with you, wherever you work. Manage appointments for yourself or your entire staff. Create, update and cancel appointments on the fly. You can meet a potential client while you’re out, enter their information, and set them up with their first appointment, all from one intuitive interface.
BENEFITS
• Create, view, update and cancel appointments and reserve times
• Create, view, update and delete customers
• Create new customers while setting up their first appointment
• View customer details while viewing their appointment details
• Easily link out to a map of your customer’s location
• Link to the customer phone number to call and confirm appointments
• Send appointment reminder emails to your customers
• If you’re an administrator, manage appointments and customers for your locations, staff, and rooms
• Manage appointments made by your customers on your DaySmart Appointments customer-facing website
• View customer appointment history, either from the customer record, or from the customer detail view, inside an appointment detail view
FEATURES
• Supports multiple appointments per timeslot
• Supports pets and children sub-categories
• Add pets or children to an existing customer
• View, update or remove pets or children
• Package balance and expiration are displayed (if applicable), when choosing a package, while creating or updating an appointment
ABOUT
DaySmart Appointments provides online scheduling software for many industries, including health services, personal and professional services, education, events and many others. DaySmart Appointments scales to any size from small businesses to large enterprises.

apple-macos:6764365394.name: Shopping Cycle
apple-macos:6764365394.description:
Shopping Cycle is a free, ad-free shopping list with built-in recipe management and a strong focus on managing the supplies that every shopping trip creates. All features are available without any purchase; the in-app purchases and subscriptions are a voluntary way to support development. The app came about because none of the apps our family tried really fit.
Shopping Cycle treats shopping as a cycle: planning the trip, doing the shopping, managing the supplies and using them up (in time) – Plan, Shop, Store, Use. Data is stored in iCloud and can be shared with other iCloud users.
A few of the features at a glance:
PLAN
* Product suggestions based on your previous purchases.
* A look at your supplies right while adding items.
* Templates for quickly adding your usual shopping (taking supplies into account).
* Creating new products with Apple Intelligence support – from iOS 27 on devices with Apple Intelligence also from a photo, via Apple Private Cloud Compute.
* Different environments keep shopping and pantry lists sensibly together – your own lists as well as shared ones (home, holiday flat, helping a neighbour, ...)
SHOP
* Location-based reminders – for the shopper (“You still wanted to shop at the supermarket”) and the family (“Frank is shopping at the supermarket right now”).
* Places with several stores side by side – for the supermarket with a bakery, right next to the drugstore.
* Learned in-store orders for quick checking off.
* Capture best-before dates right while shopping – typed in or with image recognition.
STORE
* Putting purchases away after shopping: into any list, spread across different storage locations – with sensible defaults, of course.
* Purchases can be split right away – the roast as 2 steaks into the fridge and as a roast into the freezer.
* Each storage location has a cooling class so that best-before dates can be calculated sensibly.
USE
* Recipes can be imported and used in the weekly plan. Their ingredients fill the shopping list automatically.
* Best-before dates are monitored continuously and adjusted when storage locations change.
* Notifications remind you of expiring products, widgets give a quick overview.
* When an item is used up, one tap puts it back on the shopping list.
There is a lot to discover. And if something is missing – or a translation is off – please get in touch!
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://www.shoppingcycle.de/datenschutz-app.html

apple-itunes:6478195913.name: KT Messenger
apple-itunes:6478195913.description:
KT Messenger is a unique and innovative messaging and call application that redefines the way you communicate with your friends, family and professional relationships. 
KT Messenger's mission is to bring people from around the world closer by eliminating the language barrier between the people who use the app. 
It’s a free application that requires only an Internet connection to connect you with people around the world. 
With KT Messenger, you can easily make multi-party voice and video calls in addition to sharing messages, videos, photos, documents, contacts, location, audio messages and files in a secure way. 
Audio and Video Calls
Call your contacts for free with KT Messenger. KT Messenger offers both individual and group voice and video calls with amazing voice and video quality plus other features.
Group Calls
There is no limit on the number of participants in a group call. Add as many participants as you want and have fun!
Real-time Translation
KT Messenger translates every message to the preferred language of each recipient as they are received with an amazing accuracy.
Text and Audio conversion
Listen to all text messages in a chat by pressing the speaker icon next to each message. 
Edit your messages
You can edit your messages any time after you send them. 
Forward messages
Forward any message to your contacts. KT Messenger shows the name of the owner of forwarded message. With every forwarded message you receive, you know who created it and when. 
Rich chat interface
Enjoy rich chat features like Edit, Delete, Forward, Reply, Copy and Share. Long tap on any message to see the menu containing these options.
No Limits
With KT Messenger, enjoy true freedom. Share files of any size with your contacts. Record audio and video messages of any length and say no to limits.
Audio and Video Recordings
With KT Messenger, you have full control on what you record. Whether it is an audio or video message, you can record messages of any length. Pause / resume recordings and even play them before posting in a chat.
Privacy Settings
Control the way you want to share your personal information with others. Hide your date of birth, phone number and other information. KT Messenger does not hide Seen status of others from you even if you hide your Seen status. Block unwanted people without letting them know that they have been blocked.
Find Friends
Grow your network by finding people from our global database. Search people by their name, phone number or email address.
Share
Share messages and files you receive in KT Messenger with other apps. It's also easy to share anything from others apps with your KT Messenger contacts.
Secure
Security is our main concern. Your data is stored on KT Messenger servers in a highly secure environment. State-of-art encryption algorithms encrypt your data and communication channels to ensure a maximum level of security.
We love your feedback. If you have any comments, suggestions or ideas to improve your KT Messenger experience, please don't hesitate to reach out to us at info@poshenterpriseinc.com
